And while we are facing a Republican trifecta on the federal stage, we can still make progress at the state level across the country.
Our mission then is clear: we must hold leaders accountable, tirelessly advocate for fair maps across the nation, and unwaveringly uphold the core principles of democracy reform and election integrity.

My Dear Friend, When I tell people my story, I hear the same things over and over again:“That’s crazy.” “I don’t believe that.” “That can’t be.”But if you’ve heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or Fox News, then you know it’s horribly true. My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son **James** in the photo above.I’ve spent the last decade fighting tooth-and-nail to keep school counselors, my ex-wife, and activist judges from “transitioning” **James** against my will. If you didn’t know, “transitioning” is the LGBTQ+ industry’s euphemism for sex change surgery or the chemical castration of a child.And if these radicals get their way, my son will be sterilized, traumatized, and dependent on Big Pharma for the rest of his life.This all started ten years ago when my ex-wife began telling me our two-year-old boy **James **wanted to become a girl.I ignored her and kept dressing my son in boy’s clothes. Because he’s a boy!But then I found out that after dropping him off at school, the school counselor would change him into girl’s clothes WITHOUT TELLING ME.The counselors and teachers also began calling him a different name, “Luna,” at school. Also without telling me!I assumed I’d be able to stop this madness during the custody hearings with my ex-wife. Instead, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.I would only be allowed to see James if I dressed him in girl’s clothes.My friend, I’ve never lied to my sons.And I’m not about to start now. So I was forced to stop visiting him.And then I began the fight of my life to save James from this evil “trans” culture.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers.I even authored a bill to outlaw sex change surgeries for minors in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee.And spent almost every dollar I had to make sure politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair.After I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, my ex-wife fled with **James** to California: a “trans sanctuary” state. I think you know exactly what happened once she got to California.A radical judge sided with my ex-wife and gave the greenlight to proceed with chemically castrating my son.I have never felt so helpless in my life. I am James’s father – yet I can’t protect him from the powerful LGBTQ+ activists who are using my ex-wife and our kangaroo court systems to turn my son into the poster child for their twisted and perverted agenda.I’ve watched the school system, my ex-wife, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.In fact, I can’t even appeal my case because the judge sealed the court records. I’d have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process.Worst of all, I am under a gag order to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Technically, my writing you this to you today is illegal.But I didn’t hesitate for one second to write it. If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time.But I’m not just some activist.I’m a father trying to save his son from the Left’s madness and butchery.This is what happens when you go up against the $6 BILLION “trans lobby” and radical activist judges.They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees...They’re trying to break my spirit...But I refuse to ever stop fighting for my son... for truth... and for what’s right. Because I don’t want this to ever happen to another family.These radical LGBTQ+ doctors, lawyers and judges need to be stopped...They need to be held accountable...And **James** needs to be **saved** before he’s permanently butchered.That’s why I’m writing to you today.When Patriots Legal Defense Fund (PLDF) heard about my case, they immediately offered to stand with me and fight this insanity.PLDF has been on the frontlines defending innocent J6ers targeted by the Biden DOJ.And when they heard about my case, they told me they’d help in any way possible.The fact is, this transgender madness is affecting all of our children and grandchildren. It’s in their schools. In the books in their libraries. Pediatricians are asking five-year-olds if they “feel like they’re in the wrong body” during routine doctor visits.This is madness. And it’s got to stop.If you want to help save my son **James **from castration and make sure this will NEVER happen to ANY child ever again... And if you want to send a message to these radical judges that their day of reckoning has come... My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son James in the photo above.I’ve spent the last decade fighting tooth-and-nail to keep school counselors, my ex-wife, and activist judges from “transitioning” James against my will. # [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20250205-4737-footer&t=1&akid=4737%2E420207%2E32HKJQ)
Peter,
As the Trump administration ramps up their cruel and chaotic mass deportation plans, Pramila is doing everything she can to stand up for immigrant communities.
**That’s why she just introduced the _Access to Counsel Act_ in the House of Representatives** to ensure those with legal status who are detained at ports of entry can consult with an attorney to seek assistance.

Derek, Trump has begun his presidency with a historically low approval rating. And it’s no wonder why. Since he was inaugurated, he and his allies have begun enacting their extreme, dangerous Project 2025 agenda. So far, they have rescinded President Biden’s executive order to lower prescription drug costs for Americans on Medicare and Medicaid, pardoned more than 1,500 January 6 insurrectionists, and enacted tariffs against our allies that will raise the price of everyday goods – from groceries to fuel – for working families. This is just the beginning. That’s why right now is the time to dig deep and fight back. Here at the DNC, we are committed to building the long-term infrastructure we’ll need to elect Democrats at every level of government — leaders who will check Trump’s power in their cities, districts, and states. That’s why we’re reaching out today. Your donation today will be another dollar we can invest in state parties all over the country, in organizing against Trump’s worst policies, and ultimately in winning back Congress in 2026 and the White House in 2028. name: Huffines Liberty Foundation
subject: Make Texas Housing Affordable Again by Eliminating Regulatory Barriers and Costs
body:
In 2019, President Donald Trump issued an executive order to address the rising costs of housing.
No images? [Click here](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-e-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-z/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-r/) **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Press Manager
Contact: [Press@HuffinesLiberty.com](mailto:Press@HuffinesLiberty.com)
## **Make Texas Housing Affordable Again by Eliminating Regulatory Barriers and Costs**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-y/) DALLAS, TX, February 5, 2025 -- Today, the Huffines Liberty Foundation is releasing our latest solutions paper, [_Make Texas Housing Affordable Again by Eliminating Regulatory Barriers and Costs_](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-j/).**The Problem**
In 2019, President Donald Trump issued an [executive order](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-t/) to address the rising costs of housing. The order said, "Driving the rise in housing costs is a lack of housing supply to meet demand. Federal, State, local, and tribal governments impose a multitude of regulatory barriers--laws, regulations, and administrative practices--that hinder the development of housing." The order also identified many of the regulatory barriers, including: "overly restrictive zoning and growth management controls; rent controls; cumbersome building and rehabilitation codes; excessive energy and water efficiency mandates; unreasonable maximum-density allowances; historic preservation requirements; [and] overly burdensome wetland or environmental regulations."Texans are experiencing high housing costs. According to the Texas A&M Real Estate Center, [the median price of a Texas house](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-i/) in September 2024 was $339,000, up from $180,000 ten years ago and from $127,378 in 2004. A&M also reports that housing affordability has dropped significantly over the last decade.Some people seek to blame markets and investors for this. But the free market is not the problem. As acknowledged in President Trump's executive order, local, state, and federal governments are the number one cause of increasing housing prices because their regulations, fees, and taxes restrict the growth of the housing supply.Sometimes, this is because the bureaucracy of the 'deep state' local governments delays construction due to bureaucratic incompetence. Other times the delays are intentional as cities want to slow growth, sometimes because NIMBYism leads to pressure from some residents who do not want new, less expensive housing in the area. Federal inflationary and environmental policies also interfere in this process. Whatever the cause, when housing costs increase, housing affordability decreases.There should be an orderly, logical, and safe way to move forward and provide housing without the illogical responses that are driving local government policies. In fact, there is a way. It is called the free market, where buyers and sellers (builders and prospective homeowners) can get together and work out the various challenges associated with homeownership and expanding the housing stock. By removing the bureaucratic hurdles that limit housing stock and increase housing costs, Texas can significantly reduce the cost of living for Texans, including the high cost of housing.**The Solution**
If implemented by state and local policymakers, the following recommendations explained in Huffines Liberty Foundation's latest whitepaper, [_Make Texas Housing Affordable Again by Eliminating Regulatory Barriers and Costs_](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-h/) , would significantly reduce the cost of living for Texans, including the high cost of housing:
* Eliminate or Substantially Reduce Property Taxes
* Stop Runaway Local Government Spending Growth
* Reduce Land Use Restrictions, Building Codes, and Permitting Costs
* Close the Border
* Provide Local Residents More Opportunities to Hold Local Governments Accountable
* Deal with Federal Policies

[_Click here to read HLF's latest solutions paper._](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-k/) [Read / Share Solutions Paper](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-u/) The Huffines Liberty Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, non-partisan research institute. Our mission is to advance the cause of **liberty** , **prosperity** , and **virtue** in the State of Texas by educating and equipping citizens so they may hold their elected officials accountable and better informed to tackle the toughest challenges.### [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-o/)[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-b/)[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-n/) | [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-p/) | [ Share ](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-fb-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-v/) | [ Tweet ](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-tw-sddtjg-yuddtktydi-e/) | [ Forward ](https://huffineslibertyfoundation.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-yuddtktydi-17329976-sddtjg-l-s)

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: When we organize, we overcome / Cuando nos organizamos, superamos
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Celebrating the power of Black History this month and every month
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20BlackTOP%20BHM%202025.png]
Fearless innovators and change-makers. It’s who we inherently are as Black Americans, and no executive order or policy change will ever strip us of that fact. This Black History Month, we once again affirm how Black communities have been the cornerstone of our nation's rise, and how our excellence continues to drive its prosperity.
With the twice-impeached White House occupant ridiculously claiming that DEI is a threat to our country, it’s more important than ever that we set the record straight and call out this bigotry by centering Black voices and recognizing our vast contributions to this country — a country our ancestors built.
BlackTOP's work is rooted in building Black and Latino power by carving out an unapologetic Black lane that grounds us in our history — merging our imaginations with strategy to manifest our dreams. No matter the powers we are up against, organizing will always be our vehicle for change, with collective liberation forever being our primary objective.
This Black History Month, TOP is celebrating the lives, contributions, and sacrifices of our ancestors whose tenacity has shaped us into who we are today. We invite you to join our TOP Harris County staff and members for a special community event February 22 in Houston!
Click here for more details and to RSVP. [https://secure.everyaction.com/pvBZtP2eEk-fU8Jizpv2hA2]
TAKE ACTION:
Share "Know Your Rights" info to protect lives and keep families together
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/No%20more%20raids%20keep%20immigrants%20together.jpg]
In big cities across Texas and across the nation, protests and marches are taking shape [https://www.newsweek.com/protests-trumps-immigration-policies-erupt-country-2024913] , showing the humanity of our immigrant communities, and how the flame of our movement for migrant justice will never be extinguished.
In solidarity there is strength, and by sharing vital information about our fundamental rights (no matter your documentation status), we can inform the masses, protect lives, keep families together, and mitigate harm from Trump's mass deportation machine.
Emboldened by MAGA's white nationalism, ICE agents are quickly ramping up their raid operations. There are still ways how we can collectively blunt their harmful impact on our families and communities, though. [https://www.thenation.com/article/activism/chicago-ice-raids-resistance/]
ACCESS and SHARE these "know your rights" guides in English [https://organizetexas.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/English-KYR-ILRC.pdf] and Spanish [https://organizetexas.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Spanish-KYR-ILRC.pdf] from our allies at the Immigrant Legal Resource Center.
In conjunction with our immigration justice partners, TOP will continue to provide timely updates on MAGA's aggressive efforts to attack immigrant communities.
ADD YOUR NAME:
Speak up for tenants' rights in Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20action%20-%20Meadows%20at%20Ferguson.jpg]
The housing crisis in Dallas continues to worsen. Rent prices are rising faster than wages, evictions for some residents are happening without notice or cause, and housing instability is on the rise.
From collapsing ceilings due to water damage to routine water shutoffs, countless tenants are living with poor maintenance and broken promises from landlords — and many fear retaliation if they speak up. Despite this, current laws at the local and state levels offer little protection or support for renters. We're pushing for change!
TOP's housing justice organizing is rooted in our fundamental belief that housing is a human right, and that all in our communities deserve a safe, affordable, and stable place to call home — no matter our age, race, gender, faith, or income.
ADD YOUR NAME if you're a Dallas resident who agrees, and who wants to plug in to this vital campaign work. [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc7xt9JezgWm3pil3PMcC1HyJVOTPmsxZdMxZkerJcMqS02WQ/viewform]
For more information, email Iman at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tip: Be a more informed consumer! - Check out the political affiliations of brands and companies
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/indirectpoliticaldonations.jpg]
From grocery store runs to online clothing purchases, we have power as consumers through what goods and services we purchase and invest in. At a time when big name companies are caving to Trump and his billionaire MAGA buddies like never before, we have the ability to see in real time where these brands politically align with their corporate political donations. Use this free and easy online tool from Goods Unite Us. [https://www.goodsuniteus.com/]
Español
Celebrando el poder de la historia negra este mes y todos los meses
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20BlackTOP%20BHM%202025.png]
Innovadores valientes y creadores de cambios. Es lo que somos inherentemente como estadounidenses negros, y ninguna orden ejecutiva ni cambio de política nos privará jamás de ese hecho. Este Mes de la Historia Negra, reafirmamos una vez más cómo las comunidades negras han sido esencial del ascenso de nuestra nación, y cómo nuestra excelencia sigue impulsando su prosperidad.
Con el ocupante de la Casa Blanca, dos veces enjuiciado, afirmando ridículamente que la DEI es una amenaza para nuestro país, es más importante que nunca que aclaremos las cosas y denunciemos esta intolerancia poniendo en el centro las voces negras y reconociendo nuestras vastas contribuciones a este país, un país que construyeron nuestros antepasados.
El trabajo de BlackTOP se basa en la construcción del poder negro y latino al forjar un camino negro sin complejos que nos arraigue en nuestra historia, fusionando nuestra imaginación con la estrategia para manifestar nuestros sueños. Sin importar los poderes a los que nos enfrentemos, la organización siempre será nuestro vehículo para el cambio, y la liberación colectiva será siempre nuestro objetivo principal. Este Mes de la Historia Afroamericana, TOP celebra las vidas, las contribuciones y los sacrificios de nuestros antepasados cuya tenacidad nos ha convertido en quienes somos hoy. ¡Te invitamos a unirte a nuestro personal y miembros de TOP del condado de Harris para un evento comunitario especial el 22 de febrero en Houston!
Haz clic aquí para obtener más detalles y confirmar tu asistencia. [https://secure.everyaction.com/pvBZtP2eEk-fU8Jizpv2hA2]
ACTÚE AHORA:
Comparta la información de "Conozca sus derechos" para proteger vidas y mantener unidas a las familias
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/No%20more%20raids%20keep%20immigrants%20together.jpg]
En las grandes ciudades de Texas y de todo el país, las protestas y las marchas están tomando forma [https://www.newsweek.com/protests-trumps-immigration-policies-erupt-country-2024913] , mostrando la humanidad de nuestras comunidades inmigrantes y cómo la llama de nuestro movimiento por la justicia migratoria nunca se extinguirá.
La solidaridad hace la fuerza, y al compartir información vital sobre nuestros derechos fundamentales (sin importar el estatus migratorio), podemos informar a las masas, proteger vidas, mantener unidas a las familias y mitigar el daño de la máquina de deportación masiva de Trump.
Envalentonados por el nacionalismo blanco de MAGA, los agentes de ICE están aumentando rápidamente sus operaciones de redadas. Sin embargo, todavía hay formas en las que podemos mitigar colectivamente su impacto dañino en nuestras familias y comunidades. [https://www.thenation.com/article/activism/chicago-ice-raids-resistance/]
ACCEDA y COMPARTA estas guías de "conozca sus derechos" en inglés [https://organizetexas.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/English-KYR-ILRC.pdf] y español [https://organizetexas.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Spanish-KYR-ILRC.pdf] de nuestros aliados en el Centro de Recursos Legales para Inmigrantes.
Junto con nuestros socios de justicia migratoria, TOP seguirá brindando actualizaciones oportunas sobre los esfuerzos agresivos de MAGA para atacar a las comunidades inmigrantes.
FIRMA AHORA:
Defiende los derechos de los inquilinos en Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20action%20-%20Meadows%20at%20Ferguson.jpg]
La campaña de TOP por la justicia en la vivienda en el condado de Dallas quiere saber de USTED mientras buscamos tener un mayor impacto y lograr un cambio más positivo en 2025.
Las leyes actuales a nivel local y estatal ofrecen poca protección o apoyo a los inquilinos. Estamos presionando para que se produzca un cambio, porque nuestra organización por la justicia en la vivienda se basa en la creencia fundamental de que la vivienda es un derecho humano.
Además, AGREGUE SU NOMBRE aquí si es un residente de Dallas que está de acuerdo en que todos en nuestras comunidades merecen un lugar seguro, asequible y estable al que llamar hogar, sin importar nuestra edad, raza, género, fe o ingreso [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc7xt9JezgWm3pil3PMcC1HyJVOTPmsxZdMxZkerJcMqS02WQ/viewform] s.
Para obtener más información, comuníquese con Iman a ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
Consejos de TOP: Sea un consumidor más informado: consulte las afiliaciones políticas de las marcas y empresas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/indirectpoliticaldonations.jpg]
Desde las compras en el supermercado hasta las compras de ropa en línea, tenemos poder como consumidores a través de los bienes y servicios que compramos y en los que invertimos. En un momento en el que las grandes empresas se están rindiendo ante Trump y sus multimillonarios amigos del MAGA como nunca antes, tenemos la capacidad de ver en tiempo real dónde se alinean políticamente estas marcas con sus donaciones políticas corporativas. name: Kyle Rittenhouse
subject: It’s time to go on the offensive.
body:
I never asked to be thrown into national politics. I wanted to be a paramedic or a cop and live a normal life.

|
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zitln64qi2ea4j4kbev143mc5r6e4df9jvnoick0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs "Tuttle Twins")
Friend,

I never asked to be thrown into national politics. I wanted to be a paramedic or a cop and live a normal life.

However, all that changed when I lawfully defended myself during a BLM riot.

My life was thrown upside down. I had Biden using my image in his ads, saying I was a white supremacist. I had the national media lying about me. I had strangers online cursing at me and even sending me death threats.

This is all detailed in my new book, _Acquitted_.

**_I’ve accepted my life is different now. But I will not accept leaving the fate of our country to radical leftists who want to destroy American values of liberty_.**

This is personal for me.

We must take back our universities and go on the offensive against the woke mobs who control them.

My friend JP Kirby started a youth organization called Student Rights Inc. They have a strategy to battle woke campus administrators, defend the freedom of speech of students, and promote Constitutional rights at colleges.

Students Rights Inc. incorporates the Freedom Method strategy to defend student rights on campus. More on that below. But first, here’s how you can help them lead the students who are fighting back on campus. [I gave JP my word that I would help him raise $38,000 online. As a personal favor to me, can you donate $10, $35, or even $100 today to Student Rights Inc.?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp0rip6qs8vm04bnnqt9rv56fouqe9ne79mhahmg_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)
[Donate $10](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjps8fko1fuqgof6oc70arrq43bltru3o84qqjjo_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)

[Donate $35](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn0c497j904mgt50g8dltnfn448oj80bmr1d4ks0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)

[Donate $50](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za4c8eo2aqdpnpmuid16n92fhej434bcve7dj6b0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)

[Donate $100](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zommtu33ot30vlli8jrlk8vcjng6tc6967tv4lmg_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)

[Donate $250](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z66d5m935rvej6lc10c4dfcmekl5h5majqlogbdo_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)

[Other Amount](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmbcvgb8cgrnk24jqa6fgulrjppko4dv6ea2v8so_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)
**How to defend student rights on campus: the Freedom Method.**

**STEP 1:** Student Rights Inc. identifies campus policies that violate students’ constitutional rights.

These can be anything from speech codes restricting what students can say and where they can say it. Or it can even be gun policies that prohibit self-defense on campus. Or, lately, it can be medical policies like forced COVID vaccine requirements.

**STEP 2:** Student Rights Inc. gives the freedom-loving students on campus the training to build an opposition movement.

Through the Freedom Method curriculum developed during JP’s years of policy change work as well as personalized coaching, Student Rights Inc. teaches students to win over their classmates, build coalitions with campus groups, and spread the movement on their campuses.

**STEP 3:** This one is the fun part. Student Rights Inc. activists go after the campus administrators!

SRInc activists unleash the coalition of student activists they’ve built on the campus bureaucrats who are restricting their rights. SRInc guides its activists through using the tools of political change such as phone banking, organized protests, media pressure, and much more until the administration removes the restrictions on their rights.

Students desperately need our help on college campuses.

Let’s not leave them to defend themselves against the woke mobs.

[Please send your urgent support today to help us raise $38,000 before the end of the month to defend student rights on college campuses.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpslfbt3crnsbm8eij4npch86o7vdfoph77avi28_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)

[Donate $50](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf5c9feo66ldat43udau7keo0d86gk6lb16vgee8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)

[Donate $100](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z04co7n8co70jth34bd2ucf5t985kkcl14aoodp0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)

[Donate $250](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv374595q65c8v30jvaajhkruq7tlppsu07fudm0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)

[Other Amount](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj5psf9itjbi3am2basbhe14gq66eul68l10d9mo_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm2p36cdh2bs)
With Harvard’s president resigning in disgrace, this is a year where conservatives can go on the offense. We have the opportunity to reclaim our institutions from the radical left.

Student Rights Inc. doesn’t have George Soros billionaires funding them. They don’t have the media on their side. They rely on your support, which is why I am asking you to chip in any amount you can generously spare.

Thank you,

Kyle Rittenhouse

P.S. Students need help on campus defending their constitutional rights. I am looking to raise $38,000 for Student Rights Inc. to help them sue and remove unconstitutional policies at universities. There is no organization on Earth that I abhor more than the Central Intelligence Agency, with the possible exception of Congress. The [CIA's criminal trail](https://substack.com/redirect/b3d30568-cfad-48f9-a2fd-0d2d370e2515?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has encompassed coups d'etat and assassinations by the dozens, and a [torture policy](https://substack.com/redirect/640cc6e6-dd47-4098-88f4-9f30fea0cc4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that enabled [murder and rape](https://substack.com/redirect/f10faa28-3501-4d66-a5e1-4fe6e9dfcf9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for which no one was ever held accountable.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/81dc7240-f524-44f7-baa8-4a9b9455f95d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Now, the entire CIA is [reportedly getting purged](https://substack.com/redirect/1b04dc23-698a-4154-be12-2119e55185a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--by an incoming president whose own history is replete with criminal offenses, fraud, sexual coercion, and every manner of mendacity and tackiness imaginable.
[Even a stopped clock is right twice a day](https://substack.com/redirect/72505e7f-d76b-48e2-8f04-7db01f36e403?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)!

### **Out of the frying pan, into the fire?**
Trump's outrageous announcement that he plans to turn Gaza into "the [Riviera of the Middle East](https://substack.com/redirect/36f19e53-8933-441e-9c30-87d6ffa08b35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" suggests that whoever he finds to staff the soon-to-be-reconstituted CIA will likely be only worse than the criminals who preceded them.
When Trump first came to the White House in 2017, [one of his first official speeches](https://substack.com/redirect/ed9ef4c7-b58d-4560-b874-9771a7fe248b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was at the CIA headquarters, where he pledged to turn the Agency loose:
> The old expression, "to the victor belong the spoils" \-- you remember. I always used to say, keep the oil. I wasn't a fan of Iraq. I didn't want to go into Iraq. But I will tell you, when we were in, we got out wrong. And I always said, in addition to that, keep the oil....
> I believe that this group is going to be one of the most important groups in this country toward making us safe, toward making us winners again, toward ending all of the problems....I can only say that I am with you 1,000 percent.
> And the reason you're my first stop is that, as you know, I have a running war with the media. They are among the most dishonest human beings on Earth. (Laughter and applause.) And they sort of made it sound like I had a feud with the intelligence community. And I just want to let you know, the reason you're the number-one stop is exactly the opposite -- exactly.
Given Trump's sensibilities in that speech, or his manic aspirations to annex Greenland and Panama, there is no reason to think that whoever replaces the current batch of CIA criminals is likely to be any better.
### When time moves backward
We are living through the retrogression of history, and the abandonment of international human rights outright by the country that once pioneered their development.
As [I've written before](https://open.substack.com/pub/shahidbuttar/p/strap-in?r=97w99&utm_medium=ios), Trump's belligerence and mendacity represent not so much a change from the previous baseline, so much as a [revelation](https://open.substack.com/pub/shahidbuttar/p/from-new-york-to-los-angeles?r=97w99&utm_medium=ios) of a pattern that too many observers--particularly gullible journalists and complicit policymakers--have indulged for the last three generations.
Might makes right. That principle defined the era of colonialism, as well as the [genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/8bd46ce4-07af-412f-85da-cb4e5eaedeca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that created the United States. It continues to define the era of American exceptionalism.
Gaza may have weathered the storm of the Israeli genocide, only to now confront an even more overwhelming force in Washington under Trump's so-called leadership. The possibility of coerced expulsion at the hands of America's military is a terrifying possibility--and nothing is poised to stop it (or whatever will come next), [unless](https://substack.com/redirect/23378117-ed16-45f5-a7ee-01a5de51639b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the labor movement rediscovers the meaning of solidarity and the capacity to demonstrate it.
Forced expulsion is an international human rights violation, and also a defining element of genocide--of which the U.S. has long been [guilty](https://substack.com/redirect/8bd46ce4-07af-412f-85da-cb4e5eaedeca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). While the repetition of those gruesome crimes offers a dangerous omen for the future, I find no small measure of solace knowing that at least the last batch of war criminals at the CIA will observe that future without a chance to influence it any further.

name: Kyle Rittenhouse
subject: It’s time to go on the offensive.
body:
I never asked to be thrown into national politics. I wanted to be a paramedic or a cop and live a normal life.

|
---
| | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znoo03ea7kr15sb0br6ac9etvuthud3qputeudn8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm6o74c5h2bs "Tuttle Twins")
Friend,

I never asked to be thrown into national politics. I wanted to be a paramedic or a cop and live a normal life.

However, all that changed when I lawfully defended myself during a BLM riot.

My life was thrown upside down. I had Biden using my image in his ads, saying I was a white supremacist. I had the national media lying about me. I had strangers online cursing at me and even sending me death threats.

This is all detailed in my new book, _Acquitted_.

**_I’ve accepted my life is different now. But I will not accept leaving the fate of our country to radical leftists who want to destroy American values of liberty_.**

This is personal for me.

We must take back our universities and go on the offensive against the woke mobs who control them.

My friend JP Kirby started a youth organization called Student Rights Inc. They have a strategy to battle woke campus administrators, defend the freedom of speech of students, and promote Constitutional rights at colleges.

Students Rights Inc. incorporates the Freedom Method strategy to defend student rights on campus. More on that below. But first, here’s how you can help them lead the students who are fighting back on campus. [I gave JP my word that I would help him raise $38,000 online. As a personal favor to me, can you donate $10, $35, or even $100 today to Student Rights Inc.?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zht4fd9qs832rd9co2c6evrdu5m9aobk04irnke0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm6o74c5h2bs)

[Donate $50](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zd67oh1hu7eafppjfotr9ivk7l524l4btt5a47a0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm6o74c5h2bs)

[Donate $100](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7h629fjfuv83slaghrspv162jshfccsjthhv8po_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm6o74c5h2bs)

[Donate $250](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z12nt8aka56gim8e42hbej124d73grbejo164efo_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm6o74c5h2bs)

[Other Amount](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ztn4s54gkg51hk9gifrehrmriars7fuco1aabm0o_rp22sh2s8i6epj0s3gm6o74c5h2bs)
**How to defend student rights on campus: the Freedom Method.**

**STEP 1:** Student Rights Inc. identifies campus policies that violate students’ constitutional rights.

These can be anything from speech codes restricting what students can say and where they can say it. Or it can even be gun policies that prohibit self-defense on campus. Or, lately, it can be medical policies like forced COVID vaccine requirements.

**STEP 2:** Student Rights Inc. gives the freedom-loving students on campus the training to build an opposition movement.

Through the Freedom Method curriculum developed during JP’s years of policy change work as well as personalized coaching, Student Rights Inc. teaches students to win over their classmates, build coalitions with campus groups, and spread the movement on their campuses.

**STEP 3:** This one is the fun part. Student Rights Inc. activists go after the campus administrators!

SRInc activists unleash the coalition of student activists they’ve built on the campus bureaucrats who are restricting their rights. SRInc guides its activists through using the tools of political change such as phone banking, organized protests, media pressure, and much more until the administration removes the restrictions on their rights.

Students desperately need our help on college campuses.

Let’s not leave them to defend themselves against the woke mobs.

Demanding Answers on Paid Family Medical Leave (PFML) On Tuesday, I participated in a briefing from the Department of Labor Commissioner on the status of Paid Family Medical Leave and the impact it will have on everyday Mainers. I posted some of the exchanges on my Facebook page, including questions about existing prepaid premiums, guardrails for individuals filing while working multiple jobs, and the ever-changing fiscal burden of over $25M. Reacting to Proposed Tariffs The Maine Wire shared a video of my reaction to the misleading statement Gov. Mills distributed regarding the tariffs on Canada this week. Her statement reads: "I am deeply concerned that President Trump's tariffs, especially those on Canada, will increase prices for Maine people, especially at a time when they can least afford it." That's quite a departure from what I heard the Governor say last week during her State of the State address, where she proposed tariffs on goods and services--in the form of new taxes--on our income, pensions, cannabis, cigarettes, ambulances, streaming services, and prescription drugs. Mike Soboleski Rep. Mike Soboleski Proudly Serving House District 73 | | Demanding Answers on Paid Family Medical Leave (PFML) On Tuesday, I participated in a briefing from the Department of Labor Commissioner on the status of Paid Family Medical Leave and the impact it will have on everyday Mainers. I posted some of the exchanges on my Facebook page, including questions about existing prepaid premiums, guardrails for individuals filing while working multiple jobs, and the ever-changing fiscal burden of over $25M. == | Reacting to Proposed Tariffs The Maine Wire shared a video of my reaction to the misleading statement Gov. Mills distributed regarding the tariffs on Canada this week. Her statement reads: "I am deeply concerned that President Trump's tariffs, especially those on Canada, will increase prices for Maine people, especially at a time when they can least afford it." That's quite a departure from what I heard the Governor say last week during her State of the State address, where she proposed tariffs on goods and services--in the form of new taxes--on our income, pensions, cannabis, cigarettes, ambulances, streaming services, and prescription drugs. == | Governor's State of the Budget Address I shared three videos on the night of the State of the State Address, highlighting what I was listening for and what we should expect from legislative Democrats this session. == page (and ==) for the latest from Augusta. | | | In Case You Missed It: Rep. Soboleski: It is Time for Maine's Leaders to Join the Effort to End Mass Illegal Immigration. As the new year begins, elected officials at all levels of government, from the president of the United States to small town mayors, will be placing their hands on family bibles and reciting their oaths of office. In addition to the prescribed oath that each of us in elected office takes, we might consider one more as we assume the responsibility of serving the people who elected us: A Hippocratic Oath for politicians that begins with, "First, do no harm." For years, irresponsible immigration policies have been inflicting harm on large segments of the American public. During the past four years, under the outgoing Biden-Harris administration, out-of-control illegal immigration and rampant abuse of our asylum system have caused catastrophic damage to people and communities across the country. Here in Maine, the damage has been compounded by state and local policies that harm the vital interests of our citizens. Maine is not officially a sanctuary state, but it might as well be one. Beginning in her first year in office, Gov. Janet Mills has done everything in her power to make Maine a magnet for illegal immigrants. In 2019, her administration rewrote the eligibility rules for Maine's General Assistance (GA) voucher to include asylum seekers (some== of which are without merit). ==, these "vouchers [may be] used to purchase basic items like food, medications, housing, and other essential services." The effect of this rule change was almost immediate. The combined state and local== jumped from $13 million in 2019 to $43 million in 2023 (even after the impact of the COVID crisis had largely abated). Equally as harmful and irresponsible are policies adopted by local governments across our state. Perhaps none is more egregious than that of South Portland, a town of about 27,000 residents, where the city council approved $1.8 million in welfare == while homeowners have seen hikes in their property tax bills by as much as ==. When confronted by elderly homeowners worried that they might not be able to remain in their homes, while city spends lavishly on migrants, == that they consider reverse mortgages. While senior citizens are being asked to tap the equity in their homes to pay for state and local policies that encourage illegal immigration to our state, our children are being asked to sacrifice their educations. In Lewiston, schools that have been overwhelmed by the influx of illegal aliens have reached a point where they can neither educate nor ensure the safety of the students. According to Stephanie Poulin, the social worker at the city's ==, "You have children that are getting no education, but are being traumatized every day and that is disgusting." Despite the mounting fiscal and social burdens being imposed on Mainers because of the state's welcome mat for illegal aliens, Gov. Mills and other sanctuary politicians remain intent on making these problems worse. The governor has set a goal of welcoming == to our state (regardless of whether they are here legally or illegally) by 2029. Meanwhile other state and local leaders are gearing up to fight efforts by the incoming Trump administration to remove illegal aliens who should not be here. President-elect Trump's Border Czar, Tom Homan, has said he will begin arresting and deporting illegal aliens on Day One of the new administration, and will prioritize the removal of criminals and the 1.4 million people who have already been issued final orders of deportation. Nevertheless, some Maine officials are vowing to resist. Within days of Trump being declared the winner, the Portland Public School Board of Education convened to formulate == whom they claim are "under attack." The board pledged that no district resources would be used "for the purpose of detecting or assisting in the apprehension" of individuals whose "only violation of law" is residing in the U.S. illegally - even though the school system is committing == to the growing number of migrant children, speaking a wide-range of languages, who have entered Portland schools over the past few years. Such policies are not only ill-considered and further sacrifice the interests and security of Mainers; they are also patently illegal. The America First Legal Foundation, a group closely aligned with President-elect Trump, has put == that they could face serious consequences for obstructing efforts to enforce immigration laws. The letter warns that it is "a crime to conceal, harbor or shield" illegal aliens who are being sought by the federal government, as is impeding such efforts. Our commitment to the people of Maine must go beyond merely pledging to do no further harm. We must now endeavor to undo the damage that has already been done. | | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

To help you learn more about Lewis, we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/s/c/7rWGo785U4Mln1e9J1BhnMSFB59J92w_Pu16ph-mJ7HRfPFxfWug7lqU_Xrjq7lZmls3IR4ulAwDIsd9yO1oJCD275ZuaL4Rlg9qeH0yQA8JBDc9Lhfjo6dbBRdQp_rIEp9zUBmLGq0JMSqGAetxnxwSzZmBZnF2b7dIRPN-nZoUbR9HMjV9ue7VpNMl7TL6rgjxZPZnAuv1IoZEQpcFXOXIrGsuCBdX1pWYytLzm-IRdIgWPFkNzXXrwgOiiNJKmD8NhFnYURzQtHgdWEevi0Hh9jHR6WMLejpL_4qrBQDtrcyPlHCPbefN6G9dU9-bCAuW9WvjJO0FLGANUsQew0KK3AJ_3Y-2oEFYJrUf2L-fDNdxQCUW1NZN89BmYMli7JVza_pkW-vk-eQy8ZS04DLW_q9NSQuvhV6EBRiNxyA9GgBL4pTS5QwZVRc3V4Bd0CXG1EptU69lp2ExMFgrVwXKBfAHemDYv_pInQWy3ka9IwFXENc/0p3hUDrNGdHGCtk-K0WcER1cBJePFVc7/5)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

The instructor, Dr. Michael Ward, is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/s/c/fi4vlafjezpQjVGo7daOkLY5Rr0NBt5xjhxwxgQEqc5xRw6iz3a785O8Rl8A_RliofTr8qzuu-aXQgB1zaIWCpv3ZZ1p6QeMHiGbB3oO_zoyf6B5q8S6uZPvrcrLxDgoxjEESKUQ9HOBqsRYM1eZU7xeepJH7ofULtvV18eoZuebVNRTo9TyskO8HPspjweeYErHe-9IsIGPHpQj2luHwwZR9UEqV134NcliXVSyZO2Vg30_wktiHU1zYGaufgL6sVVpIbUjeY_cTPXGAGrg6wcRjOmbfu9gt4gUJnmGiZXSugnzwTRDejoyc73BWCNEiqO3pO-_b0vb2EYVhudlKuXjCxmeZbdkNkvZF4mmYfB5hg8DEGR9cz_FObBV7FbJX6lPu5vDE8AxRQ9jQj50ce5GscMvoDkWYY9lIw1ARTqWjhHGwzmODBDanVY55qGIB8DEMG0pBROv5uPPcoyZ5CYdQZauluc7TnJfiqY0E2jidMV5VsY/JgBkaaMejzinhx-3CwEwYjY-N_O4utEd/5).

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D.

# [“Keep Calm and Carry On” posters were never actually released during WWII.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sr9g94&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [World History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sr9g94&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sr9g94&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| “K eep Calm and Carry On” posters and their [variants](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sr9g94&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) have become ubiquitous over the last two decades, a symbol of the United Kingdom’s stoic resilience during World War II. But while more than 2 million posters were printed by the Ministry of Information in the leadup to World War II, they were [never officially released](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sr9g94&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) during the actual conflict. [Two other slogan posters](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sr9g94&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) were designed in the same style, neither of which has achieved the same prominence despite being seen by far more people during the war. They were: “Your Courage, Your Cheerfulness, Your Resolution — Will Bring Us Victory” and “Freedom Is in Peril; Defend It with All Your Might.”
---
The “Keep Calm and Carry On” posters were meant to be held in reserve until the situation grew especially dire and the public needed a morale boost, but officials**** found the other designs effective enough on their own. It wasn’t until the owner of a bookstore in Alnwick, Northumberland, found a batch of “Keep Calm” posters in a box of secondhand books he’d won that the posters achieved their current fame. The bookseller framed one in his shop, and it drew so much attention from the public that he began selling copies.

## The bestselling poster in history is Farrah Fawcett in a red swimsuit.
Even if you didn’t have one on your bedroom wall growing up, you’ve surely seen it: _Charlie’s Angels_ star Farrah Fawcett in a red swimsuit, smiling at the camera in profile. The [iconic poster](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sr9g94&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) was released in 1976, selling more than 6 million copies in its first year at the modest price of $3. More than 12 million total have been sold, making it the bestselling poster of all time and an enduring symbol of the 1970s. A copy of the poster, and the swimsuit itself, can now be found in the Smithsonian’s National Museum of American History.

**Good morning!** On this day in 1860, the Galveston, Houston and Henderson Railroad completed a 10,000-foot bridge from [Virginia Point](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FuwyAQgOGngc0WHBDHA0MXb-na0Tqbwz6VQIRRnLx91e59gf_X93Wbb8iJ8_aJd_LtFcsMClynoFOXOSCn92xl8IsKo5bk9WCuV-u0cXL3Li5uVbAQRhrBhrha0utoRlQxKCTJ_jemQF00wGBMT3YEDWGNNAzBoRZWUeBWat92avTCI6Z3eVLt13KXye-tPQ5hPgRMAqbzPPt27Fhy4kx9qZuAacccllK-BUyUW2U6BExPrhtnxu5ROLeuvWT14XFySnxcBmHVdkdOf5P2r_rp4ScAAP__e_9cKQ) to Galveston Island. The bridge was destroyed by a hurricane in 1867, as were several subsequent bridges. Virginia Point was abandoned in the 1950s. Today, it can only be reached during low tide by a shell road where the old causeway previously stood. ## School Choice Proposal Passes Senate
The Texas Senate approved a measure Wednesday that would [provide $1 billion for eligible families](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7uOwyAUBb8GOiy45uEUFNu4y7ZbWjwuMRIxkWFj5-9XSb_9OTOan-tydbnk7fbt7mj7meoCHBTjwLheosvltUgarefxIihaYcZpkkqMiq5WeedBhAm0C4krjXES4H0SRkaMSdNs3zAOXAsAM44DygsIiCGhMVE5QSTHmHvdh75ix9O1VF71ifsQ6p0Wu_b-aGT8IjATmI_jGFI9jfttPW_vCYF5w6MRmD9n1sJaa2FhrTkgi-hdR-bxlrfGGm6uI91tfBy5lNy0IZLf7i6Xj63_m_-08BcAAP__gNpfDw) to pay for private school tuition or expenses associated with homeschooling. The bill advances a proposal that Gov. Greg Abbott and Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick have marked as a legislative priority and tried to enact for years. [Senate Bill 2](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L9u6yAcxfGngS0IfmD-DAw3iqw7JB2aoaNFgDiouFiGuvbbV8ne_aNzpO_HZbi4lNPX-OamaNt2LwNQ6A4UDlQOwaW8DwIHe6PBMBwtU1xr0THe4Ye9Ga6lMZp2wikmQDLFvNJBaK-9YDec7HOMApUMQHFOojDAIPh7VCp0jiFBY0itLKQ9Youbq_e8lzUuxJcJZ_toba6I_0PQI-i9m1MrmbwgGcuKoD-mnM-lfH7PCPr_qbay7MTVeUO8P8fxGmtF_KTNOwL5tIifrkfAiw3zT8o5VamQoOPkUn59tj8jrBZ-AwAA__-3Kl0I) advanced to the House by a 19-12 vote, with every Democrat and one Republican opposing the measure. The legislation establishes education savings accounts of up to $11,500 a year for families with an income less than 500% of the federal poverty level, with 80% of the funding prioritized for low-income families and students with disabilities. Democrats [opposed the bill](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOpDAQRL_GZD2y24BnAweTcNFecsGFI4MbaKmxEfYyy9-fZvPLSirVU-n9_Xx-BhZOy--wka_fc36ixg40gu6fMbBcz7aJftTxwzTkjbP3e9sZ2zWr7w2FcY7urufYjuRcb6zBMI9d69DavmH_hmnUvUF01t6o_UCDcZrJudgFo1pNkWs-bnWlSt-hzHLlk47blLdG_FrrXpR9KBwUDq_X67aV9O4UDpTgqygc9ixceXrH5T1NG6WqcPjBQaEUKsHCJxXgxJWDQNj3I59BoGYo05qzwLRmnghGFoGcQMKxkFywh6NeIJwIzlxJ4RAOeDzM9fVL_jSHj_uLRbj0TrV62QLLz_P6X5Wnx38BAAD__6tNecI). They contend it would primarily benefit wealthy families and divert tax dollars from public schools to private institutions that aren’t regulated to the same degree. Republicans, on the other hand, said it empowers families to choose the education that’s best for their children, spurs competition, and incentivizes the establishment of new private schools. Gov. Abbott designated the legislation as an emergency item during his State of the State address on Sunday, making it eligible for consideration during the first 60 days of the 140-day session, which began Jan. 14. The bill faces an uncertain future in the House, where a similar proposal was killed two years ago.
## Nuclear Power Companies Partner with Texas A&M
Four companies have agreed to [build small modular nuclear reactors](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LHO4yAQBOCnwR0WLGCSguIad7n2SmuBJUGH7QhInLz9r6T_qylG-jSaf5flgrnk7foXV3L9lfYFBBgugItpiZjLe9FDdF7EsxzISatOJ22kMsPNAdLJK6tDImNiUhPYKM8arUc7pSSH7D6YADFJAKvUSPoMEmJIZG00KJkWFHPf69hv1OmFLZX3_qQ6hn0dirv1fm9M_WEwM5iP4xj_B9r681MzmLH2HAoxmEtOn_gSHFfe3q3TyveUqDZecIs87Osdt0yN-0cukW-PUAgrr4Sh77UxmI0QHAN5Hwi5MHbimiJw9KC4V6SSFJaCSkN18X7kUnKbLNPiumIu38n91w-fDn4CAAD__8GYdGE) at Texas A&M University’s 2,400-acre RELLIS campus in Bryan. The project, dubbed “The Energy Proving Ground,” could eventually provide up to one gigawatt of electricity to the Texas power grid, with the first reactors coming online in as soon as five years. The CEOs of the four companies—Kairos Power, Natura Resources, Terrestrial Energy, and Aalo Atomics—joined Chancellor John Sharp on Tuesday to [announce the project](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD3PrCAQhX-NdmNgwK-CYhubm_e2WxoWRpdcFAO4rv_-Rvu3mkme5Dkn5_kz_mjn3Tr_1Qup_J3CiAxrYAisGa12_hxladWL2Z6XpHgruk7WXNTlWxFHKXg3vQQKZhorXhZ720uriaam7UqnLhlD1nDEVoiKZI8crZmobW2teSEZWZdDrPKbMn11mvwZPhQrE5bSq3fOWyrEo8ChwOE4jmpJ68UKHGiFPRU4rHRc5_7pa_ye3IfgloGGBTZn_iWQYMKy6dVRghzA0ubDCWbP2a0zkJ0J1t140hEiaZNDTKAzRPLeJTB62e4AHeHx4Gd4_ollVHY73MWbtpBsXrTzd-_865Afhf8DAAD__1hMeHU). “ _We plan to showcase how our technology can address the energy needs of Texas and the nation_ ,” said Natura Resources founder and CEO Douglass Robison. A [statement from the university](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GO8yAQBOCngQ4LFmziguJv3OVvr7QWsyRIECJDcvHbn3z9NVONvtF8Xdcrppwet_9YyPVPrCtIGIUEIac1YMrHanhwXoZZcXLK6svFjEqP_O589LPxAHGOUW8w-SkG9KONaKUCDTy5E5MgJwVgtR7IzKAgbJGsDSMqZiSF1Os-9Dt1-mCL-ahv2oetFp7dvfdnY_ofg4XB0mvAY-hYXgOFF4Pl1BksEs4wZ-MkBBbRjtapiFulJh6vLRPuDBa-u_D8TjmnNllm5K1gyr9T_c_vbwc_AQAA__8SsVp1) said the project would “set the stage for deploying small nuclear reactors across the country.” University officials have already submitted applications to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission for commercial electrical and thermal power generation facilities.
## Eight Texas Cities among Safest in U.S.
Eight Texas cities ranked among the [top 50 safest cities](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOwyAQBNCvwR0WrME4BcU17nLtlRZnlmQVbCKzieO_PyX9VdOM3kjzc57OgTKtl--woOdXKhMosFKBVP0UA-VjMk30vyqedINeu24YjNWdba4eEaJNqIzSZkgOBtsb0EabeTiZlFJD_o0pUL0GcF3XojmBhjgndC7aoIVRGInL1vIVGV-hpnyUJ27tXJYm-yvzvYruS8AoYNz3vU3l5cKjMq3vioBxxb0KGLfyWKPcynyTH0fWkJCPT1SWMzFhlZkqy6WseFwQb83m432nnKn2Thh1WQLlzzL_e8XTw18AAAD__2oJYvg) in the U.S., according to an annual analysis by financial services broker MoneyGeek. Frisco ranked No. 2 overall, with a violent crime rate of 86 per 100,000 residents and a crime cost per capita of $287. Nearby Plano was No. 18 overall, while Pearland was No. 13, with a violent crime rate of 106 and a crime cost per capita of $471. Sugar Land (20), McKinney (22), Round Rock (26), Grand Prairie (42), and League City (48) were also among the safest cities in the country. San Antonio (222), Dallas (248), and Houston (250) ranked in the bottom third, while Austin came in at No. 162. The analysis examined 2023 crime data reported to the FBI for 292 U.S. cities with populations of at least 100,000. [See the full dataset here](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7uO6yAUheGngc4WbG52QXEadzntlBaGjY0Gh8gwcfz2o6SfcklLn_R_3eabSznd1_9uR9tesczAQHUMOqbn4FK-ZkmDXVgYOUXLjRgGqbhQdLNaeRmZ04viKg6SG3DR6xGidiLGZaHJvjEGTHMAI0SPcgQOwUc0JijHiWQYUitH3zZs-HI15qs88eh92Wm2W2uPSsQ_AhOB6TzPfi93vFbE7_eDwHRgLT-Hx0pgqi5ibZ1PLX02PWx4nCnnVLUhkq27S_kjtz9TnxZ-AwAA___U9lb_).

East Africa has just endured its worst drought in 40 years, leaving tens of millions without access to clean water, wiping out millions of livestock, and destroying crops. With domestic food production crippled, Somalia has relied heavily on imports—90% of its wheat coming from Russia and Ukraine—until those shipments stopped. Now, two in five children in Somalia suffer from acute malnutrition, and cholera is spreading in some regions. The food crisis, compounded by global humanitarian aid being redirected to Europe and the Middle East, has created a perfect storm, leading to a sharp rise in child malnutrition. **[Be Doers](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z8FqwyAYAOCn0VuD_sbaHDzsEgajYawbOwajv0YwMRhJ27cf230v8MH3fR2vJqa4hsEsqOvD5xEYyBODEzuPzsT0HFvq9MRcxylqrsTl0kouJJ21F2CxU6iMBId-kt4pixfJcMJOuolG_YsxYGcOoIRosO2Ag7MelXLScNIydLHm0tQZKz7M7tMzH1gamxea9FzrthPxQqAn0Id4xDU091ySs3m1WNYml0Cg30xAAn3_Nbx_3N5un8MrLdpt95hS3M-KtCwsJqY_tf7bPDT8BAAA___mGVWa)** We’re asking the Flyover Community to join us in partnering with World Concern to help get emergency nutrition packs (a peanut paste fortified with nutrients), water, and hygiene products to those with the most need. Every $12 feeds a child for a month. Dan Patrick have marked as a legislative priority and tried to enact for years. advanced to the House by a 19-12 vote, with every Democrat and one Republican opposing the measure. The legislation establishes education savings accounts of up to $11,500 a year for families with an income less than 500% of the federal poverty level, with 80% of the funding prioritized for low-income families and students with disabilities. Democrats . They contend it would primarily benefit wealthy families and divert tax dollars from public schools to private institutions that aren’t regulated to the same degree. Republicans, on the other hand, said it empowers families to choose the education that’s best for their children, spurs competition, and incentivizes the establishment of new private schools. Gov. Abbott designated the legislation as an emergency item during his State of the State address on Sunday, making it eligible for consideration during the first 60 days of the 140-day session, which began Jan. 14. The bill faces an uncertain future in the House, where a similar proposal was killed two years ago. Nuclear Power Companies Partner with Texas A&M Four companies have agreed to at Texas A&M University’s 2,400-acre RELLIS campus in Bryan. The project, dubbed “The Energy Proving Ground,” could eventually provide up to one gigawatt of electricity to the Texas power grid, with the first reactors coming online in as soon as five years. A said the project would “set the stage for deploying small nuclear reactors across the country.” University officials have already submitted applications to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission for commercial electrical and thermal power generation facilities. Eight Texas Cities among Safest in U.S. Eight Texas cities ranked among the in the U.S., according to an annual analysis by financial services broker MoneyGeek. Frisco ranked No. 2 overall, with a violent crime rate of 86 per 100,000 residents and a crime cost per capita of $287. Nearby Plano was No. 18 overall, while Pearland was No. 13, with a violent crime rate of 106 and a crime cost per capita of $471. Sugar Land (20), McKinney (22), Round Rock (26), Grand Prairie (42), and League City (48) were also among the safest cities in the country. San Antonio (222), Dallas (248), and Houston (250) ranked in the bottom third, while Austin came in at No. 162. name: Dominic Rapini
subject: Fredrick Douglass - The Anti DEI Hero of our Republic
body:
Victor vs Victimhood

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/449e4f49d70c/when-we-vote-we-win-14761974?e=8763c56857)
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
| | | | | “You are not judged by the height you have risen, but by the depth you have climbed.”
* Fredrick Douglass

---
|
---
|
**A Nation of Victors, Not Victims:**
_**What Fredrick Douglass**_ _**Taught us about DEI**_
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| _**By Dominic Rapini, American Businessman and Political Commentator**_
In the spirit of Frederick Douglass, the self-liberated man who defied every chain meant to hold him down, I find myself grappling with the modern ideology of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI). It is not that the concept of equity is inherently flawed, nor that inclusion is unwelcome; rather, the industry built around DEI seems to have gone astray. Instead of uplifting individuals, it often encourages them to see themselves as victims instead of victors. If there’s one lesson Douglass imparts, it's that self-determination and personal excellence outweigh all obstacles.
For those unfamiliar, Frederick Douglass was not merely a man of his time but a visionary ahead of it. Born into slavery and fueled by his own courage and resolve, he taught himself to read and write when such actions were punishable by death. He became a prolific orator, writer, and abolitionist, eventually advising President Abraham Lincoln. By the time of his death, Douglass emerged as one of the wealthiest men of his era, a testament to the strength of grit, intelligence, and an unshakeable belief in his own worth.
Let’s be honest: Frederick Douglass likely wouldn’t be invited to keynote your average DEI seminar. He would stand at the lectern, pause, and then deconstruct the idea of viewing individuals solely as representatives of their racial or social categories instead of as unique, capable beings. He believed that freedom came not from handouts or lowered expectations but from opportunity and effort.
Today's DEI playbook, in contrast, often does the opposite. By framing marginalized communities as inherently disadvantaged, it risks fostering a culture of dependency and resentment. Rather than encouraging individuals to tackle challenges, it suggests, “The system is rigged, and you are powerless without intervention.” This stands in direct opposition to what America is supposed to represent.
If we want a nation where equity truly thrives, we should focus on empowering individuals through education, experience, and merit-based opportunities, rather than perpetuating a narrative of systemic helplessness. Excellence, not victimhood, should be the gold standard. This isn’t merely a feel-good platitude but the formula for a new golden age for the United States.
Let’s consider how Douglass might have approached the modern workplace. Faced with barriers, he would likely do what he always did: learn, strategize, and excel until he overcame them. He wouldn’t waste his energy on grievances but would channel it into accomplishments. Yet, he would not expect the world to bend to him simply because of his struggles. He believed in equality of opportunity, not equality of outcome.
The irony is that Douglass achieved more for inclusion without a corporate diversity officer. Through his actions, he proved that intelligence and character, not skin color, matter most. By his example, he elevated not only himself but also the perception of an entire race. Our modern DEI apparatus would do well to revisit this lesson.
If America is to continue its progress, it must return to a simple, though demanding, idea: Treat people as individuals, not as victims of arbitrary categories. Judge them by their abilities and contributions, not by their grievances or identities. Equity, in its truest sense, means creating a society where everyone has the chance to thrive based on their talents and determination. That, however, is actually the definition of Equality.
Frederick Douglass didn’t need a DEI consultant to achieve greatness. What he needed was opportunity and a belief in his own potential—two things America, at its best, has always offered. Let us honor his legacy not by teaching future generations to see themselves as victims, but as victors. That is the DEI America truly needs. And if Douglass were alive today, I can imagine he’d close his speech with something like this: **“Dear friends, do not wait for a committee or a consultan** t to validate your worth. Get up, take the reins, and make something of yourself.”
Wise words and an even wiser path forward.

Excellence, not victimhood, should be the gold standard. This isn’t merely a feel-good platitude but the formula for a new golden age for the United States. Let’s consider how Douglass might have approached the modern workplace. Faced with barriers, he would likely do what he always did: learn, strategize, and excel until he overcame them. He wouldn’t waste his energy on grievances but would channel it into accomplishments. Yet, he would not expect the world to bend to him simply because of his struggles. He believed in equality of opportunity, not equality of outcome. The irony is that Douglass achieved more for inclusion without a corporate diversity officer. Through his actions, he proved that intelligence and character, not skin color, matter most. By his example, he elevated not only himself but also the perception of an entire race. Our modern DEI apparatus would do well to revisit this lesson. If America is to continue its progress, it must return to a simple, though demanding, idea: Treat people as individuals, not as victims of arbitrary categories. Judge them by their abilities and contributions, not by their grievances or identities. Equity, in its truest sense, means creating a society where everyone has the chance to thrive based on their talents and determination. That, however, is actually the definition of Equality. Frederick Douglass didn’t need a DEI consultant to achieve greatness. What he needed was opportunity and a belief in his own potential—two things America, at its best, has always offered. Let us honor his legacy not by teaching future generations to see themselves as victims, but as victors. That is the DEI America truly needs. And if Douglass were alive today, I can imagine he’d close his speech with something like this: “Dear friends, do not wait for a committee or a consultan** t to validate your worth. Get up, take the reins, and make something of yourself.” Wise words and an even wiser path forward. | | | | | Copyright (C) 2025 Dominic For CT. All rights reserved. body:
This is an open letter to America First patriots.

| | | | |
---
Friend, I’m bringing Republican Senators an urgent message:
#

# **__RFK Jr__**** _.,_****__Tulsi Gabbard__**** _, and_**** __Kash Patel__**** _must be confirmed._**
#
**_And our team will do whatever is necessary to hold GOP Senators accountable who don’t vote YES on their confirmations._**
#

# This is not a threat... It's a peaceful promise.
#

# We must hold our senators accountable and let them know that the Republican voters who got them into office demand that they confirm President Trump’s Cabinet nominees.

[HELP CONFIRM TRUMP’S CABINET](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9X8z/?__vbtrk=Mjc0MDU4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc0MDU4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
# We, the grassroots, are watching closely.
#

# That’s why I’m not just sending this message to the Senators considering voting down President Trump’s cabinet appointees.
#

# I am sending this message to you, and countless other American patriots just like you who helped us get President Trump over the line in November.
#

# **_We are holding our Republican Senators’ feet to the fire, and we are making sure they know that the voice of the people will be heard._**

[PUT GOP SENATORS ON NOTICE](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9X8z/?__vbtrk=Mjc0MDU4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc0MDU4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
# I have made my intentions clear, friend.

# When we sent President Trump to the White House, we did so believing that President Trump would staff the federal government with allies who will help him Make America Great Again.

# Any Republican Senator standing in the way of President Trump’s cabinet appointees must not be let off the hook by the voters who made their voices loud and clear on Election Day...

** _If they vote no, they must be primaried out of the Senate._**

[PUT GOP SENATORS ON NOTICE](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9X8z/?__vbtrk=Mjc0MDU4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc0MDU4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
# Senators, for decades, have _**voted against**_ the will of the American people, and faced **_zero accountability_** for it.
#

# If we want to truly Make America Great Again then this time things must be different.
#

# Accountability is coming to Washington whether the political establishment likes it or not.
#

# That’s why I’m asking for your help right now.
#

# **__[Please chip in whatever you can today to help us hold our ground and fuel our ability to keep the pressure on Republican Senators to support President Trump’s cabinet nominees](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9X8z/?__vbtrk=Mjc0MDU4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc0MDU4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)__**** _._**
#

# I am counting on you to help us win this crucial fight, we have come too far to let our movement be stopped by the Swamp.

_To Victory,_

**Scott Presler** Founder, Early Vote Action

[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/9X8z/?__vbtrk=Mjc0MDU4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc0MDU4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

body:
I never asked to be thrown into national politics. I wanted to be a paramedic or a cop and live a normal life.

|

Friend,

I never asked to be thrown into national politics. I wanted to be a paramedic or a cop and live a normal life.

However, all that changed when I lawfully defended myself during a BLM riot.

My life was thrown upside down. I had Biden using my image in his ads, saying I was a white supremacist. I had the national media lying about me. I had strangers online cursing at me and even sending me death threats.

This is all detailed in my new book, _Acquitted_.

**_I 've accepted my life is different now. But I will not accept leaving the fate of our country to radical leftists who want to destroy American values of liberty_.**

This is personal for me.

We must take back our universities and go on the offensive against the woke mobs who control them.

My friend JP Kirby started a youth organization called Student Rights Inc. They have a strategy to battle woke campus administrators, defend the freedom of speech of students, and promote Constitutional rights at colleges.

Students Rights Inc. incorporates the Freedom Method strategy to defend student rights on campus. More on that below. **STEP 1:** Student Rights Inc. identifies campus policies that violate students' constitutional rights.

These can be anything from speech codes restricting what students can say and where they can say it. Or it can even be gun policies that prohibit self-defense on campus. Or, lately, it can be medical policies like forced COVID vaccine requirements.

**STEP 2:** Student Rights Inc. gives the freedom-loving students on campus the training to build an opposition movement.

Through the Freedom Method curriculum developed during JP's years of policy change work as well as personalized coaching, Student Rights Inc. teaches students to win over their classmates, build coalitions with campus groups, and spread the movement on their campuses.

**STEP 3:** This one is the fun part. Student Rights Inc. activists go after the campus administrators!

CNN Republican Scott Jennings **[hammered his Democrat cohost for refusing to admit](https://substack.com/redirect/7dcb3753-e8b0-487e-a3c2-22315eb5d9e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that President Donald Trump's tariff negotiation strategy worked in yielding a desired result for the American people.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/7dcb3753-e8b0-487e-a3c2-22315eb5d9e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7dcb3753-e8b0-487e-a3c2-22315eb5d9e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"I don't know what Trump wanted from this," CNN Democrat Catherine Rampell said of Trump's tariff strategy. "Again, he didn't actually get anything. But if he were to put these tariffs in place it would be very painful for American consumers."
"Total lie!" Jennings cut in. **["It's a total lie, I'm sorry! He got what he wanted!!"](https://substack.com/redirect/7dcb3753-e8b0-487e-a3c2-22315eb5d9e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Jennings added that Trump successfully got an agreement from Mexico and Canada to do more to secure the border, which is the result he was aiming for all along.
"I understand you're the minister of propaganda tonight but you don't have to be! You could just say 'alls well that ends well!'" Jennings joked.

## Trump Bans Men from Women's Sports
The White House issued an executive order on Wednesday [banning males](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQRn-NvTk6Do7ggaFLtnTtaBFzF1NhY2GaKP--SveOnz7p6el9XadrSDlt98-wsm9SJgSkAXAAO8WQ8msyffTCjKx79uqsnSPQoPvFzzHczgZpNI4wAkctQka0II2jotgn_6YBglWaHLgT20DolGLFZhYynQGOqZV6-i5pawtLfpUH19Nc1j77pbX96PRHh5cOL2Hf-Hm8r_eoLc2ZO7zEsoUch1Z_1n1oNWzHnbfIdQhtydz4GLQFa5SSWSGLCM8jBTdqTcqiYXXrq4_7M-WcDnvuDNzXkPKfQvsvycPjbwAAAP__eMliAA) from participating in women's and girls' sporting events, fulfilling a campaign promise to keep men out of women's sports. The order mandated that federal agencies, including the Department of Justice, will interpret Title IX regulations as banning boys and men from participating in female sports. Noncompliant organizations risk [losing federal funding](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L9uwyAYBPCnwRsW_2xgYKhUeUvVraNFzGf7qzBEQJLm7St373on_XS6r8t88RgxbR_-ANfWPAsmBsoEZeMcPMbXrLrgVgABsgPHtTRmYJLJbnd61dbKYK0YRq3NalXgg-QgQUp7tUuH7tSYYCOXg2Gmh9EPwnAOHNSyDoooBgFbLv13xtR2WOMrP6D0Sz666PbWbpXINyImIiZ_XRI8a7_lsyZi-swRGy6ViKmV-3GjFbdE4QeWe8MH0FwCFHr1KWHaaCs-1Q3Smfm2R2hQ6TMfkE6gtlxeRE4YiHzn3KjRKG264sLtiTFiHTVRbDs8xr9x7b-zHk78BgAA__9fJGx4) and facing legal action. Officials also stated that Wednesday's actions would affect the 2028 Summer Olympic Games in Los Angeles by [targeting visas](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOszAQBOCnsTtH67UhTuHib-jyt1ciBxbsk8Gc2STH25-4_rqRRvpGmo97fw8pp3X-HxbyPJUeARsFqKDtx5Dy0Vs5-okIyUjy-mqca8CAkdFfLZlWg75ZB3aA0NLDjtppG9wDLTiZ_KkBQqtN48BdqA0NOq1Jkx2mxgoLNCYu9fJZ0sqRpnyUF9XLUBaZfWTedmH-CewEdhwpppzPTmAXy0IrvXeBXZ4f_CWwazTewILi-lw2Rd80PDm9SJU6UlVcw7rPtJ45cMzEtCsEdKrkY9nScFKy-nF7p5zT3l6FhXkJ6XdR8l_vvDz-BAAA__8_tmZr) for transgender athletes, stating males intending to compete against women would be potentially investigated for fraud. Before signing the _[Keeping Men Out of Women’s Sports](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuhDAQBNCvMZ3RsjYcKVykobu0KZHBC2xibIR9Z93fR1yf_mlmNN_38W7Zc1i_7E4mL3FEwFYCSuhGZ9m_Rl05sxAhqYpMc1N934ICVW3GtpObeo1NQw25CdyHVra5gXY4o1ZTxeZKA4SuUW0PfU2dbbF_ez0vrRYayHGOZ_0TOeSNFv-KTzrrOe6VN1vORxLqU-AgcCil1GXjTFt8JKrX-BQ4HCcldhQyWy_tnDmGJHC4egUOgAKHX6KDwyp3CjI-soyLLHGnkGQ64pkvXp3GHYW959TdhIZ1t-zfI_J_pzwN_gUAAP__n-tkLA)_ order, President Trump, surrounded by dozens of female athletes, declared, _"From now on, women’s sports will be only for women."_
## Protests Held Nationwide Over Trump Policies
[Demonstrations took place across 50 states](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGv4yAQhH8N7mwtCxiuoLiGLtdeaZF4nfCEjWU2sfzvn3j9a_bbYjQzmv-36RZTTtvzX1zJ81ImBDQ9YA_jNMeUr0l3s1-IkFRHXlrlnAEFqnt5F52DuyYbtdJoDd7JKb2ghGWU0rku-eYGCKNUxoEbaIwGnZQkST8Wo4UGmhOXY_gqaeMXLfkqHzqGR1m77F_MexXqr8AgMJznObxr5DLHqwkEhsrluASGjc7aEDmVTWBosQIDYDvtixunno_3uvf7UZgq195AXzky1f69z40Cg3Wo_miLAFZg6A4_72fKOdXRCg3PNab8041_2-rj8TsAAP___INntg) on Wednesday as part of the 50501 Movement, with protests against recent Trump administration policies. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2241%2E135344%2Esek0SB)

Team,
We wanted to send a quick update from Washington, where Elissa took the floor of the Senate bright and early at 6:00 am this morning.
She was one of 35 Democratic U.S. Senators participating in a 30-hour session—starting yesterday afternoon and continuing through the night—to use the maximum allowed debate time on the floor, and draw attention to recent threats facing our democracy, our rights, and our Constitution.
A key focus was President Trump’s nominee to lead the Office of Management and Budget, Russell Vought. When Elissa questioned him in the Homeland Security Committee, he couldn’t commit to pushing back against orders that might violate the U.S. Constitution. This fits into a troubling pattern we’ve seen in recent weeks—a willingness to bend the Constitution to serve political ends.
On top of that, there’s a group of billionaires with access to the White House who are leading the administration around by their noses. No one in Michigan voted for Elon Musk, and now he has access to every American’s personal and private data, raising serious questions about how that information could be used for his personal or financial gain.
Our country is going through something right now. As Elissa emphasized in her speech—her first on the Senate floor—her responsibility as a senior elected leader is to protect the Constitution and the foundations of our democracy.
Thanks for following along, and for being an engaged citizen.
Team Slotkin
* * *

Musk and Trump’s MAGA crew are working hand in hand to dismantle the institutions that serve _us_ , and we can’t afford to stand idly by. It’s time to fight back. Peter, the Trump administration is attacking our government from the inside out to enact their MAGA agenda. **One of the latest targets: the U.S. Census Bureau.** Since late last week, the bureau has experienced significant setbacks that hurt its ability to operate effectively as a nonpartisan statistical agency. And that hurts our ability to have a fair count in the census that leads to fair maps. First, Census Bureau Director Robert Santos, the renowned data expert who has led the Census Bureau for years, abruptly announced his resignation, which paves the path for Trump to appoint a right-wing, partisan replacement. Next, the bureau’s website started going dark for periods of time. _The New York Times_ reported that “more than 3,000 pages from the Census Bureau, the vast majority of which are articles filed under research and methodology,” were affected. Other missing pages include data stewardship policies and documentation for several data sets and surveys.” **It’s an ambush in broad daylight, and these attacks only strengthen and demonstrate the power of the Trump administration to undermine and politicize the agency.** Trump and his allies are counting on us being too distracted by all of their other attacks on our democracy to notice what they’re doing here. **And it could endanger President Trump’s entire legislative agenda!**

By all accounts, Elise Stefanik’s confirmation to Trump’s Cabinet will sail through. She’s an excellent pick – no surprise there. That tees up a Special Election in New York to replace her. Then, the Governor is mandated by state law to lay out the election calendar.

_Losing one seat – or even postponing a Republican victory – will have serious ramifications for President Trump’s agenda to pass through Congress._
