Today, organizations like ours around the country are rallying members for a Medicaid Day of Action. **Will you help us stop cuts to Medicaid, once and for all?**
**[**_Take a moment NOW to contact your representatives and tell them to save Medicaid >>_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101642880/526624373/29127930?ms=020625_WAAmedicaid_CiA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YjBhMWRmNC05OGU0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rHuOdc545V-hTqjobeoANrKSW6GTxhWBZmJu82gd-zc=&emci=30b7113e-f4e3-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=9b0a1df4-98e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=864787)**

In case you’ve forgotten, Medicaid cuts would:
* Take health care coverage away from **millions of people,** including children, people in nursing homes and those living with disabilities and chronic illnesses;
* Make it harder for part-time workers, and caregivers to get health care;
* Increase health care costs for everyone, including medical debt for millions;
* And destabilize hospitals and health care systems that we all rely on.

If health care is further privatized through cuts to Medicaid, health care CEOs will get richer while the rest of us get sicker.
_Why should our health have to suffer so their bank accounts grow even more?_

clean_body: Take a minute to contact your representatives Peter, Donald Trump and Republicans want to slash Medicaid funding so they can pass tax breaks for the wealthiest 1% and corporations. Today, organizations like ours around the country are rallying members for a Medicaid Day of Action. Will you help us stop cuts to Medicaid, once and for all? **** In case you’ve forgotten, Medicaid cuts would: Take health care coverage away from millions of people, including children, people in nursing homes and those living with disabilities and chronic illnesses; Make it harder for part-time workers, and caregivers to get health care; Increase health care costs for everyone, including medical debt for millions; And destabilize hospitals and health care systems that we all rely on. If health care is further privatized through cuts to Medicaid, health care CEOs will get richer while the rest of us get sicker. Why should our health have to suffer so their bank accounts grow even more? Keep an eye out for our weekly Action Alerts — as long as Republicans continue to attack critical care programs, we’ll be organizing to fight back. In solidarity, Care in Action

| | It’s important you download your concealed carry certificate before it's banned for good.

Due to increased pressure from lawmakers, a website offering you a certificate for America’s Top CCW Gun Permit **could be shut down at any moment.**

Which is why it’s important you download your **Concealed Carry Certificate ASAP**.

Wait even one more day and we won’t be able to guarantee this certificate will be available to download.

This certificate is great for gun owners because it takes advantage of a little-known (but 100% legal) loophole - **[allowing you to get a CCW certification from this website](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/20196/6374453/26d7598b49312f15a05604e5b5865c652f027ab5/520bf9d33a563fd33e7ff73aa42c6f9d14db5c2d). You don’t even have to leave your house to do it!**

This loophole ensures you encounter:
* Zero government red tape (and no exposing your private info to the Feds)...
* Zero lines, classroom time or books to read...
* Zero gun range time (you don’t even need to fire a gun to get this permit).

**[It’s as simple as visiting this site and answering a few questions (they’re simple)](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/20196/6374453/26d7598b49312f15a05604e5b5865c652f027ab5/520bf9d33a563fd33e7ff73aa42c6f9d14db5c2d).**

Plus you can complete the entire certification process online.

Download it directly to your phone or computer in as little as 30 minutes.

**You don’t even need to own a gun to get this permit...** that’s why it’s named America’s #1 Concealed Carry Permit.

31 states have agreed to accept this permit so far. That’s because it’s simply the closest and easiest path to a semi-nationally recognized permit that’s available right now.

This permit isn’t just a basic concealed carry permit either. **It’s one of a kind... and is available to you No Matter what state you reside in.**

**Hurry and get it now.**

**[There are no guarantees this website](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/20196/6374453/26d7598b49312f15a05604e5b5865c652f027ab5/520bf9d33a563fd33e7ff73aa42c6f9d14db5c2d)** will be able to legally deliver this certificate to your email address after today!

Strength in Numbers
| Friend, The time to act is now! With Donald Trump in office, conservatives have a powerful ally in the mission to protect women’s rights. **_Maybe the movement’s most powerful ally, yet!_**
However, you and I cannot achieve our goals without a strong, united front.
President Trump is a tremendous help for finally giving a voice to the women who are under attack from leftist policies. But there’s only so much he can do, Friend. Enter my ambassadors. The Riley Gaines Center is committed to building a movement of advocates dedicated to standing up for women. **Your support will allow the Riley Gaines Center to organize events, produce educational materials, and advocate for policies that prioritize women’s rights.** This is the on-the-ground grunt work that has a real impact in the real world.
Together, we can create a ripple effect that impacts every corner of our country.

Today is the deadline for federal workers to take Trump’s so-called sweetheart deal of pay without work. Cutting right to the chase... Don't be fooled!
Not only is there no budget line to pay people who don’t show up for work, Trump doesn’t even have the authority to make this kind of offer.
If you’re a federal worker and you resign based on Trump’s word, I’d bet anything he’ll stiff you — just like he’s stiffed thousands before.
Our federal workers deserve better than lies and manipulation from the President.
Sign my petition today to say we stand with federal workers — not Trump’s tricks and threats. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/tyinIdI7iUG-a92OidXPTA2]
Thanks.
—Tim Kaine

------------- Forwarded message -------------
From : Tim Kaine
Sent: Sat, Feb 1, 2025
Subject: Don’t be fooled.
Folks, Donald Trump is out for our federal workforce.
On Day One of his second term, he issued executive orders that order federal workers to return to the office in person five days a week and weaken job protections for civil servants.
He revived a policy called “Schedule F” — now renamed “Schedule Policy/Career” — that is designed to replace long-serving public servants with MAGA loyalists, subjecting government workers to ideology tests in order to hold onto their jobs.
Now, Trump has offered federal workers an alleged incentive to quit their jobs: eight months’ pay, if they hurry up and quit by next week.
But let’s be clear about one thing: There is no budget line item in the U.S. government to pay people who aren’t showing up for work — so do not be fooled by this.
Just like he has for decades in his organizations, I’m willing to bet that Trump will stiff our federal workers. We know Donald Trump — he’s tricked people with this kind of offer before, and we know he’ll do it again.
If you’re a federal worker and you accept his offer and resign, he’ll stiff you just like he’s stiffed thousands of contractors in the past.
The President has been trying to terrorize federal workers for the past week. Now, he’s handing out a sweetheart offer — if you resign in the next week, we’ll pay you for doing nothing! Do. Not. Be. Fooled.
Aside from being a known grifter and liar, Trump doesn’t even have the authority to make this kind of offer.
Our civil servants and government workers deserve better than tricks and lies from their boss — our President. If you agree, sign on to my petition today to say we should be supporting the federal workforce, not terrorizing them. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/tyinIdI7iUG-a92OidXPTA2]
Thanks for speaking up.
-Tim Kaine

---

Fellow American,

I'm seeing early reports that the radical Left is actively mobilizing across the Country to derail and undermine President Trump and his Republican supporters.

**The level of funding and scale of their operation is ALARMING!**

body:
One of his first actions was attacking DEI.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101651356/526648201/-211760203?refcode=EM_F_250129turn_N_TSB_90DO_3_NG_N_logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYmQxOTA2Yy1hM2U0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LFuqu78nJ8Y1ssCBZPsdd-yX6RuVHpVGee3a8FWfSqU=) Peter,

As we enter Black History Month, I want to make one thing clear: **President Trump will do anything to make America less fair, less just, and less inclusive.**

As a proud member of the Congressional Black Caucus, I am deeply disappointed in the new diversity, equity, and inclusion rollbacks taking place in our federal government that are aimed at limiting opportunities for Black Americans and Black communities.

**The MAGA myth of reverse discrimination isn’t just insulting – it is entirely baseless.** [**This Black History Month, help me continue fighting for a just and equitable nation by pitching in $5 today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101651360/526648206/-211760203?refcode=EM_F_250129turn_N_TSB_90DO_3_NG_N_L1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYmQxOTA2Yy1hM2U0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LFuqu78nJ8Y1ssCBZPsdd-yX6RuVHpVGee3a8FWfSqU=)

One of Donald Trump’s first actions was terminating federal government diversity, equity, and inclusion programs. Additionally, all federal employees who work in DEI programs have now been placed on paid leave, and those agencies employing them are tasked with submitting a written plan for their dismissal. **Trump is playing politics at the expense of our nation, and we cannot stand for it.**

The legacy of groundbreaking Black leaders in OH-11 runs decades long, and as Trump works to wreak havoc on our nation, I will continue to support programs that promote fair hiring, support small minority-owned businesses, and ensure our nation represents everyone – not just a select few. But I cannot do it alone.

[**In honor of Black History Month, will you join me in the fight against discrimination and protect our rights by donating $5 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101651363/526648211/-211760203?refcode=EM_F_250205insult_N_SB_90DO_6_NG_N_L1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYmQxOTA2Yy1hM2U0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LFuqu78nJ8Y1ssCBZPsdd-yX6RuVHpVGee3a8FWfSqU=)

Together,

Shontel Brown | Shontel Brown is proud to be elected as the Congresswoman for Ohio’s 11th District. She has spent the last decade serving the people of Ohio and building coalitions. As she enters her second full term in Congress, she will use that experience to continue the fight for affordable quality health care, jobs that pay fair wages, a strong public education system, and to preserve and protect our democracy for generations to come. Will you join her and be the change we need?

Folks,
President Trump is exploiting a crisis: Using the suffering of those affected by the Los Angeles fires as a tool to push voter suppression.
That’s right – he's threatening to withhold aid to the thousands of Southern Californians who’ve lost their homes, livelihoods, and communities to wildfire unless the state government sides with him to deny thousands of voters’ rights by passing a voter ID law.
Say it loud: Disaster victims are not political pawns . California needs wildfire aid now – with no partisan, anti-voter demands attached.
Stand with us and urge Congress to do their job and deliver help to people who need it immediately >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-speaker-johnson-disaster-victims-are-not-political-pawns-2?source=013125swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions%3Frefcode%3Djaaidvictims]

Unfortunately, Trump's friends in Congress are falling in line , with House Speaker Mike Johnson refusing to commit to helping his fellow Americans in need if there isn’t something in it for his party.
California lawmakers have already passed strong protections for the state’s voting systems to ensure they’re both accessible AND secure . Adding voter ID into the mix would do nothing to secure elections, just shut thousands of eligible voters out on the basis of class and color.
Entire neighborhoods have been reduced to ash, families have been displaced, and critical infrastructure has been damaged. The road to recovery is long – and pressuring California to pass voter ID will only make it longer.
Tell Speaker Mike Johnson: Don’t follow Trump’s lead in politicizing disaster aid. body:
Welcome to the third installment of...
---
| | | | | |
---
| |
#### Teichert in the Trenches - February 2025
Welcome to the third installment of Teichert in the Trenches, a monthly newsletter highlighting a snippet of my attempts to maximize my impact on people and our great nation and to develop the leaders our nation needs! ** _Teichert in the News_**
---
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBmP64SPACXkt7Xr7g/NiR0luKIYxzP)
---
The topics of Greenland, the Panama Canal, and a refocus on the security of our hemisphere have provided several opportunities for media engagements. One of these is visible above.
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13EXv1dZJgdaBrW9hw/zj6FiHqIu1um)
---
| | | The horrible aviation tragedy in Washington, DC this past month had audiences thirsting for well-reasoned voices of perspective and context. The video above is a part of my real-time commentary shortly after the crash that evening. The following 48 hours offered interviews on News Nation, Newsmax, BBC, Sky News, CBS, Fox Baltimore, The Times, Al Arabiya, Todd Starnes, John Catsimatidis, and the Family Research Council. ** _Thoughts by Teichert_**
---
| | | | [ Alsobrooks must be an independent voice for Maryland](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG7uggjyojTAjPUbUSIC/H7fmjnsU4dB_)
---
Thanks to the Baltimore Sun for publishing my commentary calling for our new U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks to break three campaign promises for the betterment of Maryland and our great nation.
| | | | [ Greenland is a Strategic Goldmine](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGEm8pYvztcepEnLSksS/YvsX6vUyHWYI)
---
| | | I appreciate The Daily Caller for publishing these thoughts on the strategic significance of Greenland for U.S. interests.
---
| | | | [ Transformative Leadership - Podcast](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGLdayNtB3m8v465R3Si/8pYNskgZTISO)
---
| | | I thoroughly enjoyed joining my former colleague Nate Scheer on his podcast. We crammed in discussion about leadership, innovation, and revival, and I know you will enjoy it.
---
| [ "Way Point Better" Podcast](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGSV37CqMDvd0tOpPM2y/5DVjyPwAiTl-)
---
| | | I also appreciated the opportunity to be a guest on Joseph Bogdan’s podcast, especially our discussion on actionable ways to remain firmly tethered to our values, principles, and priorities while remaining flexible to seize the exploding energy of change all around us. ** _Teichert in the Trenches_**
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | Prayers for a Nation is hanging out at the U.S. Capitol and smart dogs are reading and studying BOOM! (I would have recommended that Jax listen to the Audio version instead). ** _Behind the Scenes_**
---
| | | |
---
My team did an amazing job creating a powerful cover for Prayers for a Nation. This was their first draft. Can you pick out the differences from the final cover? First, we made the white fireworks brighter in the blue background. Second, we changed the red star to a white star. A red star is the international symbol for communism, and that was NOT what we were going for. Fortunately, we discovered it and made the changes in time! ** _My Bookshelf_**
| | | |
---
I reread this great book this month. The following is from my book endorsement back in 2021: “The world wants today’s Christian to stagnate is a foxhole of faith. Offensive Faith challenges Christians to take our faith on the offensive. Stephen Chappell has used offensive faith to change the lives of southern California residents through Coastline Baptist Church. Jeremy Stalnecker has used offensive faith to change the lives of our nation’s warriors through the Mighty Oaks Foundation. Their effective employment of an offensive faith has saved lives, restored families, and changed legacies. The wise perspective provided by this book will help readers employ a forward-leaning faith to meet the needs of a struggling society that cannot afford for Christians to remain on the defensive.”
|
---
“So many today want character in leadership but without the constraint of virtues ... many companies select a set of values which organize their work and define their brand, but these corporate values in turn need to be grounded in transcendent virtues.”
|
---
“For the most part, public reaction to the possibility of a massive cyberattack has not even risen to the level of apathy. Apathy suggests the awareness of a problem and the decision not to worry about it. We’re not there yet ... Our points of vulnerable access are greater than in all of previous human history, yet we have barely begun to focus on the actual danger that cyber warfare presents to our national infrastructure.” ** _PLUS Posts for the Month_**
| | | |
---
| [ Seeking His Face (Jan 4th)](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGZMVG1nXO576ihZNedE/j60OTcxY8t0G)
---
| [ Something is Missing (Jan 11th)](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGgDxOqkiYEbCY0JLxDU/C2qZokZU7UDg)
---
| [ Bearing Much Fruit (Jan 18th)](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGn5PXfhtiO5INJ3KFnk/2y-rlqQO8pU2)
---
| [ Truly Making a Difference (Jan 25th)](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGtwrgUf4sXZOCbnIYO0/xDA5C2Mi4Pi_)
---
| | | **_Blasts from the Past_**
---
| | | |
---
With Greenland in the news, it’s the perfect time to roll out this picture from 2022 of a 12-hour trip to northwest Greenland during the wintertime. We saw temps down to -47 degrees, but the views were stunning. It was only a few weeks until the first sunrise of the year!
|
---
“You could write to the NFL Commissioner and ask him to adjust the schedule!” That’s what my Joint Base Andrews Air Show Director recommended as the best solution to resolve our parking concerns at FedEx Field for our 2017 air show. The following is what Roger Goodell wrote back after we had done a bit of socialization with the Redskins and our amazing community partners. With a real-reasoned rationale, it never hurts to ask!
[ ](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDhYHcZvsAP4JMNKzgWGO/w-OjThNXEmlz)
The recent inauguration brought back great memories. As the Commander of Joint Base Andrews in January 2017, I had the privilege of leading Division 4 of the Inauguration parade, with 500 incredible Airmen giving President Trump his first Air Force salute. What an amazing memory! Ironically, when I first found out that this was my responsibility during the inauguration, I laughed (Melonie laughed even more!). Drill and ceremonies had never been my strong suit and now I’m responsible for leading and calling commands as we parade down Pennsylvania Avenue in front of the White House. Life throws some interesting and enjoyable curveballs! ** _Rejoin Opportunities_**
| [ Spiritual Leadership Conference Asia](https://eufi5.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE9szp0KEGKEZQCiofFyS/_oYJZAgqA4Ye)
---
If you are in the Manila area, I will be speaking at the Spiritual Leadership Conference Asia in early March. Please stop by and say hi! ** _Dad Joke of the Month_** I recently competed in an art competition in Washington DC ... it ended in a draw!
| | | |
---

A red star is the international symbol for communism, and that was NOT what we were going for. Fortunately, we discovered it and made the changes in time! My Bookshelf | | | | I reread this great book this month. The following is from my book endorsement back in 2021: “The world wants today’s Christian to stagnate is a foxhole of faith. Offensive Faith challenges Christians to take our faith on the offensive. Stephen Chappell has used offensive faith to change the lives of southern California residents through Coastline Baptist Church. Jeremy Stalnecker has used offensive faith to change the lives of our nation’s warriors through the Mighty Oaks Foundation. Their effective employment of an offensive faith has saved lives, restored families, and changed legacies. The wise perspective provided by this book will help readers employ a forward-leaning faith to meet the needs of a struggling society that cannot afford for Christians to remain on the defensive.” | “So many today want character in leadership but without the constraint of virtues ... many companies select a set of values which organize their work and define their brand, but these corporate values in turn need to be grounded in transcendent virtues.” | “For the most part, public reaction to the possibility of a massive cyberattack has not even risen to the level of apathy. Apathy suggests the awareness of a problem and the decision not to worry about it. We’re not there yet ... Our points of vulnerable access are greater than in all of previous human history, yet we have barely begun to focus on the actual danger that cyber warfare presents to our national infrastructure.” PLUS Posts for the Month | | | | | | | | | | | Blasts from the Past | | | | With Greenland in the news, it’s the perfect time to roll out this picture from 2022 of a 12-hour trip to northwest Greenland during the wintertime. We saw temps down to -47 degrees, but the views were stunning. It was only a few weeks until the first sunrise of the year! | “You could write to the NFL Commissioner and ask him to adjust the schedule!” That’s what my Joint Base Andrews Air Show Director recommended as the best solution to resolve our parking concerns at FedEx Field for our 2017 air show. The following is what Roger Goodell wrote back after we had done a bit of socialization with the Redskins and our amazing community partners. With a real-reasoned rationale, it never hurts to ask! The recent inauguration brought back great memories. As the Commander of Joint Base Andrews in January 2017, I had the privilege of leading Division 4 of the Inauguration parade, with 500 incredible Airmen giving President Trump his first Air Force salute. What an amazing memory! Ironically, when I first found out that this was my responsibility during the inauguration, I laughed (Melonie laughed even more!). Drill and ceremonies had never been my strong suit and now I’m responsible for leading and calling commands as we parade down Pennsylvania Avenue in front of the White House. Life throws some interesting and enjoyable curveballs! Rejoin Opportunities | If you are in the Manila area, I will be speaking at the Spiritual Leadership Conference Asia in early March. Please stop by and say hi! Dad Joke of the Month I recently competed in an art competition in Washington DC ... it ended in a draw! | | | | | | | | Teichert in the Trenches | Washington, DC | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | You've received it because you've subscribed to our newsletter. | |

subject: Are we going to stand up, Democrats?
body:
It’s Malcolm Kenyatta, one of the new vice chairs of the DNC.
---
Derek, It’s Malcolm Kenyatta, one of the new vice chairs of the DNC. Since 2018, I’ve had the honor of being one of the youngest members of the Pennsylvania General Assembly, where I serve the people of North Philly. Now, I am also honored to have the opportunity to reach millions of more voters in my new role. Let me be honest: This is a moment for us to choose. This is a moment when young people like me are asking whether or not we're going to inherit a world where we can drink the water and breathe the air. This is a moment for us to choose. This is a moment where our seniors are asking whether they can access the hard-earned benefits they worked their entire lives for. This is a moment for us to choose. At this moment my friends, where Black boys like me are being shot down in our streets and are asking if they are going to live to their 21st birthday. This is a moment for us to choose, my friends. Are we going to stand up to Trump and his MAGA allies? Are we going to give in when Republican extremists want to rip away Medicare and Social Security? Are we going to stand up, Democrats? **Let me tell you what I know: I’m ready to stand up and fight back. I’m ready to usher in generational change. This is a crucial part of our heritage — and we’re grateful Jason Miyares fought to keep it safe!| | | Friend, Today we’re celebrating Attorney General Miyares’ defense of one of your rights: **the right to retrieve**. If you aren’t a hunter, you may not be familiar with it — but the right to retrieve has existed in Virginia law for over 100 years. This principle is a part of the Commonwealth’s heritage, all the way back to George Washington, a lover of hunting dogs. The right to retrieve allows hunters to retrieve their animals from someone else’s property. But after several high-profile killings of hunting dogs on private land, the right came under attack in court. [**That’s when Jason Miyares stood up to defend the right to retrieve.**](http://links.jasonforvirginia.com/s/c/xGtXAkgOtaxirD2vQxkt_zJDVDeCNMsolEWr5-Ki8KeMbQQ-A_QlSrCp4AGZu241UGmYvKyzDISoXq26Sy2UH08Tzc-KbA_ukkAmesnD5RWr7M3tjxo2eumvY9Q6hmC-FY-c0ODB7a_WX5bYvOJTEZzB1T4vtGGszXRRQCjoy9MeL6gFxD_1W8xi6e4OaETtxrkr98VW_Qu_tRT_b-mGyXrF30bomh0FO5HEYdaUG7d1D6seWDONo4PSMAYe8Gw6qpVGcd9q2ceGN77kVcYjvBJw6W2U985C0JP1jiABJ23flJjM0c0vZHbSxkzDZGdijTaZmFOEoW_jE7VUGlfAPfBhYa1uLdE-dOAye33ysMFTeQ9LT5GaVquBgRNOOfJY7at8IZmGHNcMJly34fMScJcJMG108qtcsA/Vk7rSCptm-p7Ul7obnQkdirfQTmdVT5L/5) **More than half of Virginia’s hunters own hunting dogs, and we’re proud that Attorney General Miyares spoke up for these Virginians.** Want to learn more about this victory?

| | **Chaos and destruction continue to be Trump's number one plan.** I'm not distracted by the havoc, and Americans are paying attention. In the latest bid to pursue his Project 2025 agenda, Trump and Elon Musk are now taking aim at the Department of Education. **Trump will severely hurt working families and our education system.** As outlined in Trump's Project 2025, his plans could shutter public schools across the country, dismantle the Department of Education, eliminate Head Start, which serves over 800,000 children in all 50 states, and raise costs for families and students already struggling with high education costs. **His plans for education are deeply unpopular and harmful to our children, and we can not compromise on education for future generations. When we invest in our teachers and children – we are investing in the future.** Let's move forward, not backward. We're going to use every tool we can to hold Trump accountable and make sure they know that their actions are heartless and harmful. Keep raising your voices in this fight. name: Eric Underwood, Chairman
subject: CALL TO ACTION: Stand with Women - LB89
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NEBRASKA REPUBLICAN PARTY]( "PAID FOR BY THE NEBRASKA REPUBLICAN PARTY")
body:
🚨Testify Online or In-person🚨 | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/95630c2c9a3a/n41kepo7ku-12729747?e=25844e23a8)

---
| | **Protect Women's Spaces and Opportunities: Support LB89**
**_Stand with Women LB89_**

**The increasing blurring of biological sex distinctions threatens the integrity of women's spaces and opportunities. Women and girls deserve fair competition in athletics, and they deserve privacy and safety in restrooms and locker rooms. These protections, based on the fundamental biological differences between males and females, are essential.**

**Contact your state senator and urge them to support LB89. Let them know that you believe in protecting women's spaces and opportunities. Share your personal stories and emphasize the importance of this legislation for the women and girls in your life.**

[](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=2b9bddb899&e=25844e23a8) Please take time to:
1) Share the graphic below with your contacts and on social media
2) Submit written testimony by 8:00am on Friday
3) Attend the hearing in person to testify
4) Sign the Proponent sheet at the hearing door
5) Email the Government, Military and Veterans Affairs Committee Senators

**[THIS LINK](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=b6d3355cbd&e=25844e23a8) **will take you to the Nebraska Legislature's LB89 web page.
* **Fair Competition:** Biological differences between males and females have a significant impact on athletic performance. Allowing biological males to compete in women's sports creates an unfair playing field and diminishes opportunities for female athletes. LB89 protects the integrity of women's sports.
* **Safety and Privacy:** Women and girls have a right to privacy and safety in restrooms and locker rooms. LB89 ensures that these spaces remain designated for their intended biological sex, protecting women from potential discomfort, harassment, and even assault.
* **Protecting Opportunities:** Women-specific scholarships, grants, and other opportunities exist to address historical disadvantages and promote equality. LB89 helps preserve these opportunities for women by maintaining a clear definition of biological sex.
* **Common Sense:** Acknowledging biological reality isn't discriminatory; it's common sense. The federal government itself recognizes only two genders: male and female. LB89 simply codifies this widely accepted understanding.
* **Personal Stories:** Sharing personal experiences can be powerful. Have you or someone you know been impacted by the blurring of sex distinctions in sports, locker rooms, or other spaces? Sharing these stories can help others understand the real-world consequences of this issue. Have you benefited from a woman-specific program? Sharing these experiences can highlight the importance of protecting these opportunities. Are you a parent or grandparent concerned about the safety and fairness for your daughters and granddaughters? Your voice matters.

**Email Revenue Committee Senators:
• [Sen. R. Brad von Gillern, Chairperson](mailto:bvongillern@leg.ne.gov?subject=INHERITANCE%20BILL%20LB468)
• [Sen. Mike Jacobson, Vice Chairperson](mailto:mjacobson@leg.ne.gov?subject=INHERITANCE%20BILL%20LB468)
• [Sen. Eliot Bostar](mailto:ebostar@leg.ne.gov?subject=INHERITANCE%20BILL%20LB468)
• [Sen. George Dungan](mailto:gdungan@leg.ne.gov?subject=INHERITANCE%20BILL%20LB468)
• [Sen. Teresa Ibach](mailto:tibach@leg.ne.gov?subject=INHERITANCE%20BILL%20LB468)
• [Sen. Kathleen Kauth](mailto:kkauth@leg.ne.gov?subject=INHERITANCE%20BILL%20LB468)
• [Sen. Dave Murman](mailto:dmurman@leg.ne.gov?subject=INHERITANCE%20BILL%20LB468)
• [Sen. Tony Sorrentino](mailto:tsorrentino@leg.ne.gov?subject=INHERITANCE%20BILL%20LB468)** **\--Chairman Eric Underwood
Republican Party of Nebraska**

Trump has announced a major shift in media reporting on his actions. He's ordered the removal of major news organizations from the Pentagon, including The New York Times, NPR, NBC News, and Politico. In their place, he's granting dedicated office space to the New York Post, One America News Network (OANN), Breitbart News, and HuffPost--most of whom are known for spreading conspiracy theories, pushing pro-Trump propaganda, and undermining democratic institutions. This transition must be completed by February 14th. The big question is--how do we inoculate ourselves from the forthcoming avalanche of disinformation? **Let 's Address This.**

## A Coordinated Effort to Rewrite Reality
One of the defining characteristics of autocratic regimes is that they control the flow of information, ensuring that media outlets report favorably on the ruling party while silencing dissenting voices. This move isn't just concerning--it's a flashing red siren. The state-run media playbook is clear: flood the public with friendly coverage, discredit legitimate journalism, and make it harder for people to differentiate between truth and propaganda.
And now, it's happening right in front of us. Let's break down what this shift means:
* Breitbart, OANN, and the New York Post actively promoted Trump's "Big Lie" about the 2020 election being stolen, despite all credible evidence proving otherwise. Now, Trump is rewarding these outlets with privileged access to the Pentagon--the world's most powerful (and unaccountable) war department.
* NBC, NPR, The New York Times, and Politico--organizations that correctly reported that the 2020 election was legitimate--are being pushed out, further cementing Trump's anti-press, anti-accountability agenda. And while I'll be the first to admit I've been critical of how many of these corporate outlets must do better, I absolutely distinguish them from right wing propaganda outlets that sold Americans the Big Lie about the 2020 election.
* And how would the average person know about the billionaires who fund these outlets and biases they present? How do we ensure we're getting accurate information in a landscape increasingly dominated by propaganda?

The answer is we can't trust legacy media _alone_ anymore. We need independent tools that expose bias and ensure we are consuming fact-based journalism.
## The Solution: Independent Media and Ground News
I've always said, I don't propose problems without offering solutions. This is not a moment to give up, but a moment to take action. Because we are not powerless against media manipulation. We have the ability to better control the information we consume, to identify bias, and to ensure that truth still matters.
That's why I use Ground News--one of the most powerful tools available today to combat media bias and misinformation.

### Why Ground News Matters Now More Than Ever
Ground News isn't just another news aggregator--it's a game-changing website and app that helps you uncover bias and hidden agendas in media. Here's how it works:
✅ Bias Analysis: It categorizes news sources based on their political leaning (left, right, center) and their overall reliability, helping you make informed choices. This tool alone is worth the investment, especially as this regime continues to block out any outlet remotely critical of its actions.

**_Stand with Women LB89_**

__****CORRECTED SUBCOMMITTEE****__
Here are the emails for the Government, Military and Veterans Affairs Committee Members:

**The increasing blurring of biological sex distinctions threatens the integrity of women's spaces and opportunities. Women and girls deserve fair competition in athletics, and they deserve privacy and safety in restrooms and locker rooms. These protections, based on the fundamental biological differences between males and females, are essential.**

**Contact your state senator and urge them to support LB89. Let them know that you believe in protecting women's spaces and opportunities. Share your personal stories and emphasize the importance of this legislation for the women and girls in your life.**

[](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=19b176acc0&e=25844e23a8) Please take time to:
1) Share the graphic below with your contacts and on social media
2) Submit written testimony by 8:00am on Friday
3) Attend the hearing in person to testify
4) Sign the Proponent sheet at the hearing door
5) Email the Government, Military and Veterans Affairs Committee Senators

**[THIS LINK](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=fb4211bc57&e=25844e23a8) **will take you to the Nebraska Legislature's LB89 web page.
* **Fair Competition:** Biological differences between males and females have a significant impact on athletic performance. Allowing biological males to compete in women's sports creates an unfair playing field and diminishes opportunities for female athletes. LB89 protects the integrity of women's sports.
* **Safety and Privacy:** Women and girls have a right to privacy and safety in restrooms and locker rooms. LB89 ensures that these spaces remain designated for their intended biological sex, protecting women from potential discomfort, harassment, and even assault.
* **Protecting Opportunities:** Women-specific scholarships, grants, and other opportunities exist to address historical disadvantages and promote equality. LB89 helps preserve these opportunities for women by maintaining a clear definition of biological sex.
* **Common Sense:** Acknowledging biological reality isn't discriminatory; it's common sense. The federal government itself recognizes only two genders: male and female. LB89 simply codifies this widely accepted understanding.
* **Personal Stories:** Sharing personal experiences can be powerful. Have you or someone you know been impacted by the blurring of sex distinctions in sports, locker rooms, or other spaces? Sharing these stories can help others understand the real-world consequences of this issue. Have you benefited from a woman-specific program? Sharing these experiences can highlight the importance of protecting these opportunities. Are you a parent or grandparent concerned about the safety and fairness for your daughters and granddaughters? Your voice matters.

Here are the emails for the Government, Military and Veterans Affairs Committee Members:
* [Sen. Rita Sanders, Chairperson](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=1e340b119c&e=25844e23a8)

* [Sen. John Cavanaugh](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9581f57a46&e=25844e23a8)
* [Sen. Dunixi Guereca](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7cd7e2b3fc&e=25844e23a8)
* [Sen. Megan Hunt](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=a5f8a56127&e=25844e23a8)
* [Sen. Dan Lonowski](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=17f24e4c8c&e=25844e23a8)
* [Sen. Dan McKeon](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=0800b7cab8&e=25844e23a8)

My Dear Friend, When I tell people my story, I hear the same things over and over again:“That’s crazy.” “I don’t believe that.” “That can’t be.”But if you’ve heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or Fox News, then you know it’s horribly true. My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son **James** in the photo above.I’ve spent the last decade fighting tooth-and-nail to keep school counselors, my ex-wife, and activist judges from “transitioning” **James** against my will. If you didn’t know, “transitioning” is the LGBTQ+ industry’s euphemism for sex change surgery or the chemical castration of a child.And if these radicals get their way, my son will be sterilized, traumatized, and dependent on Big Pharma for the rest of his life.This all started ten years ago when my ex-wife began telling me our two-year-old boy **James **wanted to become a girl.I ignored her and kept dressing my son in boy’s clothes. Because he’s a boy!But then I found out that after dropping him off at school, the school counselor would change him into girl’s clothes WITHOUT TELLING ME.The counselors and teachers also began calling him a different name, “Luna,” at school. Also without telling me!I assumed I’d be able to stop this madness during the custody hearings with my ex-wife. Instead, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.I would only be allowed to see James if I dressed him in girl’s clothes.My friend, I’ve never lied to my sons.And I’m not about to start now. So I was forced to stop visiting him.And then I began the fight of my life to save James from this evil “trans” culture.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers.I even authored a bill to outlaw sex change surgeries for minors in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee.And spent almost every dollar I had to make sure politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair.After I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, my ex-wife fled with **James** to California: a “trans sanctuary” state. I think you know exactly what happened once she got to California.A radical judge sided with my ex-wife and gave the greenlight to proceed with chemically castrating my son.I have never felt so helpless in my life. I am James’s father – yet I can’t protect him from the powerful LGBTQ+ activists who are using my ex-wife and our kangaroo court systems to turn my son into the poster child for their twisted and perverted agenda.I’ve watched the school system, my ex-wife, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.In fact, I can’t even appeal my case because the judge sealed the court records. I’d have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process.Worst of all, I am under a gag order to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Technically, my writing you this to you today is illegal.But I didn’t hesitate for one second to write it. If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time.But I’m not just some activist.I’m a father trying to save his son from the Left’s madness and butchery.This is what happens when you go up against the $6 BILLION “trans lobby” and radical activist judges.They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees...They’re trying to break my spirit...But I refuse to ever stop fighting for my son... for truth... and for what’s right. Because I don’t want this to ever happen to another family.These radical LGBTQ+ doctors, lawyers and judges need to be stopped...They need to be held accountable...And **James** needs to be **saved** before he’s permanently butchered.That’s why I’m writing to you today.When Patriots Legal Defense Fund (PLDF) heard about my case, they immediately offered to stand with me and fight this insanity.PLDF has been on the frontlines defending innocent J6ers targeted by the Biden DOJ.And when they heard about my case, they told me they’d help in any way possible.The fact is, this transgender madness is affecting all of our children and grandchildren. It’s in their schools. In the books in their libraries. Pediatricians are asking five-year-olds if they “feel like they’re in the wrong body” during routine doctor visits.This is madness. And it’s got to stop.If you want to help save my son **James **from castration and make sure this will NEVER happen to ANY child ever again... And if you want to send a message to these radical judges that their day of reckoning has come... name: Justice Democrats
subject: Tell Congress to stop weaponizing the military against immigrants
body:
Sign our petition telling Congress that tax dollars allocated to the U.S. military must not power Trump’s deportation machine.
#
Peter,
Donald Trump’s far-right administration is **weaponizing the Department of Defense to detain and deport undocumented immigrants** – a misuse of billions of taxpayer dollars that will have devastating consequences.
**[Fight back NOW: sign the petition to oppose this →](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140610?t=2&akid=36402%2E1203867%2Egz7YVA)**
We’ve already seen Trump lift the ban on ICE raids in sensitive places – schools, courthouses, places of worship – and threaten to detain tens of thousands of immigrants in Guantanamo Bay. Using the military for deportations is another way he is ratcheting up his cruel, anti-immigrant agenda across the country.
Not only is this morally wrong, it is deeply unpopular. A recent Axios-Ipsos poll revealed that 62 percent of people across ALL parties oppose using money allocated to the U.S. military to pay for deportation efforts.
Despite this, **the Trump administration has already begun to use aircraft and intelligence systems and deploy troops to strengthen a deportation machine** capable of devastating millions of lives.
We must come together as a movement to stand up for justice and end this abuse of government resources. Together, we can push Congress – _Democrats and Republicans alike_ – to block taxpayer funds allocated for military operations from being used to target undocumented immigrants.
**That’s why Justice Democrats is joining Win Without War and progressive organizations from across the country to tell Congress tax dollars allocated to the U.S. military must not power Trump’s deportation machine.**
**[Can you add your name to our petition to stop this disgusting misuse of government resources?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140610?t=3&akid=36402%2E1203867%2Egz7YVA)**
**[Add Your Name](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140610?t=4&akid=36402%2E1203867%2Egz7YVA)**
Thank you for making your voice heard.
In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

Yesterday was a historic day -- President Trump signed an executive order protecting girls sports nationwide yesterday and invited me to join him at the White House to celebrate.
It was surreal to be in the East Room celebrating such an enormous victory -- primarily because I know how far this movement has come.
I am not exaggerating when I say that when my team and I began working on this issue over 6 years ago, no politician wanted to talk about it, let alone champion legislation on it.
But that's the thing that makes President Trump special. He isn't afraid to take on big challenges for important causes -- and protecting America's daughters is quite important.

Hi Peter — I
want to take a moment to share a story about my very first campaign.

Back in 1997, when I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin, no one thought I
could win — especially when an extremely popular challenger entered the
race.

I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time. She said, “Well,
Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s going to
be tough.”

I looked her right in the eye and asked, “Do you think I should wait my
turn?”

And then I said: I believe that women have to run and not wait our turn —
especially when it’s hard. We can’t wait until we get a tap on our
shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere.

Defying the odds, I ended up winning that race and became the very first
woman elected to the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And that was
just the first time our team would make history.

When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots
supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us
off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the Senate from our
state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.

In 2018 and again last year, despite being a top target for national
Republicans and facing millions of dollars of negative ads and attacks,
you stood with me and we won again.

I’m used to being written off,
Peter. But time and again,
grassroots supporters like you have helped us defy the odds. Because here
we are again, fighting back against the Trump administration’s extreme
policies that hurt our families.

We have our work cut out for us. Trump has already issued over forty
executive orders to roll back our progress and cause chaos for millions of
Americans.

But we’ve already succeeded in fighting back, and if we stick together, I
know we can reject the MAGA extremism.

And next year, we can defy the odds once again and flip the Senate.

**FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ** Dear friend, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Peter Willis,

Trump’s attacks on our independent media and basic right to freedom of
speech are growing by the day. But we will not be silent. We must
dissent!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21433?t=1060&akid=7658%2E5885482%2E-gb9mC ]Bernie is warning us

Bernie is sounding the alarm as Trump doubles down, coming after one news
outlet after the next when he doesn’t like their coverage. First it was
ABC, which settled a defamation case Trump brought for a shocking $16
million. Then he began taking clear steps to gut PBS and NPR. And now he’s
in settlement talks with CBS after suing when he didn’t like how 60
Minutes edited an interview with Kamala Harris.

It’s not hard to see what’s happening here and it's straight out of an
authoritarian playbook: Trump is coming after the First Amendment.

If Trump can silence anyone who dares to report the truth, he’ll be free
to spread all the lies and disinformation he likes. All while making

# SESSION BEGINS AT 10am
---
| Dear Hello The General Assembly usually gavels in at noon each weekday with the exception of Fridays.
Please be sure to tune in to the Virginia Senate Session tomorrow at 10am, instead of noon.
The only House bill coming up tomorrow on the Senate floor on third read is [HB1699](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vVVA6Op5xEyWYCemDzTRIhby-sLlCbNQTOs4u-6aTGLS-VhRg5O7_oPQptOIZmQAZ6ICsWCqFxDup_Ik5cR1HhxPEK_qTPJeVy5rUvpfngOf4qE4jVXnrrfgj9wDKsHrs5_inSCQBy5IjgZr1y3e3uYZhe2hSxt5dNQFqCDuABWe2eXlFbtT8XbN9W9uc8Pq&c=629Cfhsm3hhgGVjc0FwmdIucfcgg_dCR6oIMNJAG5FQIBdB2U7Vx5Q==&ch=S3N7Rr39eImryizAIdL6Zknq-AkhUJo4QHLaJqs7Rmqo-i6Ir_6sLw==). This is a bill to get rid of the tax exempt status of Confederacy organizations. Obviously this is a politically motivated move by Democrats, who are hell bent on continuing their false narrative about our history.
In my opinion, we either exempt all organizations or we don't exempt any organizations. The cherry picking needs to end.
Tomorrow's session will be heated as Democrats accuse Republicans of being racists for supporting a tax exempt status for Confederate organizations, like the Museum of the Confederacy, and Republicans push back on the false narrative.
If we're going to eliminate the tax exempt status for Confederate organizations, then we need to eliminate taxpayer money going to Planned Parenthood.
About 43% of Planned Parenthood revenues came from government reimbursements or grants in the 2014-2015 fiscal year. Out of the [$1.29 billion in total revenue](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vVVA6Op5xEyWYCemDzTRIhby-sLlCbNQTOs4u-6aTGLS-VhRg5O7_oPQptOIZmQA-2pyX6cOnizCwyZV7vb5aPa9zwHtR1s-F9rAQwUsJqiQCEamm_NTFsqUODa-RgF_-BP7f59ocRDB7hoXzQyGCsW4akTwuzrQaIX0JtM199OJ93cPAAKUha7x1irjT8k1TK9-nuTiGR0=&c=629Cfhsm3hhgGVjc0FwmdIucfcgg_dCR6oIMNJAG5FQIBdB2U7Vx5Q==&ch=S3N7Rr39eImryizAIdL6Zknq-AkhUJo4QHLaJqs7Rmqo-i6Ir_6sLw==), $553.7 million came from the government reimbursing Planned Parenthood for providing medical services covered by programs such as Medicaid or from government grants from the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). The remainder of revenues mostly come from donations (27%) and patient fees (24%).
Get your popcorn ready for the political theatre coming up on the Senate floor tomorrow.

Have a great weekend! For God and Country, Amanda Chase

body:

---
Fellow American, I want you to hear it from me first: **I'll be voting** _YES_** on RFK Jr., Tulsi Gabbard, and Kash Patel.**

_**WATCH MY FULL STATEMENT:**_

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=e69e2d009dbe41cbac1cff15b0f46f57&_e=d6l7KbzpJhpaBshoyMgV8LnVIZpohb3DQr6C7KROUK2d4uDcTnW2NAqeIiQAS4UczqQHFVBnFHhNhbwUvNCYTUledpIUW1mnulGte3so7Aqmm6sscoYixug52L9puiN3Z95pZTmwra92Ds-ZkplPiWg1vf6RPPuY5aZ1j-r7HsUXkuS9KEe_VTKSB-MKG38TMlsZd2kSv-b5suwhfN6gTb2Yb4xZddlsD6xvxOq5xdwhaRh2ctxAZjwQZ01HyyrOLdMBDkE-1HVjXmJ3-Pe_TfVhcmJDw-MjCqT8Hzfvx7lsayE9ytCfEX-gaoDupSjhAaU1ynmFfnYwswoV4MBU3goiR9Vsv8K3qp0QYadKYyLMoEa8SWEDHqfEyKTJhZNYwo91CnGQfq_xVXhD7lwdr4tctr5am84y--5RxJk3w3Q%3D)
The American people sent a clear message through the 2024 election results -- they want new, bold leadership, and that’s exactly what President Trump is bringing.

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Texas'** **population expected to top California in 20 years,** " Houston Chronicle's **Brian Rausch** -- "More homes were built in Texas last year than in any other state, [according to Realtor.com](https://substack.com/redirect/0c75254f-7294-497b-a13b-a9ae32206a6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the state is poised to become the nation's most populous in just two decades.

Texas' 225,601 residential building permits accounted for 15% of those in the U.S. in 2024, with Florida, California, North Carolina and Georgia rounding out the top five.

Meanwhile, the state's population -- [the fastest growing in the nation](https://substack.com/redirect/0c3a69a3-c286-4a8a-9623-5413fe14061f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- is expected to make Texas the most populous state in the country by 2045, according to the report by the Austin-based real estate website.

There were 31.3 million residents in Texas in July, up from 30.5 million a year earlier and 29.1 million in 2020, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. That's an almost 8% increase in just four years. For the 10 years ended in 2024, Texas added 3.9 million residents compared to 2.9 million in Florida.

Among the top reasons for the state's boom in population, according to Realtor.com, are Texas' climate, job opportunities and relatively affordable housing.

"The state has grown rapidly in the last several years as people from across the country and across the world have seen what Texas has to offer," said **Danielle Hale** , chief economist for Realtor.com.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/3f7551a3-96be-4332-aa5b-d7afd1a59c9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Here's what else we learned from the Realtor.com report, which relied on its own housing data and U.S. Census Bureau data from 2009 to 2023.

• More than 1 in 4 people shopping for homes in Texas are from out of state.
• More Californians (781,237) moved to Texas than residents of any other state.
• But more Texans (306,5341) moved to California than to any other state.
• Nearly 2 million people from outside the U.S. moved to Texas during the time period.

Newcomers to Texas will find about 47% of for-sale housing inventory priced at $350,000 or less, Realtor.com said, compared with 40% nationally. But as prices have risen, that reflects a smaller share of inventory at that level than in 2019.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/3f7551a3-96be-4332-aa5b-d7afd1a59c9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Jobs are also relatively plentiful. In the decade from 2013 to 2023, Texas added 2.5 million jobs, about 25% more than No. 2 Florida. Its unemployment rate, 4.2% in December, has been less than 5% for a decade, except for about a year and a half after the dawn of the pandemic.

"The Texas economy is a model for other states," said **Damian** **Eales** , CEO of Realtor.com. "Residents are attracted to Texas for its abundant jobs, available housing and favorable climate. This has put Texas on a path to potentially become the largest state by the year 2045."" TOP NEWS "Texas' population expected to top California in 20 years, " Houston Chronicle's Brian Rausch -- "More homes were built in Texas last year than in any other state, , and the state is poised to become the nation's most populous in just two decades. Texas' 225,601 residential building permits accounted for 15% of those in the U.S. in 2024, with Florida, California, North Carolina and Georgia rounding out the top five. Meanwhile, the state's population -- -- is expected to make Texas the most populous state in the country by 2045, according to the report by the Austin-based real estate website. There were 31.3 million residents in Texas in July, up from 30.5 million a year earlier and 29.1 million in 2020, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. That's an almost 8% increase in just four years. For the 10 years ended in 2024, Texas added 3.9 million residents compared to 2.9 million in Florida. Among the top reasons for the state's boom in population, according to Realtor.com, are Texas' climate, job opportunities and relatively affordable housing. "The state has grown rapidly in the last several years as people from across the country and across the world have seen what Texas has to offer," said Danielle Hale , chief economist for Realtor.com. Here's what else we learned from the Realtor.com report, which relied on its own housing data and U.S. Census Bureau data from 2009 to 2023. • More than 1 in 4 people shopping for homes in Texas are from out of state. • More Californians (781,237) moved to Texas than residents of any other state. • But more Texans (306,5341) moved to California than to any other state. • Nearly 2 million people from outside the U.S. moved to Texas during the time period. Newcomers to Texas will find about 47% of for-sale housing inventory priced at $350,000 or less, Realtor.com said, compared with 40% nationally. But as prices have risen, that reflects a smaller share of inventory at that level than in 2019. Jobs are also relatively plentiful. In the decade from 2013 to 2023, Texas added 2.5 million jobs, about 25% more than No. 2 Florida. Its unemployment rate, 4.2% in December, has been less than 5% for a decade, except for about a year and a half after the dawn of the pandemic. "The Texas economy is a model for other states," said Damian Eales , CEO of Realtor.com. "Residents are attracted to Texas for its abundant jobs, available housing and favorable climate. This has put Texas on a path to potentially become the largest state by the year 2045."" FREE SUBSCRIPTIONS HAVE ENDED : As of July 11, 2022, we have moved to a paywall for free subscribers. * **TOP NEWS**

"**Texas'** **population expected to top California in 20 years,** " Houston Chronicle's **Brian Rausch** -- "More homes were built in Texas last year than in any other state, [according to Realtor.com](https://substack.com/redirect/d30afe6e-26c6-4c24-80c1-5d1680bc0592?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the state is poised to become the nation's most populous in just two decades.

Texas' 225,601 residential building permits accounted for 15% of those in the U.S. in 2024, with Florida, California, North Carolina and Georgia rounding out the top five.

Meanwhile, the state's population -- [the fastest growing in the nation](https://substack.com/redirect/565913a6-7b32-4d5a-9ca1-03086b640f77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- is expected to make Texas the most populous state in the country by 2045, according to the report by the Austin-based real estate website.

There were 31.3 million residents in Texas in July, up from 30.5 million a year earlier and 29.1 million in 2020, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. That's an almost 8% increase in just four years. For the 10 years ended in 2024, Texas added 3.9 million residents compared to 2.9 million in Florida.

Among the top reasons for the state's boom in population, according to Realtor.com, are Texas' climate, job opportunities and relatively affordable housing.

"The state has grown rapidly in the last several years as people from across the country and across the world have seen what Texas has to offer," said **Danielle Hale** , chief economist for Realtor.com.

Here's what else we learned from the Realtor.com report, which relied on its own housing data and U.S. Census Bureau data from 2009 to 2023.

• More than 1 in 4 people shopping for homes in Texas are from out of state.
• More Californians (781,237) moved to Texas than residents of any other state.
• But more Texans (306,5341) moved to California than to any other state.
• Nearly 2 million people from outside the U.S. moved to Texas during the time period.

Newcomers to Texas will find about 47% of for-sale housing inventory priced at $350,000 or less, Realtor.com said, compared with 40% nationally. But as prices have risen, that reflects a smaller share of inventory at that level than in 2019.

Jobs are also relatively plentiful. In the decade from 2013 to 2023, Texas added 2.5 million jobs, about 25% more than No. 2 Florida. Its unemployment rate, 4.2% in December, has been less than 5% for a decade, except for about a year and a half after the dawn of the pandemic.

"The Texas economy is a model for other states," said **Damian** **Eales** , CEO of Realtor.com. "Residents are attracted to Texas for its abundant jobs, available housing and favorable climate. This has put Texas on a path to potentially become the largest state by the year 2045."" Peter—

While the Trump administration sows chaos at the national level, critical state-level battles continue for reproductive rights.******A groundbreaking fight is unfolding as a hospital system sues their state to protect patients' access to emergency abortion care for the first time ever.**

St. Luke's Health System, Idaho's largest healthcare provider, has filed a landmark lawsuit against the state Attorney General to challenge Idaho's total abortion ban.

Their argument? The abortion restrictions conflict with federal law requiring emergency medical care (EMTALA)—a similar argument [**the Center for Reproductive Rights brought to trial last November in _Adkins, et al. v. State of Idaho._**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101670548/526696966/1977185726?sourceid=1150385&utm_campaign=25emrge-0115aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=renewals&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzgxMmMwNi1iY2U0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_ro3oI5ZJwQxpc4E6Y9WRShlbspajfIPctTnqFskpYE=&emci=967747b4-f9e3-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=1c812c06-bce4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=954237)

The human cost of Idaho's ban is staggering:
* Idaho's abortion ban **threatens doctors with 2-5 years in prison** for providing abortion care, with no clear exceptions for protecting a patient’s health.
* St. Lukes reports the abortion ban "**makes it impossible to provide the highest standard of care** in some of the most heartbreaking situations."
* Pregnant people in Idaho are facing obstetric deserts, with some patients having to **travel more than 100 miles away to safely give birth.**

This case could create a powerful precedent for healthcare providers nationwide to challenge dangerous abortion restrictions. St. Luke's lawsuit offers new hope for protecting both patients and physicians.

[**The Center is ready to fight for reproductive rights across the country and around the world.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101670549/526696967/1474386068?sourceid=1150385&utm_campaign=25emrge-0115aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=renewals&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzgxMmMwNi1iY2U0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_ro3oI5ZJwQxpc4E6Y9WRShlbspajfIPctTnqFskpYE=&emci=967747b4-f9e3-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=1c812c06-bce4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=954237) **Don't forget to renew your support right now—your commitment today strengthens our ability to challenge these deadly restrictions wherever they arise.**

clean_body: Landmark case alert | | | ---|--- Peter— While the Trump administration sows chaos at the national level, critical state-level battles continue for reproductive rights.****A groundbreaking fight is unfolding as a hospital system sues their state to protect patients' access to emergency abortion care for the first time ever. St. Luke's Health System, Idaho's largest healthcare provider, has filed a landmark lawsuit against the state Attorney General to challenge Idaho's total abortion ban. Their argument? The abortion restrictions conflict with federal law requiring emergency medical care (EMTALA)—a similar argument The human cost of Idaho's ban is staggering: Idaho's abortion ban threatens doctors with 2-5 years in prison for providing abortion care, with no clear exceptions for protecting a patient’s health. St. Lukes reports the abortion ban "makes it impossible to provide the highest standard of care in some of the most heartbreaking situations." Pregnant people in Idaho are facing obstetric deserts, with some patients having to travel more than 100 miles away to safely give birth. This case could create a powerful precedent for healthcare providers nationwide to challenge dangerous abortion restrictions. St. Luke's lawsuit offers new hope for protecting both patients and physicians. Don't forget to renew your support right now—your commitment today strengthens our ability to challenge these deadly restrictions wherever they arise.** Onward! subject: First votes, townhalls and our March 31 goal

body:
I am energized, optimistic, and fully committed to battle.

| | | | |
---
| | | | | Friends,It was so cold on Inauguration Day that the proceedings had to move into the Capitol Rotunda. I was there to see the President sworn in and hundreds of Eastern Washington patriots joined me in DC for a day or two to take in the historical moment and celebrate!It was a joy to be surrounded by friends from back home, and to host a tour of the beautiful Library of Congress and the Capitol. If you couldn’t make it this time – mark your calendar for 2028 – because we need to keep our momentum going forward.
---
| _President Trump speaks to Congressional Members and their spouses underneath the Statue of Freedom in Emancipation Hall_
---
| _I am energized, optimistic, and fully committed to battle._ This past week I was back in Eastern Washington and held four listening townhall meetings – in the first four weeks! From Colville to Walla Walla and points in between – I heard from students, farmers, business owners, veterans and seniors.I’ll tell you what I heard:● People want a secure border and a stop to fentanyl pouring into the country.● They want to protect the dams, increase hydropower, and help farmers.● They want to cut regulations that throw sand in the gears of business and cost jobs.If you agree with this commonsense, Eastern Washington agenda, then please stand by me as I build towards success in 2026 – for myself and for Republicans throughout Washington state.[You can make a donation now as a sign of support for the first four weeks of the new Republican leadership – in the White House and in the Congress.](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=bf5a273319&e=5a45b9550e)In this first month, I voted for the Laken Riley Act – and it was signed into law to protect against foreign criminals. I also supported the Fix our Forests Act – a priority for our district, and also for me personally, since one of my first summer jobs was working for the US Forest Service. Both bills passed with some bipartisan support – gaining Democrat votes as well as Republican.There is a long, steep learning curve for me to know my way around Congress and master the key issues before the committees. I’ll never know more than you know – and never want to put my voice above yours. _You’re the boss! And, I’ll need your help as we move forward._ You may know, the general rule of thumb in politics is that the first re-election is the most difficult. **My goal is to raise at least $100,000 before the first quarterly fundraising deadline on March 31st.** I have eight more weeks to work toward that goal. [Would you chip in to help get us there?](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=71de5819e6&e=5a45b9550e)Thanks in advance for any support you can provide. I promise you that I’m keeping Eastern Washington’s priorities and values front of mind in considering each bill that comes before me as well as each vote. I love this job and it’s such an honor to be serving in Congress! Thank you!Sincerely,
---
| P.S. I have a lot to learn and want to share with you all that’s happening in the weeks and months ahead. [Please take a moment to make a contribution today.](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=1b83b2b324&e=5a45b9550e)

clean_body: Trump is making it clearer than ever before he doesn't care about rising costs for Americans (not even a little bit). Peter, Last week, Donald Trump announced a wave of new tariffs – a new 25% tax on goods coming from Canada and Mexico. Our allies fought back with tariffs of their own – and now, thankfully, these tariffs are on a one-month hold. But these onerous taxes still loom in our future, and we need to fully understand what they mean for everyday Americans. If Donald Trump’s tariffs ever take effect, Americans can expect skyrocketing prices at the grocery store, higher costs for everyday goods, and more financial strain on working families. This is not what real leadership looks like. As a mom, Kim knows how important it is for families to be able to put food on the table and keep up with the rising cost of living. **Tip #1: Start NOW**
Look, I know you’re exhausted. Just about everyone I know is. The outcome of this last election was heartbreaking, and the constant flow of mis- and disinformation online and in the media definitely didn’t help.
But putting politics on a shelf isn’t going to help anyone. It might just make things worse.
In these first few months of his second term, Trump and his MAGA cronies are counting on us to be so done with politics that we won’t pay attention while they cram their agenda down our throats.
That’s why NextGen is working RIGHT NOW to engage young voters and help them fight back. Defeating extremism is going to take time. **So we have to make every second count.**
**Tip #2: Don’t get distracted**
One of the far-right’s favorite tactics is to spew hate speech and vitriol any time they want to distract us from their plan to take over. And it keeps working.
As tempting as it is to respond to each and every horrible thing Trump does, we can’t let ourselves get distracted from the big picture. _We have to stay focused._
We’re fighting for a working economy. We’re defending our fundamental rights. We’re upholding equality and preserving the progress we’ve fought long and hard for.
**Your reasons for being part of this movement are more important than any temper tantrum Trump throws. Don’t lose faith.**
**Tip #3: Know your strengths**
In moments like this, there are countless ways to make an impact. And whether they’re marching in Washington or holding their elected officials accountable, young voters are leading the charge against MAGA extremism.
Team, I’m so grateful that the Youth Movement has this network of grassroots supporters ready to help save our democracy. **We’re facing the biggest threat to our fight for progress right now.** [So please, can I count on you to chip in $5 right now and help the Youth Vote resist extremism?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101671665/526700393/171324239?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS85OTMyMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZmZlN2ZmOS1iY2U0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gn706qoQd_e5ux-462BQmtZuSwhQeYOqjnA746WrAqQ=&emci=d8329080-b9e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=5ffe7ff9-bce4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=6787172)

clean_body: | Hey team, Emily here from NextGen’s comms team. Nice to meet you! I’ve been in the political space for a while and have no shortage of experience leading folks in a crisis. There’s no bigger crisis right now than Donald Trump’s attacks on our democracy. So today, I want to share some advice that could make all the difference as we navigate Trump’s presidency. | Tip #1: Start NOW Look, I know you’re exhausted. Just about everyone I know is. The outcome of this last election was heartbreaking, and the constant flow of mis- and disinformation online and in the media definitely didn’t help. But putting politics on a shelf isn’t going to help anyone. It might just make things worse. In these first few months of his second term, Trump and his MAGA cronies are counting on us to be so done with politics that we won’t pay attention while they cram their agenda down our throats. That’s why NextGen is working RIGHT NOW to engage young voters and help them fight back. Defeating extremism is going to take time. So we have to make every second count. Tip #2: Don’t get distracted One of the far-right’s favorite tactics is to spew hate speech and vitriol any time they want to distract us from their plan to take over. And it keeps working. As tempting as it is to respond to each and every horrible thing Trump does, we can’t let ourselves get distracted from the big picture. We have to stay focused. We’re fighting for a working economy. We’re defending our fundamental rights. We’re upholding equality and preserving the progress we’ve fought long and hard for. Your reasons for being part of this movement are more important than any temper tantrum Trump throws. Don’t lose faith. Tip #3: Know your strengths In moments like this, there are countless ways to make an impact. And whether they’re marching in Washington or holding their elected officials accountable, young voters are leading the charge against MAGA extremism. Team, I’m so grateful that the Youth Movement has this network of grassroots supporters ready to help save our democracy. We’re facing the biggest threat to our fight for progress right now. | | | | | | In solidarity, Slatkow Communications Director NextGen PAC | Paid for by NextGen Climate Action Committee; ; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. | = |
