We're going to keep updating this, folks, because we can't lose sight of what's happening or let Congress treat this as a "one protest and done" issue.
Elon Musk's private citizens at DOGE now have access to Medicare and Medicaid payment data [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/doge-aides-search-medicare-agency-payment-systems-fraud-wsj-reports-2025-02-05/] . This comes on top of these unvetted, non-government employees showing up at the headquarters of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) to access their IT infrastructure [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/feb/04/doge-noaa-headquarters] and try to fulfill one of the goals of Project 2025, privatizing the government weather data that we all rely on so these private companies can charge us for it.
We MUST keep up the pressure: Call your member of Congress via the switchboard at (202) 224-3121 or find their direct number for the House [https://www.house.gov/representatives/find-your-representative#:~:text=If%20you%20know%20who%20your,the%20U.S.%20House%20switchboard%20operator.] or Senate [https://www.senate.gov/senators/index.htm] . Call their state or district offices if you don't get an answer in DC. Ask them if they support the President taking these actions and if Congress has given up checks and balances and their constitutional authority.
If you haven't been following this, there's a lot more information below, but -- voting rights or not -- it's on us to stand up for the country and government we deserve.
Onward,
The Voter Action Project Team
Interested in supporting our work defending our fundamental right to vote? If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=020625_2&amount=15]
This crisis is expanding, folks, not receding. We guess you could call what's happened at USAID, Treasury, and OPM a "successful beta test" in the eyes of the illegal DOGE operation.
Elon Musk's team of private citizens continued their assault on agencies, now turning their attention to the Department of Education [https://thehill.com/homenews/education/5125069-department-of-education-trump-musk-doge/] . The acolytes at DOGE are reportedly probing data from the department while it puts dozens of employees on administrative leave, looking to gut the agency even though it would take an act of Congress to shut it down.
Many members of Congress posted videos yesterday, saying their phone lines were jammed. Our message is getting through to them and we need to keep it up!
We're asking again: Call your member of Congress via the switchboard at (202) 224-3121 or find their direct number for the House [https://www.house.gov/representatives/find-your-representative#:~:text=If%20you%20know%20who%20your,the%20U.S.%20House%20switchboard%20operator.] or Senate [https://www.senate.gov/senators/index.htm] . Call their state or district offices if you don't get an answer in DC. Ask them if they support the President taking these actions and if Congress has given up checks and balances and their constitutional authority.
We know -- none of this directly impacts voting rights. However, the implications of these sweeping and illegal actions seem like the tip of the iceberg -- which is why we're not letting this go or turning away just because it's not our main mission. Our democracy is forged by all of us , so we must fight on these other issues before DOGE turns it's focus onto our fundamental rights, like voting.
Sincerely,
The Voter Action Project Team
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=020625_2&amount=25]
If you've been watching events unfold this weekend, folks, then you know what we're talking about. If not, here's an overview:
Elon Musk's team of private citizens gained access to the Treasury Department's classified payment system [https://apnews.com/article/donald-trump-elon-musk-doge-treasury-5e26cc80fcb766981cea56afd57ae759] . Musk's "DOGE" team -- filled with non-federal employees and not a department created by Congress or presidential commission created legally -- is now reportedly "turning off" payments Congress approved, line by line. Reportedly the "engineers" accessing these systems are former Musk company interns [https://www.wired.com/story/elon-musk-government-young-engineers/] .
Federal workers blockade the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) [https://dcmediagroup.us/2025/02/02/federal-workers-block-doors-of-admin-building-over-elon-musk-data-breach/] . These workers spent the weekend protesting outside OPM after Musk's team accessed potentially classified data there as well. They reportedly blocked more "data miners" from "DOGE" from getting in the building and taking more information on hard drives.
Now Musk and Trump are trying to illegally shut down USAID [https://apnews.com/article/trump-musk-usaid-c0c7799be0b2fa7cad4c806565985fe2] , the U.S. Agency for International Development. USAID was created by Congress in 1961 as a way for the United States to aid allies around the world. USAID employees were reportedly told to not come to work and USAID's grants around the world have apparently been turned off. Presidents can only be granted "reorganization authority" to close or consolidate agencies by act of Congress , which was last granted to Ronald Reagan decades ago.
None of these things directly impact voting rights. But we're terrified by the implications of these sweeping and illegal actions -- likely just the tip of the iceberg -- so we're putting aside our plans for today to ask you to act. We all need to demand that Congress do their jobs , find out what's going on, walk down to these departments and knock on the door and demand answers.
Please: Call your member of Congress via the switchboard at (202) 224-3121 or find their direct number for the House [https://www.house.gov/representatives/find-your-representative#:~:text=If%20you%20know%20who%20your,the%20U.S.%20House%20switchboard%20operator.] or Senate [https://www.senate.gov/senators/index.htm] . Call their state offices if you don't get an answer in DC. Ask them if they support the President taking these actions and if Congress has given up separations of powers. No one else can hold them accountable, so we must do the hard work of our democracy before too much harm is done.
Sincerely,
The Voter Action Project Team

Gov. J.B. Pritzker and Mayor Brandon Johnson talk to reporters on Aug. 30, 2023. (Antonio Perez/ Chicago Tribune)
By Illinois Review

On Friday, the U.S. Department of Justice filed a federal lawsuit in the Northern District of Illinois against Democratic officials including Gov. JB Pritzker, Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson, Cook County Board President Tony Preckwinkle and Cook County Sheriff Tom Dart – alleging that Illinois ‘”sanctuary city” laws “interfere” and limit federal law enforcement’s ability to deport dangerous migrants.

“We’ve identified Illinois, the city of Chicago and Cook County as all having laws and ordinances on the books that impede federal immigration enforcement, in particular the Chicago Welcoming ordinance, the Illinois Trust Act,” said a Justice Department official to the New York Post.

The lawsuit cites examples where local laws “restrict local governments from sharing immigration information with federal law enforcement officials.” And in an unsettling statement, the suit states that “instead of handing over people who are in prison or in jail to federal immigration authorities they will just let folks go.”

President Donald Trump, who still owns Trump National Hotel and Tower in Chicago, has kept a close eye on the ‘Windy City.’ And as a senior DoJ official noted, “This lawsuit will put the spotlight on obstruction by state and local officials and their refusal to support the administration and compliance with the law.”

| Hi Peter, I’m Blake Gendebien.

I’m a husband, father, dairy farmer, and business owner who was born and raised in the North Country.

I’m excited to announce that I’m running for Congress here in New York’s 21st District.

[Will you split $10 between my campaign and Ritchie Torres today to help us kickstart our campaign and flip this seat in the special election? »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101673915/526707190/-1137810903?amount=10&refcode=RTFC_20250206_EMSPL_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OWJiYjNjNi1jMGU0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jz7p18Se5Wds5uw4LWSm1ADPVdBtUpBzSsmwx6RIxf8=) | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101673916/526707191/-1137810903?amount=10&amounts=10,25,50,100&refcode=RTFC_20250206_EMSPL_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OWJiYjNjNi1jMGU0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jz7p18Se5Wds5uw4LWSm1ADPVdBtUpBzSsmwx6RIxf8=)

After serving in the Peace Corps, my parents moved to the North Country and started a dairy farm. I grew up working on the farm, earned a degree in agriculture, and later worked for a farm equipment manufacturer. For the past 22 years, with my family, I have owned and operated Twin Mill Farms, which currently has over 1,000 acres of land, 500 cows, and 12 employees.

Now, I’ve decided to run for Congress because the North Country is a national treasure and has been overlooked for far too long. It’s time for us to get the representation we deserve in Washington.

My experience as a farm owner, serving as Vice Chair on the Agri-Mark Board of Directors, and co-founding the Jules of Life Foundation – a nonprofit that assists patients and families battling cancer – has given me deep roots in our community.

**But this campaign isn’t about me; it’s about all of us.** It’s about all of the farmers, business owners, workers, families, teachers, coaches, and community members here in the North Country. I’m not running for Congress as a stepping stone to political power. I’m running because this is an opportunity to fight for the North Country, and I understand the challenges that folks here are facing.

name: David Shadburn, LCV
subject: TAKE ACTION: Oppose Trump’s dangerous nominee for OMB
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTIwOTUxNTES1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjE2MDA5MzMxMAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
This is important, Peter, Just last week, President Trump’s Office of Management and Budget (OMB) moved to illegally cut fundingfor all federal programs, grants, and aid programs. This includes disaster
unemployment assistance, clean air monitoring, safe drinking water, low-income
home energy assistance, and so much more, creating chaos and harming people in
every state. Tens of thousands of supporters like you stepped up and spoke out,
and it made the Trump administration stumble and try to do damage control. With momentum on our side, we need to press ahead to block the root cause. This didn’t come out of nowhere, Peter. All of these extreme plans are
laid out in Project 2025, and their chief architect is Russell Vought, Trump’s
nominee for Director of OMB. We cannot let him get confirmed. Senators are holding the floor right now to stop this confirmation — join us in sending a message to your senators supporting that fight and urging them to oppose the confirmation of Russell Vought for Director of OMB. https://links.messages.lcv. Vought is not fit for this office, plain and simple. His goal is to use OMB, a
powerful agency within the White House that develops and executes the
president’s budget and oversees policy implementation across federal agencies,
to hollow out the ability of the government to help our communities by any means
necessary, so that his billionaire cronies can get even richer. He pushes fringe legal theories that claim the president has the right to
withhold funds for programs that help working families (spoiler alert, that’s
illegal). He has proposed cutting the budget for the EPA by as much as 30%, and
once said of EPA “We want their funding to be shut down so that the EPA can’t do
all of the rules against our energy industry because they have no bandwidth
financially to do so.” He has already revived his illegal effort from the end of President Trump’s
first term to strip civil service protections from tens of thousands of federal
workers, known as “Schedule F” or “Schedule Career/Policy,” with the goal of replacing career professionals with extreme Trump loyalists who would steamroll
objective concerns, such as science showing the harmful public health impact of
certain pollutants.And he is well known for his contempt for civil servants, even suggesting that
he wants to put them “in trauma.” This is as terrible as it sounds — and should be disqualifying. Russell Vought
is a dangerous, self-described Christian nationalist ideologue who wants to
permanently damage federal environmental protections for his billionaire
buddies. The cuts he has repeatedly proposed threaten the air we breathe, the
water we drink, and affordable clean energy that will help prevent catastrophic
climate change. This extreme agenda would harm communities across the country
with Vought at the helm of OMB. Don’t let that happen, Peter — Urge your senators to vote against Vought for the Office of Management and Budget and protect our communities, our environment, and our future. https://links.messages.lcv. Thank you for being with us. Onward, David Shadburn
Senior Government Affairs Advocate, Climate Change & Clean Energy

This is important, Peter, Just last week, President Trump’s Office of Management and Budget (OMB) moved to illegally cut fundingfor all federal programs, grants, and aid programs. This includes disaster unemployment assistance, clean air monitoring, safe drinking water, low-income home energy assistance, and so much more, creating chaos and harming people in every state. Tens of thousands of supporters like you stepped up and spoke out, and it made the Trump administration stumble and try to do damage control. With momentum on our side, we need to press ahead to block the root cause. This didn’t come out of nowhere, Peter. All of these extreme plans are laid out in Project 2025, and their chief architect is Russell Vought, Trump’s nominee for Director of OMB. We cannot let him get confirmed. Senators are holding the floor right now to stop this confirmation — join us in sending a message to your senators supporting that fight and urging them to oppose the confirmation of Russell Vought for Director of OMB. Vought is not fit for this office, plain and simple. His goal is to use OMB, a powerful agency within the White House that develops and executes the president’s budget and oversees policy implementation across federal agencies, to hollow out the ability of the government to help our communities by any means necessary, so that his billionaire cronies can get even richer. He pushes fringe legal theories that claim the president has the right to withhold funds for programs that help working families (spoiler alert, that’s illegal). He has proposed cutting the budget for the EPA by as much as 30%, and once said of EPA “We want their funding to be shut down so that the EPA can’t do all of the rules against our energy industry because they have no bandwidth financially to do so.” He has already revived his illegal effort from the end of President Trump’s first term to strip civil service protections from tens of thousands of federal workers, known as “Schedule F” or “Schedule Career/Policy,” with the goal of replacing career professionals with extreme Trump loyalists who would steamroll objective concerns, such as science showing the harmful public health impact of certain pollutants.And he is well known for his contempt for civil servants, even suggesting that he wants to put them “in trauma.” This is as terrible as it sounds — and should be disqualifying. Russell Vought is a dangerous, self-described Christian nationalist ideologue who wants to permanently damage federal environmental protections for his billionaire buddies. The cuts he has repeatedly proposed threaten the air we breathe, the water we drink, and affordable clean energy that will help prevent catastrophic climate change. This extreme agenda would harm communities across the country with Vought at the helm of OMB. Don’t let that happen, Peter — Urge your senators to vote against Vought for the Office of Management and Budget and protect our communities, our environment, and our future. Not the one that’s home to the Nets in New York, but Brooklyn, Illinois, “America’s First Black Town.” Brooklyn was a key outpost on the Underground Railroad and became a beacon in the north for those escaping slavery and the Jim Crow South. body:

Unsubscribe

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sra4ca&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6da2s3smh1uobcj6czpvxya0t2ypl83pw5pddacc55g1hr3i2yknps23qk2lydmhzyg4ka78ws7i6u0k3eopaygutyscrh760feunktt865j0yqhpkl4gd2pkssag4nvmmsal99xdnx0o2exbuxbl&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sra4ca&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sra4ca&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sra4ca&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sra4ca&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_em-25q1?refcode=em_250206_BHM_act_a&refcode2=x_020625_BHM [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_em-25q1?refcode=em_250206_BHM_act_a&refcode2=x_020625_BHM]
Peter,
Black History Month is about celebrating the beauty, creativity, innovation, resilience, and endless contributions of Black people. And while we are proud to honor our past and inspire our future, we also recognize that our history and progress are under attack.
Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and others in the highest levels of our government are actively working to erase our stories by banning books, whitewashing slavery, and pretending the Civil Rights Movement wasn’t met with brutal violence. They want to rewrite history to protect their power — but we won’t let them.
That’s why, this month, Politivist Action PAC is honoring some of our nation’s greatest Black leaders and champions, people who fought for justice and changed the course of history.
Today, we honor Donna Jean Barksdale , who, at just 11 years old in 1955, became one of the first Black students to integrate an all-white school in Arkansas.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_em-25q1?refcode=em_250206_BHM_act_a&refcode2=x_020625_BHM [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_em-25q1?refcode=em_250206_BHM_act_a&refcode2=x_020625_BHM]
Think about that. It’s only been 70 years since Black children were first allowed to even sit in the same classroom as white children. Never let anyone tell you Black history doesn’t matter.
And yet, here we are in 2024 — watching Donald Trump and his cronies try to erase history right in front of our eyes. Banning Black authors. Dismissing the reality of systemic racism. Trying to drag us backward.
But, Peter: Black history is American history. And no matter how hard they try, they can’t erase us. They can’t silence us. And they most definitely can’t stop us.
This month, let’s honor our ancestors by telling their stories loudly , lifting up the next generation of leaders, and making sure the sacrifices of those who came before us were not in vain.
Who is a Black leader or champion — past or present — who inspires you? Maybe it’s a historic figure or someone close to home. Click here and let us know. We’d love to honor them this month. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/0DpboqGwWkynbE7ygONJlg2]
And remember Peter: History remembers the fighters. Let’s keep fighting.
In solidarity,
Cori Bush
Founder, Politivist Action PAC

This could be the end. https://click.updates.marshablackburn.com/?qs=629a6c4c405df2fe27876ba6f755f9d9fffe8bf61863f483e06549d7bee7e1edf5283448947b78fa350533f0efb709c318a8e232de0aa70cd668b773466f5cad RUSH EMERGENCY SUPPORT I really hate that I’m having to bother you with this, but you’ve been such an important supporter of my campaign that I wanted you to hear the truth directly from me. In order to try and defeat us, they’re pulling out all the stops. They’re making the calls to all the national Democrats and liberal fat cats. They’re fundraising and strategizing for how to TAKE DOWN our America First agenda once and for all. 3. Meanwhile, I’m way behind pace to reach my make-or-break fundraising goal before our MAJOR deadline. We can’t afford to start the year out on this note! https://click.updates.marshablackburn.com/?qs=629a6c4c405df2fe27876ba6f755f9d9fffe8bf61863f483e06549d7bee7e1edf5283448947b78fa350533f0efb709c318a8e232de0aa70cd668b773466f5cad RUSH EMERGENCY SUPPORT I know you’ve already done so much for this campaign, but if you can find it in your heart to pitch in ONCE MORE before our deadline, it would mean the world to me and go a long way in my fight to protect our America First priorities! I’m really hoping I can count on your help, Peter. No gift is too small right now. Anything you can give helps me inch closer to our make-or-break goal. https://click.updates.marshablackburn.com/?qs=629a6c4c405df2fe27876ba6f755f9d9fffe8bf61863f483e06549d7bee7e1edf5283448947b78fa350533f0efb709c318a8e232de0aa70cd668b773466f5cad So please, help me get back on track. I’m fresh from the House floor, where I took to for the first time to call out House leadership on their inability – or outright refusal – to allow lawmakers to vote on a bill to lower costs for Americans. After all, that’s what we were elected to do.

I also introduced a tracker that I will continue to post on my social media channels every day until we vote on substantive legislation that will make a difference for constituents struggling with sticker shock at the grocery stores and gas pumps.
I’ll keep fighting for you and your wallet.

body:
Derek, last night, I spoke on the Senate floor to prevent the GOP-controlled Senate from voting for Russell Vought’s confirmation.
Turn on C-SPAN if you want to tune in—my Democratic colleagues and I will be here until tonight revealing why Vought is a dangerous, disastrous pick to run the Office of Management and Budget.
In the meantime, if you can, split a donation between Tim Kaine's Common Ground PAC and my re-election campaign to fuel our work in the Senate to hold nominees like Vought accountable >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-warner]
Vought said he wants to “traumatize the federal workforce.” Those are his OWN WORDS. He wants to wake up every day believing that our federal workers are the villains in this story.
Frankly, I can’t think of anything more traumatic than what our federal workforce has already gone through since Trump took office. Unfortunately, Vought can, and he wrote all about it in Project 2025.
It couldn’t be more obvious that Vought is a clear and present danger to our country.
But since Republicans would rather pledge blind loyalty to Trump than admit that’s the case, I went to the Senate floor to try and show them the truth and stop his confirmation in its tracks.
I pledge to always fight in Washington to make the lives of all Virginians and Americans safer, healthier, and stronger. That means doing everything in my power to stop Vought from being confirmed. Will you split a donation between Common Ground PAC and my re-election campaign so we can fight back against the Trump administration every step of the way? Thank you,
Mark Warner

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8287%2E5257348%2Egu57-a ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Late last night, I held the Senate floor for an hour,
Derek, as part
of a 30 hour effort (the maximum under Senate rules) to slow down the
nomination of Russell Vought.

We need to take every action we can to try and stop the nominations of
these terrible candidates and make the case against them with the American
people. That’s why it was so important to protest Russell Vought’s
nomination for director of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) — the
government office that helps the President manage the federal budget and
the Executive Branch — yes, that one.

Just last week, OMB was responsible for freezing all federal funding and
loans. Something that Russ Vought defended and helped dream up under
Project 2025.

And while daytime has now come, the chaos Donald Trump and Elon Musk have
unleashed is still unfolding.

A mother in the Central Valley is waking up, still unsure how she’ll get
medical care for her child now that a federal grant for her community’s
only health center is in limbo.

A federal career employee is facing another day of uncertainty, wondering
how they’ll make rent if they’re laid off.

Around the world, people are grappling with the reality that U.S.
humanitarian aid — often their very last lifeline — has disappeared.

If my constituents are awake at night, fearing Donald Trump and Elon
Musk’s next actions, then I damn sure will be taking every action to fight
back – no matter what time it is.

Donald Trump is trying to obliterate all checks and balances, and
Republicans seem content to let him do it. He’s filling his Cabinet with
enablers who will let him subvert the rule of law, including Russ Vought,
who wrote the Project 2025 agenda Trump is now enacting.

They are engineering chaos. Not as a byproduct, but as a deliberate
strategy.

By overwhelming us with a storm of unconstitutional executive orders,
illegal data seizures, and purges of government officials, they hope to
paralyze us into inaction and dismantle the checks and balances that
protect democracy.

The goal? Consolidate power in the hands of Donald Trump and his
billionaire allies so they can plunder the resources of this country for
themselves. And they will succeed — unless we do everything possible to
stop them.

Speaker Mike Johnson will help Trump seize control of government spending
— congressional authority be damned — if it will help advance the
right-wing agenda of dismantling the government.

With the current composition of the Supreme Court and Justices like
Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito beholden to the same mega-donors set to
profit from Trump’s tax cuts — checks and balances be damned — they will
look the other way.

Our institutions are under siege. But we have a choice: Let Trump and his
enablers raid the Treasury for their own enrichment — or fight back.

That’s my fight in the Senate. That’s why I held the Senate Floor late
last night.

I will not let Donald Trump raid the till of the American people without
exposing, at every turn, who is robbing the bank. I will not let Trump
fill federal agencies with unqualified, dangerous extremists without
making clear the threats they pose and doing everything to stop them.

If we do nothing, if we let Trump install Russ Vought to dismantle
government from the inside, then we are complicit in the destruction that
follows.

clean_body: Brad Schimel does not think that a law from 1849 that would ban abortion is flawed. | = Peter, The New York Times has uncovered audio of Brad Schimel, the conservative candidate for Wisconsin's Supreme Court, openly prejudging the state's crucial abortion case. He declared that there is no constitutional right to abortion — and even defended the state's 1849 law banning abortion, saying he doesn't believe it's flawed. The majority of Wisconsinites disagree with Schimel. So why should he get to make decisions that strip them of their rights? Electing Judge Crawford could be our first major pro-choice victory of the year. = | = Schimel's record speaks for itself: he is a anti-choice politician, not a fair and impartial judge. As attorney general, he didn't just defend abortion restrictions — he helped design the strategy to dismantle reproductive rights nationwide. He played a leading role in the effort that successfully overturned Roe v. Wade and has spent his career making it harder for people to access the care they need. Now, he wants a seat on Wisconsin's highest court to keep pushing his extreme agenda. If he wins, he won't stop at abortion — he'll be a threat to our fundamental freedoms across the board. Hello, I know how overwhelming this moment feels. At every turn, it’s something worse. I don’t want to list the scariest and stupidest (which can also be scary) because you hear enough about the horrors in the news — Trump threatening to seize control of Gaza and push millions of Palestinians out, antagonizing our allies in Mexico and Canada with the dumbest trade war in recent history, even slashing long-standing international aid programs. All the while, he’s handing Elon Musk the keys to critical federal agencies and threatening payment systems that millions of people rely on. This is more than cruelty, it’s manufactured chaos. They want to throw us off balance by “flooding the zone” with so much bull that we feel like there’s no way out. But we know better. I’ve seen these tactics before. I turned 87 last year. I’ve lived through enough to know what’s at stake — and to know what’s possible when we come together. I remember what it was like to be in the vocal minority speaking out against the Vietnam War. I remember how it felt every time I’ve been arrested for civil disobedience. But I also remember this: When we organize, when we refuse to be silenced or to retreat into isolation, we can change the course of history. Trump’s return to office and the mainstreaming of MAGA extremism didn’t just come about out of nowhere. Neither will the resistance. We are girding our loins. You can see protestors outside the Treasury and USAID. Democratic members of Congress are stepping up, calling for town hall meetings with constituents. If you’re able, try to show up at town halls called by your electeds. From protesting, marching, and civil disobedience to electing brave leaders at every level of government who are willing to meet this moment, we’re in this for the long haul, and I’m honored to have you on our side. You have power. I have power. And together, we can be unstoppable. It won’t be easy, but now is not the time to give in. It’s time to dig in — not just to grieve, but to organize. Not just to be outraged, but to make your voice heard. The cost of doing nothing has never been higher. So we fight — for each other and for a future that belongs to us, not billionaires and strongmen. Let’s fight like hell. Make your voice heard. I’m right with you. — Jane Fonda [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101680422/526728944/2105508926?refcode=ea.936ecee1-cfe4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ms=ea.936ecee1-cfe4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkzNmVjZWUxLWNmZTQtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=f_jkBVy9sSnxkf2WOxsTn6mb5qKxMORW0rzxY6p2fLE=) P.S. I know that not everyone is able to support our work financially, and we never want you to feel pressure to do so. But if you are able, you can **[click here to make a contribution of any amount to help elect candidates at every level of government who will dig in and fight with us in the months and years ahead.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101680426/526728948/2105508926?refcode=ea.936ecee1-cfe4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ms=ea.936ecee1-cfe4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkzNmVjZWUxLWNmZTQtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=f_jkBVy9sSnxkf2WOxsTn6mb5qKxMORW0rzxY6p2fLE=)**

clean_body: We will resist. | Hello, I know how overwhelming this moment feels. At every turn, it’s something worse. I don’t want to list the scariest and stupidest (which can also be scary) because you hear enough about the horrors in the news — Trump threatening to seize control of Gaza and push millions of Palestinians out, antagonizing our allies in Mexico and Canada with the dumbest trade war in recent history, even slashing long-standing international aid programs. All the while, he’s handing Elon Musk the keys to critical federal agencies and threatening payment systems that millions of people rely on. This is more than cruelty, it’s manufactured chaos. They want to throw us off balance by “flooding the zone” with so much bull that we feel like there’s no way out. But we know better. I’ve seen these tactics before. I turned 87 last year. I’ve lived through enough to know what’s at stake — and to know what’s possible when we come together. I remember what it was like to be in the vocal minority speaking out against the Vietnam War. I remember how it felt every time I’ve been arrested for civil disobedience. But I also remember this: When we organize, when we refuse to be silenced or to retreat into isolation, we can change the course of history. Trump’s return to office and the mainstreaming of MAGA extremism didn’t just come about out of nowhere. Neither will the resistance. We are girding our loins. You can see protestors outside the Treasury and USAID. Democratic members of Congress are stepping up, calling for town hall meetings with constituents. If you’re able, try to show up at town halls called by your electeds. From protesting, marching, and civil disobedience to electing brave leaders at every level of government who are willing to meet this moment, we’re in this for the long haul, and I’m honored to have you on our side. You have power. I have power. And together, we can be unstoppable. It won’t be easy, but now is not the time to give in. It’s time to dig in — not just to grieve, but to organize. Not just to be outraged, but to make your voice heard. The cost of doing nothing has never been higher. So we fight — for each other and for a future that belongs to us, not billionaires and strongmen. Let’s fight like hell. Make your voice heard. I’m right with you. — Jane Fonda = P.S. I know that not everyone is able to support our work financially, and we never want you to feel pressure to do so. This photo used to be one of my favorites. I was so proud of my husband that day.Now looking at it makes me cry.Because the same city that gave Chance this award is trying to put him in prison **for life** for doing his job.**[That’s why I’m humbly asking you to help me save my husband.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=d2c1ffd96664412d880357aca3396788&_e=alHykA7CSKlPxkzJ3K4G94I-9BmNk-qdctO610To_faPTa_eOCtvnHrzL3baVgd4hCZyjY128ArbhTn5LVyENRvTbfggXtvdXVCxJHNlS0KV8lOyInSMOZlHiHwnAi1NSwl7jsH94NnmDHqL4wJc2O13e6LtzyCme78iuQJSo1yHnxCwVR0vUTW5Ahr4IXTPD_XDNrOF8Eks-Qvf8IQUvT5N1cvJMOIRhcpeJSJ9cG4BOd0kkoTfQV8I9OrvFAfJycVkT24CJ600DtY3v99NphI1OqQZNHP5bQnus5TpwbJ6yD7b7-MaASZ-j8Tvyhwqrw_vbESUpmDsC-Srczh_fuIY8dtJIRaA5KMAG9WOx1B8mRiLn_Op7MITC3Ryq325r-kfg6aKxP2RtYG8W9Pd6A%3D%3D)****** Friend, it wasn’t that long ago that Chance was a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department.When my husband and his partner were assigned to the Street Narcotics Unit, I was terrified. After all, they’re the ones who deal with violent drug cartels.But Chance was brave. He was willing to put his life in danger to keep our city safe. Little did we know the biggest threat Chance would face wasn’t a dangerous drug dealer......but a radical, Soros-funded prosecutor.You see, Chance was called in to help disperse violent protestors during the violent George Floyd riots in Austin in May 2020. The police department issued Chance a beanbag launcher because they are supposed to be effective without causing serious injury.So, when a rioter hurled rocks at police officers, Chance discharged two bean bags at him.Another protestor stepped in front of the rioter at the exact wrong moment and was struck in the hand. It was a freak accident – but because a cop fired the non-lethal weapon, it instantly becomes a felony to a Soros-backed prosecutor.That radical Soros-funded prosecutor charged my husband with FELONY ASSAULT.My husband did nothing wrong!But now he’s staring at life in prison. If Chance is convicted, I’ll never spend another wedding anniversary with my husband......Our young son and daughter will grow up without their dad.I admit, when Chance was charged, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair ... and back again. **I learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros.** That was when I realized that the anti-cop crowd is trying to make an example out of my husband. They’ll do everything in their power to make cops pay.It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But over 13 years ago, my husband did.And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran.My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band.He’s served on mission trips – planted churches, planning Vacation Bible Schools, and sharing the Gospel.And he’s done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record.Chance put his life on the line to protect his community countless times, and life behind bars could be his “reward.”And on top of that, his trial was postponed for **_a fifth time_** and pushed back to start July 7, 2025.Chance has had this charge hanging over his head for the past FIVE years and the trial will finally be his opportunity for justice.But even if my husband’s good name is cleared, there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills.That’s why I’m so thankful for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund and patriots who back the blue.Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes – like my husband.LELDF helps hire the best attorneys and secure expert witnesses who will testify to the truth – without being influenced by political paybacks.Friend, you’ve read my email this far so I’m going to ask as boldly as I can:**[**Will you help by sending a gift to LELDF to help defend my husband and the other good police officers who have been wrongly accused?**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=d2c1ffd96664412d880357aca3396788&_e=alHykA7CSKlPxkzJ3K4G94I-9BmNk-qdctO610To_faPTa_eOCtvnHrzL3baVgd4hCZyjY128ArbhTn5LVyENRvTbfggXtvdXVCxJHNlS0KV8lOyInSMOZlHiHwnAi1NSwl7jsH94NnmDHqL4wJc2O13e6LtzyCme78iuQJSo1yHnxCwVR0vUTW5Ahr4IXTPD_XDNrOF8Eks-Qvf8IQUvT5N1cvJMOIRhcpeJSJ9cG5x-EIWWxdrnDDMK7uYx1--BE7uU6gMZDwhloB4vsQRsPD1Un2hVZStxaXFj8DJ9Efxq2g1bbKbbSJaQJylctjt0fhJMLn4tH7DZWn3m5KttsLSuzYeNk-kEeLu10gjgVZriOJWVoQIr9yczJGD4o1nTAtQFKgqP7fx3RG08TEs8w%3D%3D)** Right now, Chance’s legal team is working day and night to prepare for his trial that starts on July 7, 2025. They know a good man’s life is at stake.But the legal bills are piling up.So with that in mind, please know that any contribution is tax-deductible.Please make your gift right away if possible. I can never express how grateful I am to you – in advance – for helping my husband.
---
With hope and thanks,
---
Kimberly Bretches
---

Now he could spend the rest of his life behind bars. To make things worse, we’re up against the deep pockets of a George Soros backed prosecutor in court – and we’re quickly running out of time. Chance’s trial was postponed to July 7, 2025, so we need to use these next few critical months to raise enough funds for his best defense.Please don’t let my three children grow up without their father, Friend. **[**Thank you for any help you can send to LELDF today.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=d2c1ffd96664412d880357aca3396788&_e=alHykA7CSKlPxkzJ3K4G94I-9BmNk-qdctO610To_faPTa_eOCtvnHrzL3baVgd4hCZyjY128ArbhTn5LVyENRvTbfggXtvdXVCxJHNlS0KV8lOyInSMOZlHiHwnAi1NSwl7jsH94NnmDHqL4wJc2O13e6LtzyCme78iuQJSo1yHnxCwVR0vUTW5Ahr4IXTPD_XDNrOF8Eks-Qvf8IQUvT5N1cvJMOIRhcpeJSJ9cG6KNDW2jYd3x3w2SEvtv9frUT1uMfCWVdnUGtF1C41TTnPkGR90vndTe3wmZ1hQWdHdzm0EZwseAZcI-M8wXY5W_qPWMCEWdxcX5KHxi4SYVWoLbyZ6usqEBTSe4v6dZzy2xzy8M0VQacoqEolRn4VDyX0bTb5aoW40GEMr8bOcHw%3D%3D)**

clean_body: Just recently, an LA Court ruled that my ex-wife is free to proceed with castrating my son James.| | | I don’t even know what my son looks like now. | | | | | | My Dear Friend, When I tell people my story, I hear the same things over and over again:“That’s crazy.” “I don’t believe that.” “That can’t be.”But if you’ve heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or Fox News, then you know it’s horribly true. My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son James in the photo above.I’ve spent the last decade fighting tooth-and-nail to keep school counselors, my ex-wife, and activist judges from “transitioning” James against my will. If you didn’t know, “transitioning” is the LGBTQ+ industry’s euphemism for sex change surgery or the chemical castration of a child.And if these radicals get their way, my son will be sterilized, traumatized, and dependent on Big Pharma for the rest of his life.This all started ten years ago when my ex-wife began telling me our two-year-old boy James wanted to become a girl.I ignored her and kept dressing my son in boy’s clothes. Because he’s a boy!But then I found out that after dropping him off at school, the school counselor would change him into girl’s clothes WITHOUT TELLING ME.The counselors and teachers also began calling him a different name, “Luna,” at school. Also without telling me!I assumed I’d be able to stop this madness during the custody hearings with my ex-wife. Instead, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.I would only be allowed to see James if I dressed him in girl’s clothes.My friend, I’ve never lied to my sons.And I’m not about to start now. So I was forced to stop visiting him.And then I began the fight of my life to save James from this evil “trans” culture.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers.I even authored a bill to outlaw sex change surgeries for minors in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee.And spent almost every dollar I had to make sure politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair.After I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, my ex-wife fled with James to California: a “trans sanctuary” state. I think you know exactly what happened once she got to California.A radical judge sided with my ex-wife and gave the greenlight to proceed with chemically castrating my son.I have never felt so helpless in my life. I am James’s father – yet I can’t protect him from the powerful LGBTQ+ activists who are using my ex-wife and our kangaroo court systems to turn my son into the poster child for their twisted and perverted agenda.I’ve watched the school system, my ex-wife, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.In fact, I can’t even appeal my case because the judge sealed the court records. I’d have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process.Worst of all, I am under a gag order to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Technically, my writing you this to you today is illegal.But I didn’t hesitate for one second to write it. If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time.But I’m not just some activist.I’m a father trying to save his son from the Left’s madness and butchery.This is what happens when you go up against the $6 BILLION “trans lobby” and radical activist judges.They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees...They’re trying to break my spirit...But I refuse to ever stop fighting for my son... for truth... and for what’s right. Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Thank you, Tommy Tuberville Meet Coach Tuberville: Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. Trump is targeting the Left's resources.
He's removing their ability to wage war.
Out of power, Democrat congressional members took to the streets this week to rally resistance-themed news conferences and protests outside federal agencies opposing President Trump's policies. However, their riots this season seems to be a bit off, a lot smaller and not as well organized as we've become used to seeing. Remember the color coordinated tents and t-shirts we saw last summer when pro-Palestinian protests broke out on college campuses across our nation? Well, not this time.
The reason Trump took over the U.S. Treasury's payment system and USAID is coming into focus more clearly every day. There will be no more taxpayer dollars flowing to organizations that directly oppose America's interests and that promotes violent demonstrations across the country.
We're living through a historical moment in time. Books will be written about this moment. What will it read about your efforts to stand up and speak up in support of the unmasking of decades of scams, fraud, and inefficiencies?
A restructuring of our nation and how things get done is taking place right now - expect a bumpy ride and stay safe.

Team, in 2020 it was Black Lives Matter.
In 2022 it was critical race theory.
In 2023 it was “wokeness.”
Now racists at every level of government are attacking Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiatives.
And we’re calling them racists because **when they say they’re anti-DEI, what they mean is anti-Black.**
The MAGA crowd’s overt racism is fully on display. And all the anti-DEI propaganda has turned into an overt attack on our civil rights. Decades of progress is being wiped out on a whim, and _we’re not going to let that slide._
[DEI is more than just a buzzword for the far-right to rile up their base. It’s the future of civil rights. We’re calling on our elected officials — at the federal AND state levels — to uphold our civil rights and prevent DEI initiatives from being dismantled. Add your name RIGHT NOW to join the fight.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101681863/526733613/-1226746010?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTU0MTNiYS1kNWU0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PtjEOdrG95dKT7X4GH8ed2kIvpY7nHAxLjbrurEuEwE=&emci=5eda6b3f-cfe4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=a55413ba-d5e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=6787172)
| [Defend Our Civil Rights →](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101681864/526733617/1502137345?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTU0MTNiYS1kNWU0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PtjEOdrG95dKT7X4GH8ed2kIvpY7nHAxLjbrurEuEwE=&emci=5eda6b3f-cfe4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=a55413ba-d5e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=6787172)

Trump’s attacks on DEI have already had drastic consequences. Following his lead, corporations like Target, Walmart, Meta, and McDonald’s are all dismantling their DEI initiatives.
Meanwhile, government workers are being terminated from their jobs simply because their work involves diversifying government programs.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Russ Vought
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Democrats cannot be operating business as usual.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2485%2E4032634%2Eebchdk)
---
With Elon Musk completely ransacking our government right now, Democrats cannot be operating business as usual. So starting last night, during a standard procedural session to debate Trump’s nomination of Russ Vought — the author of Project 2025 — for head of the Office of Management and Budget, Democrats took every second of our 30-hour allotment to hold up his nomination. The session went overnight, and I spoke for one hour to call out the serious consequences of Vought’s nomination. I reviewed just a small fraction of the alarming proposals that he authored in Project 2025, including:
* Firing civil servants.
* Weaponizing the Department of Justice and the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
* Unleashing force onto protestors and targeting political opponents.
* Restricting abortion nationwide.
* Ripping retirement and health care benefits from seniors.
* Dismantling public education.
* And funding tax cuts for the rich by raising taxes on America's middle class.

Again, just to name a few. Despite Trump claiming over and over again during the campaign that he knew nothing about Project 2025 and had nothing to do with it, he still nominated its author to a powerfully important position. It’s a job that might be less high-profile than other roles in the administration, but still carries enormous weight. The leader of the OMB oversees the creation of the federal government’s budget, oversees the policies and rules set by federal agencies, and supervises the funding and spending of federal agencies. In other words, it puts Vought in the position to execute Project 2025. We’ve already received a sneak peak of the devastating effects of Vought's plan for America. He was the puppet master behind the funding shutdown that threw this country into chaos last week. I saw how this hurt real people in Massachusetts. Parents didn't know if their toddlers' day care would be open. Seniors didn't know if the hot meal that they were expecting from Meals on Wheels would be available. Workers at nursing homes funded by Medicaid who didn’t know if their paychecks would come through. With Russ Vought at the helm of the OMB, he can operationalize Trump and Co-President Musk’s unconstitutional plans to gut funding that families rely on. That’s why Democrats are holding the floor. That’s why I’m doing everything I can to stop this extremist from joining ranks with Trump and Musk — while also pulling every lever I can to get Musk’s ransacking under control. More soon. Elizabeth

Photo taken in Gloversville, NY, Memorial Day Weekend, 2024
**Please join me in unifying around Blake Gendebien, who is our presumptive nominee for the Special Election that will happen in NY-21. It is important that, together, we support the efforts to elect a Democrat to Congress when Stefanik resigns.**
### OK -- so now what?
I'll let Blake and the Democratic County Committee Chairs have the task of walking you through the details on the next steps on the NY-21 campaign.
So that adds to the questions floating all around the country right now: "Now what?"
In general, there is a nagging question that has me, at least, experiencing sleeplessness, lack of concentration, weird appetite, and endless social media scrolling. As I spoke about on my last video, "[So - how are we supposed to live through a coup?](https://substack.com/redirect/55ec0e64-925f-4eb7-8f73-035988b4582a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)", the important thing to do is to engage in self-care. These are tough times. You need deep sleep, exercise, and nutritious food. We need you to be battle-ready, even if your battle station is just picking up the phone to your elected officials.
### My message will change slightly, but I'm not going away
Now that I am no longer a candidate for office, I will, in some ways, be more free to write, and will be more free to broaden the scope of topics beyond NY-21. In some ways, the Dems did me a favor. I can be less guarded, and can write and speak without regard for whether something I write here could get taken out of context and amplified in the various forms of North Country press.
I will continue to write on Substack and in other spaces. And I hope you will continue to read.
### For example, I no longer have to hold back when I go to ask the hard questions
If you [follow me on Blue Sky](https://substack.com/redirect/7e416c23-789e-498b-a568-86463dfb1a95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), you know that I have been asking some variation of, "Is this the day they arrest Elon Musk and The Gang of Boys?" It bothers me that they are free-ranging through our data and computer systems.
The reality is, who will arrest them? We don't really have a normal Department of Justice to issue a complaint. I'm sure the Capitol Police would love to do something, but it's not really their jurisdiction. DC Police? I honestly don't know. The charges that I propose are violations of the [Computer Fraud and Abuse Act, 18 U.S. Code § 1030](https://substack.com/redirect/834e7255-5e3c-4da5-894e-0eff67a799f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Since I am not an elected official, I can simply do what I'm doing: talk about it on social media and hope that somehow, somewhere, somebody is working on it.
In response to Elon and The Gang of Boys rummaging through our treasury and personnel systems, House Democrats will introduce the [Taxpayer Data Protection Act](https://substack.com/redirect/79ef82e6-7582-45eb-9d07-7ff25a27415e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Hakeem Jeffries, announced on Feb 6, 2025, in his news conference that "House Republicans are doing the bidding of an unelected, out-of-control billionaire puppet master." Good for Jeffries for introducing a bill.
The bad news is that Elon et al have probably accessed, downloaded, copied our data. For all we know they have already sold our data to goodness knows who. It doesn't take very long. So for a [judge to say Elon and his Gang of Boys now have "read only" access is encouraging](https://substack.com/redirect/155f10ec-9ad9-4c19-927d-94e49541cb49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But let's not kid ourselves. Much of the damage has already been done.
Don't these judges and lawmakers watch television crime shows? It takes seconds to steal data. Whoosh!
### But I am frustrated that we are 2-3 steps behind "them"
As a Democrat, I am terribly frustrated. It feels like we are 2-3 steps behind "them" and their destruction of our nation's critical systems. We can introduce bills. That's what Congress is there to do. We can file lawsuits.
But I am concerned: we need a plan for what to do if Trump suspends our court systems. Please don't tell me they can't do that. There is very little evidence that they were listening to Biden's team during Trump Transition Training 2.0 for what they "can" and "cannot" do.
For that reason, I was actually encouraged that the Trump team filed a [lawsuit against Chicago for its sanctuary city policies](https://substack.com/redirect/185359ec-bbaa-449d-ada5-42ad719a2de6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Apparently they still think the court filings are, in some way, effective deterrents.
The court filings and the injunctions are part of our process. And they serve to slow down the ongoing carnage. But even with the lightning-fast speed with which the courts have been scheduling hearings, it all seems so slow. It's like watching another form of January 6, 2021, but over many days and weeks.
### It isn't all bad
The local mobilization efforts are encouraging. People are taking to the streets all over the country, often joined by lawmakers in Washington DC. People are calling their elected officials. Admittedly, I am great at protests, but not so great at making phone calls to my electeds. I get angry when they don't answer the phone. That's me. For those of you who are OK with the daily calls to answering machines - please keep up the good effort. I need you to handle my share of that load.
Hakeem Jeffries has advised House Democrats that [they are to conduct regular town hall meetings and let people know what is going on](https://substack.com/redirect/0303189e-6ee4-45eb-8008-4071558b7508?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I applaud this. Of course I got on social media and groused something to the effect of "Why weren't they doing this already?" But when it comes to listening to constituents - better late than never. (Sidebar: I'm considering launching a sort of virtual coffee and discussion of issues, similar to town halls. The only hesitation is that we are all already so overwhelmed. I don't want to add to the cacophony. I also don't want to compete with our NY-21 nominee.)
Jeffries also asked House Dems to regularly update social media, and offered a recommendation for how frequently to do so. I noted that he recommended that House members post to TikTok. Really? I get so confused. Is TikTok "in" or is TikTok "out" in terms of Congressional favor? As with most things in Trump world, it seems like the [sale of TikTok is being packaged as part of a negotiated deal.](https://substack.com/redirect/c40c70a3-fa51-48ab-ac90-35c6b5ed125f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### The tax cuts
I just spent about an hour and a half watching[ AOC's message to her voters](https://substack.com/redirect/13814f5b-515b-42fb-99ca-04495fbff515?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Highly recommend...if you can, please set aside some time to do so. She does an excellent job of talking about what you can do now. She also does an excellent job of alerting us to the fact that all of this chaos is a [build up to the expiration of the Trump tax cuts. ](https://substack.com/redirect/53e31fee-76b7-4e1d-9ddf-34bb82e19dea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)These tax cuts are vitally important to the billionaires who have surrounded Trump. In fact, they contributed heavily to his re-election so that they could get even deeper tax cuts. Did you know that they want [$4 trillion in tax cuts](https://substack.com/redirect/b5c85be8-40de-45e5-aba4-5d2155ca7b9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
**[Did you also know that they plan for $2.3 trillion of those cuts to be paid for by slashing the budget for Medicaid?](https://substack.com/redirect/e37ef342-dca7-4055-af84-ef7165efe974?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) No wonder they are running around breaking things. The purpose for all of this chaos is that they want us to be disoriented and distracted, at least until they get the tax cuts. **
> "Extending the expiring tax cuts would:
> _**Do relatively little for households with low or middle incomes**. _Households with incomes in the top 1 percent (who make more than roughly $743,000 a year) would [get tax cuts](https://substack.com/redirect/3e077740-ee2b-4795-9c1c-477b7b198c69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) averaging $61,000 a year, compared to only about $400 for households with incomes in the bottom 60 percent (who make roughly $96,000 or less). Those tax cuts would come on top of the large tax benefits that wealthy people will receive from the 2017 law's permanent [corporate tax cuts](https://substack.com/redirect/daad8d79-2d31-4504-82bb-988f19df1057?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which are tilted even more heavily toward wealthy people than the expiring individual tax cuts.
> _**Add trillions in debt, much of it to benefit the wealthy**._ Extending the expiring tax cuts would[ cost](https://substack.com/redirect/3e077740-ee2b-4795-9c1c-477b7b198c69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $4.2 trillion over the decade 2026-2035, and roughly half of the benefits would go to people making over roughly $320,000 (that is, people with incomes in the top 5 percent)." Source: [Center on Budget and Policy Priorities.](https://substack.com/redirect/b5c85be8-40de-45e5-aba4-5d2155ca7b9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It's sick and it's wrong. The elderly, the disabled, the poor - they will find life exponentially more difficult if and when these tax cuts go into effect.
### You can do something
I started this article by asking for party unity. That's even if you are not in NY-21. I'm hearing a lot of discontent as I talk to people. Get active with Indivisible, and any of several other organizations as we head into the Special Elections and midterms.
We need you to vote blue, even if you are wondering, "What the hell are the Democrats actually DOING?" They are doing things. This will be a long haul.
Make political engagement your new hobby. Even after all of the damage from Trump 2.0 is done, it will take decades for confidence in our systems to be restored.
**But we must move forward with hope and a shared commitment that we can build a better future after all of this is over.**
### NY-21 needs a LOT of help with getting more Democrats to register to vote
Remember that one of the biggest uphill climbs that Democrats have in NY-21 is the disparity in voter registration numbers. We need a long-term commitment for year-round voter registration every day between now and the next presidential election to overcome the deficit of approximately 81,000 vote advantage in registered Republicans versus registered Democrats. I wrote about that issue [here: "Attention NY-21 Voters".](https://substack.com/redirect/6b3bd405-15cd-49e2-96cf-c1e70a28a6f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
While I am disappointed to not be the nominee for NY-21, I am committed to party unity in support of the Democrat who is.
But please understand that it's not all about the candidate nor is it all about the money they raise. Please don't shout about the lack of DNC spending in upstate NY (no -- I don't know whether they will invest in the Special Election or not). In NY-21, we really need to identify and triage some of the root causes for the dominance of Republicans in rural upstate New York. Top of that list: let's get some more Democrats on the voter registration rolls.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democrat who ran in New York's 21st Congressional District in November 2024. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. _

Peter, let me be clear: everyone has constitutional rights regardless of their immigration status. If an immigration agent approaches you or your loved ones, knowledge is the best defense.

→ Ask to see a warrant. You do not need to open a door at your home or work unless they present a valid warrant signed by a judge.
→ You have the right to remain silent. You are NOT required to answer any questions.
→ Do not sign anything without contacting legal assistance or without first speaking to a lawyer.

body:
| Hi Peter—Happy Black History Month!

This annual observance gives us an opportunity to recognize the profound impact Black Americans have made across every field - from science and medicine to arts and culture, from civil rights advocacy to entrepreneurship and innovation.

As we celebrate throughout February, we honor the well-known pioneers of color who broke barriers and the countless unsung heroes whose determination and resilience helped shape our nation. Their stories remind us that Black history is American history.

However, we must also acknowledge that significant work remains to be done. Black communities across the country continue to face systemic challenges, including disparities in healthcare access, educational opportunities, and economic advancement. The ongoing impacts of historical disenfranchisement and mass incarceration continue to affect Black families and communities today. These persistent inequities remind us that while we celebrate progress, we must also remain committed to creating meaningful change.

This Black History Month, let us not only celebrate achievements but also renew our dedication to building a more just and equitable society.

I encourage everyone to take time this month to learn, reflect, and engage with Black history and culture. Please take the time to explore local Black History Month events, support Black-owned businesses, or dive into works by Black authors and artists – not just this month, but everyday as we work toward lasting change.

Be well,

Dr. Ami Bera

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: We spent 20 years, thousands of lives, and trillions of dollars on wars. No more.
body:
War has to be a last resort. Always. And if you’re sending Americans into harm’s way, you damn well better be able to hold their parents hands and tell them the cause is worth the sacrifice.
#

Many of you know about my time in the Marine Corps.
It was something I felt I owed this country after everything it gave to me and my family. It made me who I am today, and I am proud of my service. I am proud to be a Marine.
**But war is hell.** My brothers and I went through the worst conditions you can imagine. My best friend was killed in combat. My unit had one of the worst casualty rates of the Iraq War.
The fight didn’t stop then. We came home and had to fight for the benefits we earned. Treatment, services, basic assistance — you name it. And, like every veteran, I know that the casualties don’t stop when your deployment ends.
**War is hell.** And if you’re sending Americans into harm’s way, you damn well better be able to hold their parents hands and tell them the cause is worth the sacrifice.
Trump wants to invade Panama, Greenland, and now Gaza. Donald Trump is a warmonger.
If he’s serious about this, he should send an Authorization for Use of Military Force to the United States Senate. See what happens. We’ll kill it — and it’ll be a bipartisan blowout.
We just finished 20 years of this. **No more.**
Peter, I’m asking you for your help today. [**Add your name here and tell Donald Trump: No more pointless wars. We will not send Americans to fight and die in Gaza, Panama, or Greenland.** [SIGN ON](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/pet_em_250206_war/?source=em250206-1-120&akid=3699%2E734936%2EmVoLxK) Semper Fi, Ruben

| | Peter,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

Trust in Congress is at an all-time low, but we can strengthen the integrity of our government by ensuring Members of Congress are using their access to information only to serve their constituents, not their stock portfolios.

I will always fight for YOU — my community. That means working hard to lower costs, build our economy, and make sure everyday costs go down.

Let’s get to work!

Seth

| | The legal battle over North Carolina’s 2024 State Supreme Court election continues to escalate. This Friday, February 7, another hearing is scheduled as Republican state Supreme Court candidate Jefferson Griffin continues to refuse to concede, challenging over 65,000 ballots. Justice Allison Riggs defeated Griffin by 734 votes in November's election, but instead of listening to the people, he is trying to litigate away his loss by silencing voters — disproportionately Black North Carolinians — and overturn the results of the election. Justice Riggs’ victory is the last uncertified race in this country. **Although this is a North Carolina case, Republicans’ efforts to overturn a legitimate election could be a sign of what’s to come in states across the country. This is exactly why we must pay attention to this ongoing battle.** The North Carolina Democrats continue to fight tooth and nail to uphold the will of the people, and supporters like you are helping draw public attention to this crisis. **If Republicans succeed in stealing this election, they will export their blueprint to overturn our votes everywhere.[We need all supporters of free and fair elections to show their support for this fight — split a donation today between the North Carolina Democrats and Fair Fight to protect our elections.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101686938/526750242/1933892292?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250206_f_NCDPUpdate_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTJlMWM3OC1lMmU0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PVZTpZb8MFIfpp_cP_-EfaEK6U6YfkKVxTlGK7ff5ik=)** | [DONATE NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101686939/526750243/1933892292?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250206_f_NCDPUpdate_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTJlMWM3OC1lMmU0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PVZTpZb8MFIfpp_cP_-EfaEK6U6YfkKVxTlGK7ff5ik=)

Among the voters challenged by Griffin are Justice Allison Riggs’ parents, who have been voting for 50 years. Capt. Rebecca Lobach, the Army pilot who was killed along with about 70 other people after a passenger plane collided with her helicopter in Washington D.C. last week, is also one of the North Carolina voters whose ballot is being challenged.
An analysis shows that Black voters were twice as likely to have their ballots challenged as white voters, even though white voters outnumber Black voters by over 3 to 1. Additionally, voters aged 18-25, who comprise about 12% of the electorate, made up 23% of the ballots challenged.

clean_body: Split a donation between Fair Fight and the North Carolina Democratic Party | | | The legal battle over North Carolina’s 2024 State Supreme Court election continues to escalate. This Friday, February 7, another hearing is scheduled as Republican state Supreme Court candidate Jefferson Griffin continues to refuse to concede, challenging over 65,000 ballots. Justice Allison Riggs defeated Griffin by 734 votes in November's election, but instead of listening to the people, he is trying to litigate away his loss by silencing voters — disproportionately Black North Carolinians — and overturn the results of the election. Justice Riggs’ victory is the last uncertified race in this country. Although this is a North Carolina case, Republicans’ efforts to overturn a legitimate election could be a sign of what’s to come in states across the country. This is exactly why we must pay attention to this ongoing battle. The North Carolina Democrats continue to fight tooth and nail to uphold the will of the people, and supporters like you are helping draw public attention to this crisis. If Republicans succeed in stealing this election, they will export their blueprint to overturn our votes everywhere.= | = Among the voters challenged by Griffin are Justice Allison Riggs’ parents, who have been voting for 50 years. Capt. Rebecca Lobach, the Army pilot who was killed along with about 70 other people after a passenger plane collided with her helicopter in Washington D.C. last week, is also one of the North Carolina voters whose ballot is being challenged. An analysis shows that Black voters were twice as likely to have their ballots challenged as white voters, even though white voters outnumber Black voters by over 3 to 1. Additionally, voters aged 18-25, who comprise about 12% of the electorate, made up 23% of the ballots challenged. The judges and justices presiding over these cases know that we are watching — we can’t let our guard down now, when our democracy is at stake. = Thank you for rising to the challenge.
