My Dear Friend, When I tell people my story, I hear the same things over and over again:“That’s crazy.” “I don’t believe that.” “That can’t be.”But if you’ve heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or Fox News, then you know it’s horribly true. My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son **James** in the photo above.I’ve spent the last decade fighting tooth-and-nail to keep school counselors, my ex-wife, and activist judges from “transitioning” **James** against my will. If you didn’t know, “transitioning” is the LGBTQ+ industry’s euphemism for sex change surgery or the chemical castration of a child.And if these radicals get their way, my son will be sterilized, traumatized, and dependent on Big Pharma for the rest of his life.This all started ten years ago when my ex-wife began telling me our two-year-old boy **James **wanted to become a girl.I ignored her and kept dressing my son in boy’s clothes. Because he’s a boy!But then I found out that after dropping him off at school, the school counselor would change him into girl’s clothes WITHOUT TELLING ME.The counselors and teachers also began calling him a different name, “Luna,” at school. Also without telling me!I assumed I’d be able to stop this madness during the custody hearings with my ex-wife. Instead, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.I would only be allowed to see James if I dressed him in girl’s clothes.My friend, I’ve never lied to my sons.And I’m not about to start now. So I was forced to stop visiting him.And then I began the fight of my life to save James from this evil “trans” culture.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers.I even authored a bill to outlaw sex change surgeries for minors in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee.And spent almost every dollar I had to make sure politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair.After I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, my ex-wife fled with **James** to California: a “trans sanctuary” state. I think you know exactly what happened once she got to California.A radical judge sided with my ex-wife and gave the greenlight to proceed with chemically castrating my son.I have never felt so helpless in my life. I am James’s father – yet I can’t protect him from the powerful LGBTQ+ activists who are using my ex-wife and our kangaroo court systems to turn my son into the poster child for their twisted and perverted agenda.I’ve watched the school system, my ex-wife, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.In fact, I can’t even appeal my case because the judge sealed the court records. I’d have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process.Worst of all, I am under a gag order to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Technically, my writing you this to you today is illegal.But I didn’t hesitate for one second to write it. If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time.But I’m not just some activist.I’m a father trying to save his son from the Left’s madness and butchery.This is what happens when you go up against the $6 BILLION “trans lobby” and radical activist judges.They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... They’re trying to bankrupt me in legal fees...They’re trying to break my spirit...But I refuse to ever stop fighting for my son... for truth... and for what’s right. Because I don’t want this to ever happen to another family.These radical LGBTQ+ doctors, lawyers and judges need to be stopped...They need to be held accountable...And **James** needs to be **saved** before he’s permanently butchered.That’s why I’m writing to you today.When Patriots Legal Defense Fund (PLDF) heard about my case, they immediately offered to stand with me and fight this insanity.PLDF has been on the frontlines defending innocent J6ers targeted by the Biden DOJ.And when they heard about my case, they told me they’d help in any way possible.The fact is, this transgender madness is affecting all of our children and grandchildren. It’s in their schools. In the books in their libraries. Pediatricians are asking five-year-olds if they “feel like they’re in the wrong body” during routine doctor visits.This is madness. And it’s got to stop.If you want to help save my son **James **from castration and make sure this will NEVER happen to ANY child ever again... And if you want to send a message to these radical judges that their day of reckoning has come... clean_body: This all started ten years ago when my ex-wife began telling me our two-year-old boy James wanted to become a girl.| | | I don’t even know what my son looks like now. | | | | | | My Dear Friend, When I tell people my story, I hear the same things over and over again:“That’s crazy.” “I don’t believe that.” “That can’t be.”But if you’ve heard about my case from Charlie Kirk, Nick Freitas, or Fox News, then you know it’s horribly true. My name is Jeff Younger, and I’m the father to two wonderful boys. That’s my son James in the photo above.I’ve spent the last decade fighting tooth-and-nail to keep school counselors, my ex-wife, and activist judges from “transitioning” James against my will. If you didn’t know, “transitioning” is the LGBTQ+ industry’s euphemism for sex change surgery or the chemical castration of a child.And if these radicals get their way, my son will be sterilized, traumatized, and dependent on Big Pharma for the rest of his life.This all started ten years ago when my ex-wife began telling me our two-year-old boy James wanted to become a girl.I ignored her and kept dressing my son in boy’s clothes. Because he’s a boy!But then I found out that after dropping him off at school, the school counselor would change him into girl’s clothes WITHOUT TELLING ME.The counselors and teachers also began calling him a different name, “Luna,” at school. Also without telling me!I assumed I’d be able to stop this madness during the custody hearings with my ex-wife. Instead, the judge BANNED me from seeing my son.I would only be allowed to see James if I dressed him in girl’s clothes.My friend, I’ve never lied to my sons.And I’m not about to start now. So I was forced to stop visiting him.And then I began the fight of my life to save James from this evil “trans” culture.I’ve been in court three times a week for the past eight years. At this point, I have more trial experience than most lawyers.I even authored a bill to outlaw sex change surgeries for minors in Texas, South Carolina, and Tennessee.And spent almost every dollar I had to make sure politicians passed those bills.But these Radicals are relentless and they don’t play fair.After I got the law passed in my home state of Texas, my ex-wife fled with James to California: a “trans sanctuary” state. I think you know exactly what happened once she got to California.A radical judge sided with my ex-wife and gave the greenlight to proceed with chemically castrating my son.I have never felt so helpless in my life. I am James’s father – yet I can’t protect him from the powerful LGBTQ+ activists who are using my ex-wife and our kangaroo court systems to turn my son into the poster child for their twisted and perverted agenda.I’ve watched the school system, my ex-wife, and the courts systematically strip me of all parental rights and privileges.In fact, I can’t even appeal my case because the judge sealed the court records. I’d have to sue the LA County Court to unseal the records just to BEGIN the appeal process.Worst of all, I am under a gag order to NEVER speak about transgender issues publicly.Technically, my writing you this to you today is illegal.But I didn’t hesitate for one second to write it. If I were just some activist, maybe I would worry about the threat of jail time.But I’m not just some activist.I’m a father trying to save his son from the Left’s madness and butchery.This is what happens when you go up against the $6 BILLION “trans lobby” and radical activist judges.They’re trying to bury me in paperwork... It’s in their schools. In the books in their libraries. Pediatricians are asking five-year-olds if they “feel like they’re in the wrong body” during routine doctor visits.This is madness. And it’s got to stop.If you want to help save my son James from castration and make sure this will NEVER happen to ANY child ever again... Derek,
Trump recently enacted tariffs on goods imported from China, and is negotiating additional tariffs on goods coming from Canada and Mexico.
A tariff is a tax on an item that comes into the US from another country. _When companies pay more to bring these items in, economists agree they pass the cost along to us—the consumers._
Simply put, tariffs lead to higher prices. Everything from iPhones to avocados could become more expensive. Different think tanks have estimated that if all of Trump’s tariffs are implemented, the average American family would lose between $800 and $1,200 in 2025 alone.
Trump ran on a campaign platform of lowering the cost of goods for Americans, but **he’s enacting policies that do the opposite.**
More soon,
Katie Porter

name: Rebecca Cooke
subject: Sounding the alarm isn’t enough. We need action.
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101687104/526750818/1706257898?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjQxODhkNS1lM2U0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Um9QCxuIxfWLkKW0eqSdilK1GnKshE6C0bJsiSV0KJ8=&emci=ad656183-e3e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=864188d5-e3e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=5944223)
Peter, It’s been a while since I last reached out, but with everything we’re seeing out of Washington, I felt compelled to. These past two weeks have the American people grappling with a deluge of crushing acts from this administration – attempts to dismantle the Department of Education, threats to hike tariffs that will hit working families hardest, and policies that put billionaires first while leaving the rest of us behind. I’m feeling it personally. I’m still waitressing at the _Good Wives_ in Eau Claire, and I hear the same ongoing concerns from folks in our community. The cost of living is still on the rise, family farms are folding, and home ownership feels further and further out of reach. **We're past the point of sounding the alarm. We need action.** I’ve been seriously considering running for Congress again in WI-03, because we can't just vent our frustrations and hope for a change. We need leaders who will fight back. Working families need an actual check on this administration’s worst instincts. **Looking Back on the 2024 Election** As I reflect back, I want to take stock of how our last race played out.
* **Overperformance.** Our campaign performed better than every Democrat on the ticket in WI-03. People voted for Donald Trump and split their ticket to vote for me. But why? More on that below... Our success goes beyond this cycle as we bested the Democratic nominee from 2022 and garnered more votes than any Democrat in this District in nearly a decade.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101687105/526750819/1706257898?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjQxODhkNS1lM2U0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Um9QCxuIxfWLkKW0eqSdilK1GnKshE6C0bJsiSV0KJ8=&emci=ad656183-e3e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=864188d5-e3e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=5944223)
*
* **National support.** We drew national investment from House leadership, New Democrats, Blue Dogs, the DCCC and Welcome Party among others. They invested in this race because we had a message that resonated, mobilization power to turnout voters at the grassroots level, and the resources to communicate our message to the greater electorate. Without a change in campaign finance laws, campaigns cannot be won on “good intentions” alone.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101687106/526750820/-61663605?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjQxODhkNS1lM2U0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Um9QCxuIxfWLkKW0eqSdilK1GnKshE6C0bJsiSV0KJ8=&emci=ad656183-e3e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=864188d5-e3e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=5944223) | California Rep. Pete Aguilar, the third highest-ranking House Democrat, told the Journal Sentinel last week he thought Cooke **“performed incredibly strong”** this past cycle. “She spoke to concerns, kitchen table issues that people have,” said Aguilar, the chairman of the House Democratic caucus who spoke with Cooke after the election. “She’s just a unique candidate.” **“I encouraged her to think through what the future holds for her,” he added. “It’s up to her, but I’m a big fan of Rebecca Cooke.”**
---
*
* **Message discipline.** We avoided getting caught in the culture wars that radical factions of each party attempted to take attention away from bread and butter issues. Knowing what working people are struggling with, we remained laser focused talking about: increasing healthcare access and affordability, strengthening our economy to better serve working families and securing our southern border.
*
* **Authenticity** We ran an authentic campaign. One that attempted to draw people into a big tent, rather than demonize MAGA voters. People voted for Donald Trump, and they voted for me. Telling it to people straight: we need more people in D.C. who aren’t so far left or so far right, but willing to work across the aisle to get things done. Fewer limousine liberals and radicalized right wingers.

**Looking ahead to 2026 and beyond**
Have you ever read the book [_‘Bowling Alone’_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101687107/526750821/-1857703783?hvadid=693706201118&hvdev=c&hvdvcmdl&hvlocint&hvlocphy=9031187&hvnetw=g&hvpone&hvpos&hvptwo&hvqmt&hvrand=14406217180758893110&hvtargid=pla-921111091861&linkCode=df0&mcid=8da9d5aa4b70314a8b9c15a4aa861bcd&psc=1&tag=hyprod-20&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjQxODhkNS1lM2U0LWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Um9QCxuIxfWLkKW0eqSdilK1GnKshE6C0bJsiSV0KJ8=&emci=ad656183-e3e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=864188d5-e3e4-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=5944223)?
My campaign manager would mention it often as we spent time meeting voters at lutefisk lunches, fall bazaars in church basements and farm gatherings. We were at the heart of community centers that saw each other as neighbors first. But what happens over time when people abandon Kiwanis, quit going to church and no longer play in the bowling league, but bowl alone?
They feel isolated. It’s this type of isolation – this lack of community — that pushes people to find solace in the fringes and join radical movements. Much of that isolation is cultivated with the veil digital media holds over our lens of reality.
**As a party, what does that mean? And how do we work to rebuild a party that draws people towards our shared values and makes them feel a part of something? This is what I found to break through:**
* **Speaking with a local, culturally relevant voice.** We have to tell the story about our successes as a party in a way that connects with people. That connects federal legislation to our districts – that showcases the ways in which we are improving people’s lives. You can’t do that by throwing around acronyms for bills 100s of pages long or speaking only to fellow Democrats at county party meetings. But you can do so by speaking to the *actual* local implications. We need fewer social media wars and keyboard activists, more in-person case work and relationship building.
*
* **Avoiding purity tests.** I can’t tell you how many times I didn’t meet the “liberal enough” metric for local legislators or the Democratic establishment. We need to find value in people who come from working class backgrounds and have nuanced policy positions. This kind of credentialing in Democratic politics is harmful – no one should have to ask permission to serve their community.
*
* **Crafting a moderate agenda.** One thing I noticed about the right is how clear the agenda can be i.e. _Trump = safe, Kamala = crime._ Even the far-left are clear with legislation like Medicare for All and the Green New Deal. But where is the clear agenda for those of us in the middle? We need a disciplined policy agenda — not driven by emotion or elites, but by what we know are the top five issues keeping Americans up at night and then deliver on those promises. More on that soon.
*
* **Recruiting the right people to run.** Democratic recruitment tends to lean on candidates with the biggest rolodex and establishment credentials. Instead we should focus on uplifting those who are truly reflective of the values of our communities. We need fewer career politicians and elites, and more regular people who are leading within their union, forging new paths on Main Street or keeping their family businesses and farms alive. People want to trust their legislators, and who better to send to Washington than those who have experienced failed policy and will fight like hell to improve our neighbors lives?

It is no secret I am strongly considering a bid for this seat in 2026. It takes time to build trust with voters. It takes time to root a campaign that can stand on its own two feet and tell the Democratic establishment when it's wrong. It takes time to build the right toolkit to combat a decades long war on the working class. But I look forward to continuing this work, and it’s my hope that when the time comes, we will do it together.
With warmth,
Rebecca

| | Patriot, Elon Musk is right. It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math. It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029. While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in Congress. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in the Electoral College. And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully **canceled out in future elections**. **_American elections should be decided by American citizens._** **[If you agree then please sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution so the chaos we’re seeing now _never_ happens again in America.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kVGLozAUhX_N9a1ibmLUBx901IGlXZjuTGH2RWISp9kadTU6dH_9opS-BPLxwTmHK-zYmfaeQpQD4tWoGRCBZoC4OHoRHx-n6X44Ho_D4Zui3jjgy0Nd8Sn3Uvy5fS7r-rb8nnP-Vo1_b2IlT93dR_2UH6G-tsJ0G40KT6UMBWmlp1MS0TiOOTLqXVPOWNg0YaQZcim5xCBRnAWoAiRNE8aeSTHAMMCAIw0jgj4LVaRZmyhJSSuDCFiwB_ntpLW7mv6mJyVMd_flYL0uvTo3znuxCrASVkghnRl6f9Lr6ssBsJrdFCtGEkWahBPNgFaLs7XTkwVatE4RQL6ReVgmqYEWefF6OJeXB7ZamWVTy9ODSGFHYb56oMVenxBe58VrnZ2y9zr_-XLZf-fyUv96z86H7QHkdd8ZBbT4HKuzjZKsbXa4n40WaxiW1b8fqvSmVI3fpuvMzLf5X_v8be2a4v8AAAD__4kQlpY)** Because, here’s the scary part: The last census took place in 2020. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million). You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. **[It’s vitally important that your representatives in Washington and in your state legislature hear this demand directly from you.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kc2OmzAUhZ_G7ILsazBkwSIMMNU0qTRpJlK7Qbf-mbjhr8YQpU8_AkXZWPKnTzrn6GI7NNbcM5LkBOBi1UgACN8RgMnzM358HNx9s9_v-82Ng144gZeHOsNT7iT-vf6a5vl9-j3m4r0a_l1xZk_d3wf9lB-hoW7RNgtNikBlESAzMtAZS3iapgIiHlwyQQ1qnqDQHKXSoAQmBmJKDdDURHFgM6AQU6ACeJwwCKNYJToyWyU5M5ImJKJrUGic1v5iu6t2Cm1zD2XfBk128X4Y12IVgQpblCi97bvQ6XkOZU-gGr1LVcS2iv3ZCqYjwqvJt7XXriW8MF4xAmIhYz85qQkv8uJ1cyzPD9xqZadFLQ8PIrEd0H52hBdrfcZEnRev9e6wO9X5j5fz-juW5_rnaXfcLA8BUXeNVYQX3x3iePp2eOtWuJ6NF3Mcl9X_N1UGLlPDzTaNHcUy_3Odv6ydM_gKAAD__5Ntl6Q)** Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you. They think you and I will be so relieved to see the border secure again and criminal illegal aliens deported, that you and I will be oblivious to this threat lying dormant under our very eyes. No way. My name is Rebecca Weber. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. **AMAC Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.** **We’ve got 72 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates, who are the “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices.** **Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of our 2,000,000 AMAC members to meet, hear, and question them.** **And you should also know that we now have more than 337,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with members of the** **U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the issues.** Quite simply, when we speak, Washington listens. [](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kLtuwjAYRp_G2Yjs37EdBg-lIUNFBwZatQvyLY0htybGKH36KhFi_XSkc_Spdmh8NUskdgig9nZCAIi-IIBboB_qdHof583hcOg3dwpu2RG8PtAIT7gz6nL9usV4vH1PO34sh9-riuSJh3lwT_ghTV2rfLOsokiszECRyiROEkHzPOeQ0aSWRBvKLKeWYGK45oJVW4w5zYUQTDuceAkYGAbMgTJBIM2YFS6rttZQUhksUIZXUVqNzoXad1c3WuWbOTV9mzSyDmGY1rASQalaZZQJvu_S0cWYmh5ByXOqt1wDsVpbrC2i5blrvEW0CJ-huFT0IgYE_NytD9IiMrYv_97sPhmlHe6-afzEl5KftWQRRwn_AQAA___eDXIM)**[And AMAC Action needs your help today in this do-or-die battle to pass a Constitutional Amendment to protect your vote from being canceled out by an illegal alien or a convicted felon.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kUGLozAYhn9NvFWaL5rYg4dadWBpF6Y7U9i9SJovGTM16mh06P76QSm9BPLwhPd9iXR9Y809JSIjALXFkQAQticAk2cX-f5-Gu6b4_HYbb4Z6IUTODzUGZ5yq-Tn7e80z6_TvzHjr2X_dZMzfer-3uun_AgNtZO2WajIA0wjkNSoQKdUsCRJOEQsqNMIMebCAHKdIAopjDFKx2onEwCVYGBT2EK8hS0HFgsKYRSj0JHZoWLUqK0g0XYNCs2gta9te9MDStvcQ9W5oElr7_txLVYSKKWTSipvuzYc9DyHqiNQjn5IMKI7pNcdpzoirJy8q7weHGG58UgJ8IWM3TQoTVie5S-bc3F5YKfRTotanB5ESddL-9ESlq_1KeVVlr9U-9P-rcp-Hy7r7Vxcqj9v-_NmOQjwqm0sLk_8V1tfr58Ht8L121g-x3FR_v-FRTCk2H_bprEjX-Z_rPOXtXMKPwEAAP__eIiYjw)** But I can’t do it without you. **No matter what issue you care about the most, if you and I don’t have a secure,_honest_ elections... none of it matters.** Inflation. Illegal immigration. Violent Crime. Drug use. Homelessness. The 2nd Amendment. Out of control spending. Social Security and Medicare insolvency. Right to Life. Indoctrination in our schools. Endless foreign wars. You name it. **[So please follow this link to sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kVGLozAUhX9NfKsk90ZtH3yoo86ytMNOZ1rYfZE0idNsjboaU7q_flBKXwL5-OCcwxW2b0x9T0mSEYCLUSMBILglAJPDkzge98N9tdvtutUNQc-cwMtD9fCUWyn-Xn9P3r9Pf8Ysfi_7f1fh2VN3914_5UdoqK0wzUyTPFApB8FqGeiUJbher2PgGFzSWuJ5o6jkQHkEyOSZ1tGZc8kSpEImgUmBQkSBxoBRwiDkkUo0rzdKIqslTQinS1BYD1q7i2mvelDCNPdQdjZo0otz_bgUKwmUwgoppDNdGw7a-1B2BMrRDWvF2Uax8yZmmhMsJ2crpwdLMK-dYgTimYzdNEhNMM_y19WhOD2w1cpMs1rsH0QK2wvz1RLMl_qMxVWWv1bb_fazyt5eTsvvUJyqj8_tYTU_BOKqbYwimP_68QYfU2GP2QKXs2Huo6go__9URTCkqr-ZpjFjPM__WubPa30K3wEAAP__6PiWyA)** so that AMAC Action can put your representatives in Washington and in the state legislature on notice with a simple demand: Namely, that you will not tolerate this erosion of your vote. Now, here’s the bad news: Most state constitutions grant voting rights to “every” citizen, open-ended language that liberal activists argue permits localities to authorize non-citizen and even illegal alien voting. States should amend their constitutions to instead permit “only” citizens to vote. But there’s good news, too: Seven states have _expressly_ banned non-citizen voting already: Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Louisiana, North Dakota, and Ohio. **What’s more, voters approve of constitutional amendments to ban non-citizen voting by overwhelming margins. Nearly 77% of Ohio voters approved a measure in 2022, while nearly 63% of Colorado voters approved one in 2020.** This is a solution whose time has come. Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America.
